# False color composite\n\nA false color.msgid:
# False color composite

A false color composite uses at least one non-visible wavelength to image Earth. The false color composite using near infrared, red and green bands is very popular (a band is a region of the electromagnetic spectrum; a satellite sensor can image Earth in different bands). The false colour composite is most commonly used to assess plant density and health, since plants reflect near infrared and green light, while they absorb red. Cities and exposed ground are grey or tan, and water appears blue or black.



More info [here](https://custom-scripts.sentinel-hub.com/sentinel-2/false_color_infrared/).
msgstr:
# Kompozit lažnih barv

Kompozit lažnih barv za upodobitev Zemlje uporablja vsaj eno nevidno valovno dolžino. Zelo priljubljen je kompozit lažnih barv iz bližnjih infrardečih, rdečih in zelenih kanalov (kanal je območje elektromagnetnega spektra; satelitski senzor lahko Zemljo posname v različnih kanalih). Kompozit lažnih barv se najpogosteje uporablja za oceno gostote in zdravja rastlin, saj rastline odbijajo bližnjo infrardečo in zeleno svetlobo, rdečo pa absorbirajo. Mesta in izpostavljena tla so siva ali rjavkasta, voda pa je videti modra ali črna.



Več informacij [tukaj](https://custom-scripts.sentinel-hub.com/sentinel-2/false_color_infrared/).

# Normalized Difference Vegetation Index.msgid:
# Normalized Difference Vegetation Index (NDVI)

The normalized difference vegetation index is a simple, but effective index for quantifying green vegetation. It is a measure of the state of vegetation health based on how plants reflect light at certain wavelengths. The value range of the NDVI is -1 to 1. Negative values of NDVI (values approaching -1) correspond to water. Values close to zero (-0.1to 0.1) generally correspond to barren areas of rock, sand, or snow. Low, positive values represent shrub and grassland (approximately 0.2 to 0.4), while high values indicate temperate and tropical rainforests (values approaching 1).

More info [here](https://custom-scripts.sentinel-hub.com/sentinel-2/ndvi/).
msgstr:
# Normalizirani diferenčni vegetacijski indeks (NDVI)

Normalizirani diferenčni vegetacijski indeks je preprost, a učinkovit indeks za kvantifikacijo zelene vegetacije. Je merilo stanja zdravja vegetacije na podlagi tega, kako rastline odbijajo svetlobo pri določenih valovnih dolžinah. Razpon vrednosti NDVI je od -1 do 1. Negativne vrednosti NDVI (vrednosti, ki se bližajo -1) ustrezajo vodi. Vrednosti blizu nič (-0,1 do 0,1) običajno ustrezajo golim območjem skal, peska ali snega. Nizke pozitivne vrednosti predstavljajo grmičevje in travinje (približno 0,2 do 0,4), visoke vrednosti pa kažejo na zmerne in tropske deževne gozdove (vrednosti, ki se bližajo 1).

Več informacij [tukaj](https://custom-scripts.sentinel-hub.com/sentinel-2/ndvi/).

GDMP (Gross Dry Matter Productivity) is.msgid: GDMP (Gross Dry Matter Productivity) is considered as the amount of biomass that primary producers create in a given length of time, without any losses caused by respiration. The relation between the DMP (Dry matter productivity) and the GDMP is as follows: DMP = GDMP * AR (with AR = Autotrophic respiration factor).
msgstr: GDMP (bruto produktivnost suhe snovi) se obravnava kot količina biomase, ki jo primarni proizvajalci ustvarijo v določenem časovnem obdobju, brez izgub zaradi dihanja. Razmerje med DMP (produktivnost suhe snovi) in GDMP je naslednje: DMP = GDMP * AR (pri čemer je AR = faktor avtotrofnega dihanja).

DMP, or Dry Matter Productivity, represe.msgid: DMP, or Dry Matter Productivity, represents the overall growth rate or dry biomass increase of the vegetation, expressed in kilograms of dry matter per hectare per day (kgDM/ha/day). DMP is directly related to NPP (Net Primary Productivity, in gC/m²/day), but its units are customized for agro-statistical purposes.
msgstr: DMP ali produktivnost suhe snovi predstavlja splošno stopnjo rasti oziroma prirastek suhe biomase vegetacije, izražen v kilogramih suhe snovi na hektar na dan (kgDM/ha/dan). DMP je neposredno povezan z NPP (neto primarna produktivnost, v gC/m²/dan), vendar so njegove enote prilagojene agrostatističnim namenom.

FAPAR corresponds to the fraction of pho.msgid: FAPAR corresponds to the fraction of photosynthetically active radiation absorbed by the green elements of the canopy. The FAPAR value results directly from the radiative transfer model in the canopy which is computed instantaneously. It depends on canopy structure, vegetation element optical properties and illumination conditions. FAPAR is very useful as input to a number of primary productivity models based on simple efficiency considerations.
msgstr: FAPAR ustreza deležu fotosintetsko aktivnega sevanja, ki ga absorbirajo zeleni elementi krošnje. Vrednost FAPAR neposredno izhaja iz modela sevalnega prenosa v krošnji, ki se izračuna trenutno. Odvisna je od zgradbe krošnje, optičnih lastnosti rastlinskih elementov in osvetlitvenih razmer. FAPAR je zelo uporaben kot vhodni podatek za številne modele primarne produktivnosti, ki temeljijo na preprostih premislekih o učinkovitosti.

FCover is defined as the fraction of gro.msgid: FCover is defined as the fraction of ground surface covered by green vegetation as seen from the nadir direction. It is used to separate vegetation and soil in energy balance processes, including temperature and evapotranspiration. It is computed from the leaf area index and other canopy structural variables and does not depend on variables such as the geometry of illumination as compared to FAPAR. For this reason, it is a very good candidate for the replacement of classical vegetation indices for the monitoring of green vegetation. Because of the linear relationship with radiometric signal, FCover will be only marginally scale dependent. Note that similarly to LAI and FAPAR, only the green elements will be considered, either belonging both to the overstory and understory.
msgstr: FCover je opredeljen kot delež talne površine, prekrite z zeleno vegetacijo, gledano v smeri nadirja. Uporablja se za ločevanje vegetacije in tal v procesih energijske bilance, vključno s temperaturo in evapotranspiracijo. Izračuna se iz indeksa listne površine in drugih strukturnih spremenljivk krošnje ter za razliko od FAPAR ni odvisen od spremenljivk, kot je geometrija osvetlitve. Zato je zelo dober kandidat za zamenjavo klasičnih vegetacijskih indeksov pri spremljanju zelene vegetacije. Zaradi linearnega razmerja z radiometričnim signalom bo FCover le v manjši meri odvisen od merila. Upoštevajte, da se podobno kot pri LAI in FAPAR upoštevajo samo zeleni elementi, ki pripadajo zgornji ali spodnji plasti sestoja.

Gross Primary Production (GPP) expresses.msgid: Gross Primary Production (GPP) expresses a component of Primary Production of ecosystems related to the creation of new organic matter by vegetation. GPP is the total amount of dry matter (carbon) "fixed" by land plants per unit time through photosynthesis (atmospheric CO2 into organic compounds). A substantial fraction of GPP supports plant autotrophic respiration (Ra). GPP is typically expressed as gram of carbon per square meter per day (gC/m2 /day).
msgstr: Bruto primarna produkcija (GPP) izraža sestavino primarne produkcije ekosistemov, povezano z nastajanjem nove organske snovi z vegetacijo. GPP je celotna količina suhe snovi (ogljika), ki jo kopenske rastline s fotosintezo »vežejo« na enoto časa (atmosferski CO2 v organske spojine). Znaten delež GPP podpira avtotrofno dihanje rastlin (Ra). GPP se običajno izraža v gramih ogljika na kvadratni meter na dan (gC/m2 /dan).

LAI is defined as half the developed are.msgid: LAI is defined as half the developed area of photosynthetically active elements of the vegetation per unit horizontal ground area. It determines the size of the interface for exchange of energy (including radiation) and mass between the canopy and the atmosphere. This is an intrinsic canopy primary variable that should not depend on observation conditions. LAI is strongly non-linearly related to reflectance. Therefore, its estimation from remote sensing observations is scale dependent.
msgstr: LAI je opredeljen kot polovica razvite površine fotosintetsko aktivnih elementov vegetacije na enoto vodoravne talne površine. Določa velikost vmesnika za izmenjavo energije (vključno s sevanjem) in mase med krošnjami in atmosfero. To je intrinzična primarna spremenljivka krošenj, ki naj ne bi bila odvisna od pogojev opazovanja. LAI je močno nelinearno povezan z odbojnostjo. Zato je njegova ocena iz opazovanj daljinskega zaznavanja odvisna od merila.

\"NPP, or Net Primary Production, is an.msgid: "NPP, or Net Primary Production, is an indicator of the rate at which plants produce net useful chemical energy expressed in mass of carbon per unit area per day (gC/m²/day)."
msgstr: "NPP ali neto primarna produkcija je kazalnik hitrosti, s katero rastline proizvajajo neto uporabno kemično energijo, izraženo v masi ogljika na enoto površine na dan (gC/m²/dan)."

SWI computed with a characteristic time.msgid: SWI computed with a characteristic time length of 1 day. The Soil Water index (SWI) provides global daily information about moisture conditions in different soil depths. Near Real Time Data uses the EUMETSAT ASCAT-25km SSM product in orbit format as input data. The Archive of ASCAT SWI uses reprocessed SSM data from TU Wien.
msgstr: SWI, izračunan s karakteristično časovno dolžino 1 dan. Indeks vodnosti tal (SWI) zagotavlja globalne dnevne informacije o vlažnosti na različnih globinah tal. Podatki v skoraj realnem času uporabljajo kot vhodne podatke izdelek EUMETSAT ASCAT-25km SSM v orbitalnem formatu. Arhiv ASCAT SWI uporablja ponovno obdelane podatke SSM univerze TU Wien.

Surface soil moisture (SSM) retrieval fr.msgid: Surface soil moisture (SSM) retrieval from scatterometer data has certain limitations: it cannot be retrieved when the surface is frozen or covered by snow, dense vegetation, or water. Whereas dense vegetation and water are almost static factors, the freeze/thaw cycle is dynamic. The frozen state of the surface is recorded within the surface state flag (SSF).
msgstr: Pridobivanje vlažnosti površinskih tal (SSM) iz podatkov sipalnika ima določene omejitve: ni ga mogoče izvesti, kadar je površje zmrznjeno ali prekrito s snegom, gosto vegetacijo ali vodo. Medtem ko sta gosta vegetacija in voda skoraj statična dejavnika, je cikel zmrzovanja/odtajanja dinamičen. Zmrznjeno stanje površja je zabeleženo v zastavici stanja površja (SSF).

NDVI, or Normalized Difference Vegetatio.msgid: NDVI, or Normalized Difference Vegetation Index, is a dimensionless index that is indicative for vegetation density and is calculated by comparing the visible and near-infrared sunlight reflected by the surface (reflectance). The Global Land NDVI Collection 300m product is a 10-day synthesis product derived from Top of Canopy PROBA-V 300m data.
msgstr: NDVI ali normalizirani diferenčni vegetacijski indeks je brezdimenzijski indeks, ki kaže gostoto vegetacije in se izračuna s primerjavo vidne in bližnje infrardeče sončne svetlobe, ki jo odbije površje (odbojnost). Izdelek Global Land NDVI Collection 300m je 10-dnevni sintezni izdelek, izpeljan iz podatkov PROBA-V 300m na vrhu krošenj.

SSM (Surface Soil Moisture) describes so.msgid: SSM (Surface Soil Moisture) describes soil moisture of the soil’s topmost 5cm on a 1km (1°/112) spatial sampling. It is derived from microwave radar data observed by the Sentinel-1 SAR satellite sensors.
msgstr: SSM (vlažnost površinskih tal) opisuje vlažnost zgornjih 5 cm tal pri prostorskem vzorčenju 1 km (1°/112). Izpeljana je iz mikrovalovnih radarskih podatkov, ki jih opazujejo senzorji SAR satelita Sentinel-1.

Land Surface Temperature (LST) is estima.msgid:
Land Surface Temperature (LST) is estimated from Top-of-Atmosphere (TOA) brightness
temperatures of atmospheric window channels within the infrared range. LST describes processes such as the exchange of energy and water between the land surface and atmosphere, and influences the rate and timing of plant growth.
msgstr:
Temperatura zemeljskega površja (LST) se ocenjuje iz sevalnih temperatur na vrhu atmosfere (TOA)
v kanalih atmosferskega okna v infrardečem območju. LST opisuje procese, kot sta izmenjava energije in vode med zemeljskim površjem in atmosfero, ter vpliva na hitrost in čas rasti rastlin.

This product is a 10-daily synthesis pro.msgid: This product is a 10-daily synthesis product derived from Top of Canopy (TOC) PROVA-V 333 m data. The basic Water Bodies (WB) layer which tells which pixels contain water and which not, defined as permanent and seasonal water bodies, natural and man-made, independently of their size. Include but are not restricted to the lakes of the Global terrestrial Network for lakes.
msgstr: Ta izdelek je 10-dnevni sintezni izdelek, izpeljan iz podatkov PROBA-V 333 m na vrhu krošenj (TOC). Osnovni sloj vodnih teles (WB) pove, katere slikovne pike vsebujejo vodo in katere ne; opredeljen je kot stalna in sezonska vodna telesa, naravna in umetna, ne glede na njihovo velikost. Vključuje jezera globalnega terestričnega omrežja za jezera, vendar ni omejen nanje.

Snow Water Equivalent (SWE) is the measu.msgid: Snow Water Equivalent (SWE) is the measure of the amount of water frozen within the snow pack per unit area. In principle, it gives the height of the water column that would form, if the snow pack would melt completely. It is measured and indicated in millimetres [mm]. The retrieval algorithm used here combines information from satellite-based microwave radiometer and optical spectrometer observations with ground based weather station snow depth measurements and produces daily hemispherical scale SWE estimates.
msgstr: Vodni ekvivalent snega (SWE) je merilo količine vode, zamrznjene v snežni odeji na enoto površine. Načeloma podaja višino vodnega stolpca, ki bi nastal, če bi se snežna odeja popolnoma stopila. Meri se in izraža v milimetrih [mm]. Uporabljeni algoritem pridobivanja združuje informacije iz satelitskih opazovanj mikrovalovnega radiometra in optičnega spektrometra z meritvami višine snega na prizemnih vremenskih postajah ter ustvarja dnevne ocene SWE na hemisferni ravni.

The Snow Cover Extent (SCE) product prov.msgid: The Snow Cover Extent (SCE) product provides information on the Fraction of Snow Cover (FSC) per pixel in percentage (0% – 100%). The SCE is derived from medium resolution optical satellite data. The dataset has the following classes: Outside area of interest (0), Water bodies (20), Cloud mask (30), Polar night (251), Input data error (254), No data (255), and Snow Cover Extent (values between 100 and 200, where the percentage of snow cover can be derived using the formula: SCE = value – 100).
msgstr: Izdelek obsega snežne odeje (SCE) podaja informacije o deležu snežne odeje (FSC) na slikovno piko v odstotkih (0 % – 100 %). SCE je izpeljan iz optičnih satelitskih podatkov srednje ločljivosti. Nabor podatkov ima naslednje razrede: zunaj območja interesa (0), vodna telesa (20), maska oblakov (30), polarna noč (251), napaka vhodnih podatkov (254), ni podatkov (255) in obseg snežne odeje (vrednosti med 100 in 200, pri čemer je odstotek snežne odeje mogoče izpeljati s formulo: SCE = vrednost – 100).

The main Water Bodies detection layer (W.msgid: The main Water Bodies detection layer (WB) uses the following values: Sea (0), Water (70), No data (251), No water (255). From the Sentinel-2 L1C input reflectances, Water Bodies are detected using the Modified Normalized Difference Water Index (MNDWI), for each input tile
msgstr: Glavni sloj zaznavanja vodnih teles (WB) uporablja naslednje vrednosti: morje (0), voda (70), ni podatkov (251), ni vode (255). Iz vhodnih odbojnosti Sentinel-2 L1C se vodna telesa za vsako vhodno ploščico zaznajo z uporabo spremenjenega normaliziranega diferenčnega vodnega indeksa (MNDWI)

The LIE variable is a classification of.msgid: The LIE variable is a classification of lake ice state, with the following classes: Ice cover (10), Open water (30), Cloud (40). Some specific flag values are used: Not interpreted / no satellite input data (50), Sea pixel (60), Land pixel (70).
msgstr: Spremenljivka LIE je klasifikacija stanja ledu na jezerih z naslednjimi razredi: ledena odeja (10), odprta voda (30), oblak (40). Uporabljene so nekatere posebne vrednosti zastavic: ni interpretirano / ni vhodnih satelitskih podatkov (50), morska slikovna pika (60), kopenska slikovna pika (70).

The LIE variable is a classification of.msgid: The LIE variable is a classification of lake ice state, with the following classes: Fully snow covered ice (1), Partially snow covered or  snow free ice (2), Open water (3). Some specific flag values are also used for LIE: 0 for missing data, 4 for sea pixels, 5 for cloudy pixels, 6 for land area. LIE 250m uses thresholds on Top-of-Atmosphere (TOA) reflectances for full snow cover, partially snow covered ice/clear ice, and open water.
msgstr: Spremenljivka LIE je klasifikacija stanja ledu na jezerih z naslednjimi razredi: led, popolnoma prekrit s snegom (1), led, delno prekrit s snegom ali brez snega (2), odprta voda (3). Za LIE se uporabljajo tudi nekatere posebne vrednosti zastavic: 0 za manjkajoče podatke, 4 za morske slikovne pike, 5 za oblačne slikovne pike, 6 za kopensko območje. LIE 250m uporablja pragove odbojnosti na vrhu atmosfere (TOA) za popolno snežno odejo, delno s snegom prekrit led/čist led in odprto vodo.

Fraction of valid LST values (used to ca.msgid: Fraction of valid LST values (used to calculate statistics) in the compositing period. In this context, a valid LST value corresponds to a clear-sky retrieval, after outlier removal.
msgstr: Delež veljavnih vrednosti LST (uporabljenih za izračun statistike) v kompozitnem obdobju. V tem kontekstu veljavna vrednost LST ustreza pridobitvi pri jasnem nebu po odstranitvi osamelcev.

The aim of 10-day Land Surface Temperatu.msgid: The aim of 10-day Land Surface Temperature (LST) product is to provide a complete overview of the LST daily cycle over each 10-day compositing for every image pixel. This layer represents the maximum LST values retrieved during the 10-days composite period.
msgstr: Cilj 10-dnevnega izdelka temperature zemeljskega površja (LST) je zagotoviti popolen pregled dnevnega cikla LST za vsako 10-dnevno kompozitno obdobje za vsako slikovno piko. Ta sloj predstavlja največje vrednosti LST, pridobljene v 10-dnevnem kompozitnem obdobju.

The aim of 10-day Land Surface Temperatu.msgid: The aim of 10-day Land Surface Temperature (LST) product is to provide a complete overview of the LST daily cycle over each 10-day compositing for every image pixel. This layer represents the median LST values retrieved during the 10-days composite period.
msgstr: Cilj 10-dnevnega izdelka temperature zemeljskega površja (LST) je zagotoviti popolen pregled dnevnega cikla LST za vsako 10-dnevno kompozitno obdobje za vsako slikovno piko. Ta sloj predstavlja mediane vrednosti LST, pridobljene v 10-dnevnem kompozitnem obdobju.

The aim of 10-day Land Surface Temperatu.msgid: The aim of 10-day Land Surface Temperature (LST) product is to provide a complete overview of the LST daily cycle over each 10-day compositing for every image pixel. msgstr: Cilj 10-dnevnega izdelka temperature zemeljskega površja (LST) je zagotoviti popolen pregled dnevnega cikla LST za vsako 10-dnevno kompozitno obdobje za vsako slikovno piko. Ta sloj predstavlja najmanjše vrednosti LST, pridobljene v 10-dnevnem kompozitnem obdobju.

Geographical information on land cover a.msgid: Geographical information on land cover and its changes, land use, ground motion, vegetation state, water cycle and earth surface energy variables for both Europe and the entire globe. Visit the [CLMS website](https://land.copernicus.eu/en) for more information.
msgstr: Geografske informacije o pokrovnosti tal in njenih spremembah, rabi tal, premikanju tal, stanju vegetacije, vodnem krogu in energijskih spremenljivkah zemeljskega površja za Evropo in celoten svet. Za več informacij obiščite [spletno mesto CLMS](https://land.copernicus.eu/en).

Provides at global level spatial informa.msgid: Provides at global level spatial information on different types (classes) of physical coverage of the Earth's surface, e.g. forests, grasslands, croplands, lakes, wetlands for the 2019 base year. The data are updated annually and are available for the 2015-2019 years. More information [here](https://land.copernicus.eu/en/products/global-dynamic-land-cover).
msgstr: Zagotavlja globalne prostorske informacije o različnih vrstah (razredih) fizične pokritosti zemeljskega površja, npr. gozdovi, travniki, obdelovalna zemljišča, jezera, mokrišča za izhodiščno leto 2019. Podatki se posodabljajo letno in so na voljo za leta 2015–2019. Več informacij [tukaj](https://land.copernicus.eu/en/products/global-dynamic-land-cover).

Provides a statistical overview of the l.msgid: Provides a statistical overview of the land surface temperature over each 10-day compositing period regardless of any specific hour and every geostationary sensor image pixel. The data are available at global scale in the spatial resolution of about 5 km and covers the period from January 2017 to January 2021. More information [here](https://land.copernicus.eu/en/products/temperature-and-reflectance/10-daily-land-surface-temperature-thermal-condition-index-global-v1-0-5km).
msgstr: Zagotavlja statistični pregled temperature zemeljskega površja za vsako 10-dnevno kompozitno obdobje, ne glede na določeno uro, in za vsako slikovno piko slike geostacionarnega senzorja. Podatki so na voljo na globalni ravni s prostorsko ločljivostjo približno 5 km in pokrivajo obdobje od januarja 2017 do januarja 2021. Več informacij [tukaj](https://land.copernicus.eu/en/products/temperature-and-reflectance/10-daily-land-surface-temperature-thermal-condition-index-global-v1-0-5km).

Provides a statistical overview of the l.msgid: Provides a statistical overview of the land surface temperature daily cycle for each 10-day compositing period and every geostationary sensor image pixel. The data are available at global scale in the spatial resolution of about 5 km and covers the period from January 2017 to January 2021. More information [here](https://land.copernicus.eu/en/products/temperature-and-reflectance/10-daily-land-surface-temperature-daily-cycle-global-v1-0-5km).
msgstr: Zagotavlja statistični pregled dnevnega cikla temperature zemeljskega površja za vsako 10-dnevno kompozitno obdobje in za vsako slikovno piko slike geostacionarnega senzorja. Podatki so na voljo na globalni ravni s prostorsko ločljivostjo približno 5 km in pokrivajo obdobje od januarja 2017 do januarja 2021. Več informacij [tukaj](https://land.copernicus.eu/en/products/temperature-and-reflectance/10-daily-land-surface-temperature-daily-cycle-global-v1-0-5km).

Quantifies the fraction of the solar rad.msgid: Quantifies the fraction of the solar radiation absorbed by live plants for photosynthesis. Every 10-days estimates are available at global scale in the spatial resolution of about 1 km covering the period from 1999 to June 2020 from SPOT/VEGETATION and PROBA-V data. More information [here](https://land.copernicus.eu/en/products/vegetation/fraction-of-absorbed-photosynthetically-active-radiation-v2-0-1km).
msgstr: Kvantificira delež sončnega sevanja, ki ga žive rastline absorbirajo za fotosintezo. Ocene vsakih 10 dni so na voljo na globalni ravni s prostorsko ločljivostjo približno 1 km in pokrivajo obdobje od 1999 do junija 2020 iz podatkov SPOT/VEGETATION in PROBA-V. Več informacij [tukaj](https://land.copernicus.eu/en/products/vegetation/fraction-of-absorbed-photosynthetically-active-radiation-v2-0-1km).

Quantifies the fraction of the solar rad.msgid: Quantifies the fraction of the solar radiation absorbed by live plants for photosynthesis. Every 10-days estimates are available in near real time at global scale in the spatial resolution of about 300 m from January 2014 to June 2020 based upon PROBA-V data with version 1.0 and from July 2020 onwards based upon Sentinel-3/OLCI data with version 1.1. More information [here](https://land.copernicus.eu/en/products/vegetation/fraction-of-absorbed-photosynthetically-active-radiation-v1-0-300m).
msgstr: Kvantificira delež sončnega sevanja, ki ga žive rastline absorbirajo za fotosintezo. Ocene vsakih 10 dni so na voljo v skoraj realnem času na globalni ravni s prostorsko ločljivostjo približno 300 m od januarja 2014 do junija 2020 na podlagi podatkov PROBA-V z različico 1.0 in od julija 2020 naprej na podlagi podatkov Sentinel-3/OLCI z različico 1.1. Več informacij [tukaj](https://land.copernicus.eu/en/products/vegetation/fraction-of-absorbed-photosynthetically-active-radiation-v1-0-300m).

Defined as half the total area of green.msgid: Defined as half the total area of green elements of the canopy per unit horizontal ground area. Every 10-days estimates are available at global scale in the spatial resolution of about 1 km covering the period from 1999 to June 2020 from SPOT/VEGETATION and PROBA-V data. More information [here](https://land.copernicus.eu/en/products/vegetation/leaf-area-index-v2-0-1km).
msgstr: Opredeljen kot polovica skupne površine zelenih elementov krošenj na enoto vodoravne talne površine. Ocene vsakih 10 dni so na voljo na globalni ravni s prostorsko ločljivostjo približno 1 km in pokrivajo obdobje od 1999 do junija 2020 iz podatkov SPOT/VEGETATION in PROBA-V. Več informacij [tukaj](https://land.copernicus.eu/en/products/vegetation/leaf-area-index-v2-0-1km).

Represents the overall growth rate or dr.msgid: Represents the overall growth rate or dry biomass increase of the vegetation and is directly related to ecosystem Net Primary Production (NPP), however with units customized for agro-statistical purposes (kg/ha/day). Every 10-days estimates are available at global scale in the spatial resolution of about 1km and with the temporal extent from 1999 to June 2020. More information [here](https://land.copernicus.eu/en/products/vegetation/dry-matter-productivity-v2-0-1km).
msgstr: Predstavlja splošno stopnjo rasti oziroma prirastek suhe biomase vegetacije in je neposredno povezan z neto primarno produkcijo (NPP) ekosistema, vendar so enote prilagojene agrostatističnim namenom (kg/ha/dan). Ocene vsakih 10 dni so na voljo na globalni ravni s prostorsko ločljivostjo približno 1 km in s časovnim obsegom od 1999 do junija 2020. Več informacij [tukaj](https://land.copernicus.eu/en/products/vegetation/dry-matter-productivity-v2-0-1km).

Corresponds to the fraction of ground co.msgid: Corresponds to the fraction of ground covered by green vegetation. It quantifies the spatial extent of the vegetation. Every 10-days estimates are available at global scale in the spatial resolution of about 1 km covering the period from 1999 to June 2020 from SPOT/VEGETATION and PROBA-V data. More information [here](https://land.copernicus.eu/en/products/vegetation/fraction-of-green-vegetation-cover-v2-0-1km).
msgstr: Ustreza deležu tal, prekritih z zeleno vegetacijo. Kvantificira prostorski obseg vegetacije. Ocene vsakih 10 dni so na voljo na globalni ravni s prostorsko ločljivostjo približno 1 km in pokrivajo obdobje od 1999 do junija 2020 iz podatkov SPOT/VEGETATION in PROBA-V. Več informacij [tukaj](https://land.copernicus.eu/en/products/vegetation/fraction-of-green-vegetation-cover-v2-0-1km).

Provides information on the relative wat.msgid: Provides information on the relative water content of the top few centimeters soil, describing how wet or dry the soil is in its topmost layer, expressed in percent saturation. # Soil Adjusted Vegetation Index (SAVI)\.msgid:
# Soil Adjusted Vegetation Index (SAVI)

The Soil Adjusted Vegetation Index is similar to Normalized Difference Vegetation Index (NDVI) but is used in areas where vegetative cover is low (< 40%). The index is a transformation technique that minimizes soil brightness influences from spectral vegetation indices involving red and near-infrared (NIR) wavelengths. The index is helpful when analysing young crops, arid regions with sparse vegetation and exposed soil surfaces.





More info [here](https://custom-scripts.sentinel-hub.com/sentinel-2/savi/) and [here.](https://eos.com/blog/6-spectral-indexes-on-top-of-ndvi-to-make-your-vegetation-analysis-complete/)
msgstr:
# Vegetacijski indeks, prilagojen tlom (SAVI)

Vegetacijski indeks, prilagojen tlom, je podoben normaliziranemu diferenčnemu vegetacijskemu indeksu (NDVI), vendar se uporablja na območjih z majhno vegetacijsko odejo (< 40 %). Indeks je transformacijska tehnika, ki zmanjšuje vplive svetlosti tal pri spektralnih vegetacijskih indeksih z rdečimi in bližnjimi infrardečimi (NIR) valovnimi dolžinami. Indeks je koristen pri analizi mladih posevkov, sušnih območij z redko vegetacijo in izpostavljenih talnih površin.





Več informacij [tukaj](https://custom-scripts.sentinel-hub.com/sentinel-2/savi/) in [tukaj.](https://eos.com/blog/6-spectral-indexes-on-top-of-ndvi-to-make-your-vegetation-analysis-complete/)

# Normalised Difference Snow Index (NDSI.msgid:
# Normalised Difference Snow Index (NDSI)

The Sentinel-2 normalised difference snow index can be used to differentiate between cloud and snow cover as snow absorbs in the short-wave infrared light, but reflects the visible light, whereas cloud is generally reflective in both wavelengths. Snow cover is represented in bright vivid blue.



More info [here](https://custom-scripts.sentinel-hub.com/sentinel-2/ndsi/).
msgstr:
# Normalizirani diferencialni snežni indeks (NDSI)

Normalizirani diferencialni snežni indeks (Normalised Difference Snow Index, NDSI) Sentinel-2 se lahko uporablja za razlikovanje med oblakom in snežno odejo, saj sneg absorbira kratkovalovno infrardečo svetlobo, vendar odbija vidno svetlobo, medtem ko je oblak običajno odbijajoč v obeh valovnih dolžinah. Snežna odeja je prikazana s svetlo živo modro barvo.

Več informacij je [tukaj](https://custom-scripts.sentinel-hub.com/sentinel-2/ndsi/).

Surface soil moisture (SSM) retrieval fr.msgid: Surface soil moisture (SSM) retrieval from scatterometer data has certain limitations: it cannot be retrieved when the surface is frozen or covered by snow, dense vegetation, or water. Whereas dense vegetation and water are almost static factors, the freeze/thaw cycle is dynamic. The frozen state of the surface is recorded within the surface state flag (SSF), which is based on interpolated meteorological data.
msgstr: Pridobivanje vlažnosti površinskih tal (SSM) iz podatkov sipalnika ima določene omejitve: ni ga mogoče izvesti, kadar je površje zmrznjeno ali prekrito s snegom, gosto vegetacijo ali vodo. Medtem ko sta gosta vegetacija in voda skoraj statična dejavnika, je cikel zmrzovanja/odtajanja dinamičen. Zmrznjeno stanje površja je zabeleženo v zastavici stanja površja (SSF), ki temelji na interpoliranih meteoroloških podatkih.

Maps burn scars, surfaces which have bee.msgid: Maps burn scars, surfaces which have been sufficiently affected by fire to display significant changes in the vegetation cover (destruction of dry material, reduction or loss of green material) and in the ground surface (temporarily darker because of ash). Mesečni nabori podatkov so na voljo na globalni ravni s prostorsko ločljivostjo 300 m in z dvomesečnim zamikom. Pokrivajo obdobje od julija 2018 do danes. Več informacij _kmalu_.

Dnevni nabori podatkov so na voljo na globalni ravni s prostorsko ločljivostjo 300 m in v 24 urah po satelitskem zajemu. Pokrivajo obdobje od decembra 2024 do danes. Več informacij _kmalu_.

On daily basis for the Northern Europe c.msgid: On daily basis for the Northern Europe classifies, in pixels, inland/freshwater bodies as 1) Fully snow-covered ice, 2) Partially snow-covered or snow-free ice, 3) Open water. The data is available in near real time in the spatial resolution of 250 m and with the temporal extent from March 2017 to 30 June 2024. More information [here](https://land.copernicus.eu/en/products/water-bodies/lake-ice-extent-baltic-v1-250m).
msgstr: Vsak dan za severno Evropo razvršča slikovne pike celinskih/sladkovodnih teles v 1) led, popolnoma prekrit s snegom, 2) led, delno prekrit s snegom ali brez snega, 3) odprto vodo. Podatki so na voljo v skoraj realnem času s prostorsko ločljivostjo 250 m in s časovnim obsegom od marca 2017 do 30. junija 2024. Več informacij [tukaj](https://land.copernicus.eu/en/products/water-bodies/lake-ice-extent-baltic-v1-250m).

Provides hourly land surface temperature.msgid:
Provides hourly land surface temperature from geostationary sensors observations. The data are available at global scale in the spatial resolution of about 5 km and covers the period from July 2010 to January 2021. More information [here](https://land.copernicus.eu/en/products/temperature-and-reflectance/hourly-land-surface-temperature-global-v1-0-5km). 

*Please note that under default settings, the dataset displayed for each day is the latest image available, which typically reflects the data captured up to midnight. To access data from a specific hour, use the "Date: time range" mode.
msgstr:
Zagotavlja urno temperaturo zemeljskega površja iz opazovanj geostacionarnih senzorjev. Podatki so na voljo na globalni ravni s prostorsko ločljivostjo približno 5 km in pokrivajo obdobje od julija 2010 do januarja 2021. Več informacij [tukaj](https://land.copernicus.eu/en/products/temperature-and-reflectance/hourly-land-surface-temperature-global-v1-0-5km). 

*Upoštevajte, da je pri privzetih nastavitvah za vsak dan prikazan zadnji razpoložljivi posnetek, ki običajno odraža podatke, zajete do polnoči. Za dostop do podatkov za določeno uro uporabite način »Datum: časovni obseg«.

Provides at global scale and for Europe.msgid: Provides at global scale and for Europe information on vegetation phenology and productivity gathering 13 parameters for two growing seasons. The Lake Ice Coverage (LIE) is monitored.msgid: The Lake Ice Coverage (LIE) is monitored using optical satellite data and it classifies a section of the freshwater body as 1) Fully snow covered ice; 2) Partially snow covered ice/clear ice; 3) Open water. Classification is provided only for cloud free pixels, with dedicated cloud mask. The gridded data product covers Northern-Europe with 250m (0.0025 degree) resolution. The LIE product can have several important applications from climate change monitoring and hydrological forecasting to winter transport and recreational activity on lakes.
msgstr: Obseg ledu na jezerih (LIE) se spremlja z optičnimi satelitskimi podatki in razvršča del sladkovodnega telesa v 1) led, popolnoma prekrit s snegom; 2) led, delno prekrit s snegom/čist led; 3) odprto vodo. Klasifikacija je podana samo za slikovne pike brez oblakov, z namensko masko oblakov. Mrežni podatkovni izdelek pokriva severno Evropo z ločljivostjo 250 m (0,0025 stopinje). Izdelek LIE ima lahko več pomembnih uporab, od spremljanja podnebnih sprememb in hidrološkega napovedovanja do zimskega prometa in rekreacijskih dejavnosti na jezerih.

Provides actual evapotranspiration, soil.msgid: Provides actual evapotranspiration, soil evaporation and canopy transpiration with some quality indicators. Estimates are provided for two evapotranspiration schemes and an Ensemble of models. Every 10-days estimate are available in near real time at global scale in the spatial resolution of about 300 m from November 2025 onwards in version 1.0. More information [here](https://land.copernicus.eu/en/products/evapotranspiration/evapotranspiration-2025-present-raster-300m-global-10-daily-version-1).
msgstr: Zagotavlja dejansko evapotranspiracijo, izhlapevanje iz tal in transpiracijo vegetacijskega pokrova z nekaterimi kazalniki kakovosti. Ocene so na voljo za dve shemi evapotranspiracije in za ansambel modelov. Desetdnevne ocene so skoraj v realnem času na voljo v globalnem merilu s prostorsko ločljivostjo približno 300 m od novembra 2025 naprej v različici 1.0. Več informacij [tukaj](https://land.copernicus.eu/en/products/evapotranspiration/evapotranspiration-2025-present-raster-300m-global-10-daily-version-1).

Provides latent and sensible heat fluxes.msgid: Provides latent and sensible heat fluxes with one auxiliary information. Estimates are provided for each Sentinel-3 overpass in near real time at global scale in the spatial resolution of about 300 m from November 2025 onwards in version 1.0. More information [here](https://land.copernicus.eu/en/products/evapotranspiration/heat-flux-2025-present-raster-300-m-global-daily-version-1).
msgstr: Zagotavlja tokova latentne in občutene toplote z eno pomožno informacijo. Več informacij [tukaj](https://land.copernicus.eu/en/products/evapotranspiration/heat-flux-2025-present-raster-300-m-global-daily-version-1).

Provides daily updates on the moisture c.msgid: Provides daily updates on the moisture conditions in different soil layers. The data are available over the globe at the spatial resolution of 0.1° and with the temporal extent from 2007 to present. More information [here](https://land.copernicus.eu/en/products/soil-moisture/daily-soil-water-index-global-12-5km).
msgstr: Zagotavlja dnevne posodobitve o vlažnosti v različnih plasteh tal. Podatki so na voljo za celoten svet s prostorsko ločljivostjo 0,1° in za obdobje od leta 2007 do danes. Več informacij [tukaj](https://land.copernicus.eu/en/products/soil-moisture/daily-soil-water-index-global-12-5km).

This is a simple RGB composite with NIR.msgid: This is a simple RGB composite with NIR band B04 in the red channel, red band B03 in the green channel and green band B02 in the blue channel. The script is useful for plant density and health monitoring, as vegetation (displayed in red) heavily reflects NIR light while absorbing red. The band 4 also penetrates atmospheric haze, and distinguishes between land and water. Cities and exposed ground are grey or tan, and water appears blue or black.
msgstr: To je preprost kompozit RGB s kanalom NIR B04 v rdečem kanalu, rdečim kanalom B03 v zelenem kanalu in zelenim kanalom B02 v modrem kanalu. Skript je uporaben za spremljanje gostote in zdravja rastlin, saj vegetacija (prikazana rdeče) močno odbija svetlobo NIR, rdečo pa vpija. Kanal 4 prodira tudi skozi atmosfersko meglico in razlikuje med kopnim in vodo. Mesta in izpostavljena tla so siva ali rjavkasta, voda pa je videti modra ali črna.

The NDMI is a normalised difference mois.msgid: The NDMI is a normalised difference moisture index, that uses NIR and SWIR bands to display moisture. The SWIR band reflects changes in both the vegetation water content and the spongy mesophyll structure in vegetation canopies, while the NIR reflectance is affected by leaf internal structure and leaf dry matter content but not by water content. The combination of the NIR with the SWIR removes variations induced by leaf internal structure and leaf dry matter content, improving the accuracy in retrieving the vegetation water content. The amount of water available in the internal leaf structure largely controls the spectral reflectance in the SWIR interval of the electromagnetic spectrum. SWIR reflectance is therefore negatively related to leaf water content.
msgstr: NDMI je normaliziran diferenčni indeks vlažnosti, ki za prikaz vlažnosti uporablja kanala NIR in SWIR. Kanal SWIR odraža spremembe vsebnosti vode v vegetaciji in gobastega mezofila v krošnjah, odbojnost v NIR pa je odvisna od notranje zgradbe listov in vsebnosti suhe snovi v listih, ne pa od vsebnosti vode. Kombinacija NIR in SWIR odstrani spremembe, ki jih povzročata notranja zgradba listov in vsebnost suhe snovi, kar izboljša natančnost ocene vsebnosti vode v vegetaciji. Količina vode v notranji zgradbi lista v veliki meri nadzoruje spektralno odbojnost v območju SWIR elektromagnetnega spektra. Odbojnost v SWIR je zato negativno povezana z vsebnostjo vode v listih.

The Landsat normalized difference snow i.msgid: The Landsat normalized difference snow index is a ratio of two bands: the Green band (B02) and the SWIR Band (B05). Values above 0.42 are usually snow. NDSI can be used to differentiate between cloud and snow cover as snow absorbs in the short-wave infrared light, but reflects the visible light, whereas cloud is generally reflective in both wavelengths. In the visualisation script snow cover is represented in bright vivid blue.
msgstr: Normaliziran diferenčni indeks snega Landsat je razmerje med dvema kanaloma: zelenim kanalom (B02) in kanalom SWIR (B05). Vrednosti nad 0,42 običajno pomenijo sneg. NDSI se lahko uporablja za razlikovanje med oblaki in snežno odejo, saj sneg vpija kratkovalovno infrardečo svetlobo, vidno svetlobo pa odbija, oblaki pa so na splošno odbojni v obeh valovnih dolžinah. V vizualizacijski skripti je snežna odeja prikazana v svetli živo modri barvi.

The normalised difference vegetation ind.msgid: The normalised difference vegetation index is a simple, but effective index for quantifying green vegetation. It is a measure of the state of vegetation health based on how plants reflect light at certain wavelengths. The value range of the NDVI is -1 to 1. Negative values of NDVI (values approaching -1) correspond to water. Values close to zero (-0.1 to 0.1) generally correspond to barren areas of rock, sand, or snow. Low, positive values represent shrub and grassland (approximately 0.2 to 0.4), while high values indicate temperate and tropical rainforests (values approaching 1).
msgstr: Normaliziran diferenčni vegetacijski indeks je preprost, a učinkovit indeks za kvantifikacijo zelene vegetacije. Je merilo zdravstvenega stanja vegetacije, ki temelji na tem, kako rastline odbijajo svetlobo pri določenih valovnih dolžinah. Razpon vrednosti NDVI je od -1 do 1. Negativne vrednosti NDVI (vrednosti, ki se bližajo -1) ustrezajo vodi. Vrednosti blizu nič (od -0,1 do 0,1) običajno ustrezajo nerodovitnim območjem skal, peska ali snega. Nizke pozitivne vrednosti predstavljajo grmičevje in travinje (približno od 0,2 do 0,4), visoke vrednosti pa kažejo na zmerne in tropske deževne gozdove (vrednosti, ki se bližajo 1).

The NDWI is used to monitor changes rela.msgid: The NDWI is used to monitor changes related to water content in water bodies. As water bodies strongly absorb light in visible to infrared electromagnetic spectrum, NDWI uses green and near infrared bands to highlight water bodies. It is sensitive to built-up land and can result in over-estimation of water bodies.
msgstr: NDWI se uporablja za spremljanje sprememb, povezanih z vsebnostjo vode v vodnih telesih. Ker vodna telesa močno vpijajo svetlobo od vidnega do infrardečega dela elektromagnetnega spektra, NDWI za poudarjanje vodnih teles uporablja zeleni in bližnji infrardeči kanal. Je občutljiv na pozidana zemljišča, zato lahko povzroči preveliko oceno vodnih teles.

Short wave infrared (SWIR) measurements.msgid: Short wave infrared (SWIR) measurements can help scientists estimate how much water is present in plants and soil, as water absorbs SWIR wavelengths. Short wave infrared bands (a band is a region of the electromagnetic spectrum; a satellite sensor can image Earth in different bands) are also useful for distinguishing between cloud types (water clouds versus ice clouds), snow and ice, all of which appear white in visible light. In this composite vegetation appears in shades of green, soils and built-up areas are in various shades of brown, and water appears black. Newly burned land reflects strongly in SWIR bands, making them valuable for mapping fire damages. Each rock type reflects shortwave infrared light differently, making it possible to map out geology by comparing reflected SWIR light.
msgstr: Meritve v kratkovalovni infrardeči svetlobi (SWIR) znanstvenikom pomagajo oceniti, koliko vode je v rastlinah in tleh, saj voda vpija valovne dolžine SWIR. Kratkovalovni infrardeči kanali (kanal je območje elektromagnetnega spektra; satelitski senzor lahko Zemljo posname v različnih kanalih) so uporabni tudi za razlikovanje med vrstami oblakov (vodni oblaki in ledeni oblaki), snegom in ledom, ki so v vidni svetlobi vsi beli. V tem kompozitu je vegetacija prikazana v odtenkih zelene, tla in pozidana območja so v različnih odtenkih rjave, voda pa je črna. Na novo požgana zemlja močno odbija v kanalih SWIR, zato so ti dragoceni za kartiranje požarne škode. Vsaka vrsta kamnine različno odbija kratkovalovno infrardečo svetlobo, kar omogoča kartiranje geologije s primerjavo odbite svetlobe SWIR.

The true colour product maps Landsat bi-.msgid: The true colour product maps Landsat bi-monthly mosaic band values B03, B02, and B01 which roughly correspond to red, green, and blue part of the spectrum, respectively, to R, G, and B components. The result is a true colour product, that is a good representation of the Earth as humans would see it naturally.
msgstr: Izdelek v pravih barvah preslika vrednosti kanalov B03, B02 in B01 dvomesečnega mozaika Landsat, ki približno ustrezajo rdečemu, zelenemu in modremu delu spektra, v komponente R, G in B. Rezultat je izdelek v pravih barvah, ki dobro predstavlja Zemljo, kot bi jo ljudje videli naravno.

Global, cloud-free, and reconstructed hi.msgid: Global, cloud-free, and reconstructed historical Landsat spectral bands are provided at a spatial resolution of 30 meters and temporal resolution of bimonthly intervals from 1997 onwards. The dataset was generated using the GLAD Landsat ARD version 2 as the primary input for temporal aggregation and the imputation of missing values.
msgstr: Globalni, brezoblačni in rekonstruirani zgodovinski spektralni kanali Landsat so na voljo s prostorsko ločljivostjo 30 metrov in časovno ločljivostjo dvomesečnih intervalov od leta 1997 naprej. Zbirka podatkov je bila ustvarjena z uporabo GLAD Landsat ARD različice 2 kot glavnega vhodnega podatka za časovno združevanje in imputacijo manjkajočih vrednosti.

# Thermal band 10\n\nThis thermal visual.msgid:
# Thermal band 10

This thermal visualization is based on band 10 (a band is a region of the electromagnetic spectrum; a satellite sensor can image Earth in different bands). At the central wavelength of 10895 nm it measures in the thermal infrared, or TIR. Instead of measuring the temperature of the air, like weather stations do, band 10 reports on the ground itself, which is often much hotter. Thermal band 10 is useful in providing surface temperatures and is collected with a 100-meter resolution.



More info [here](https://www.usgs.gov/faqs/what-are-band-designations-landsat-satellites?qt-news_science_products=0#qt-news_science_products).
msgstr:
# Termalni kanal 10

Ta termalna vizualizacija temelji na kanalu 10 (kanal je območje elektromagnetnega spektra; satelitski senzor lahko Zemljo posname v različnih kanalih). Pri osrednji valovni dolžini 10895 nm meri v termalnem infrardečem območju (TIR). Namesto temperature zraka, kot to počnejo vremenske postaje, kanal 10 poroča o samih tleh, ki so pogosto precej bolj vroča. Termalni kanal 10 je uporaben za pridobivanje površinskih temperatur in se zajema z ločljivostjo 100 metrov.



Več informacij [tukaj](https://www.usgs.gov/faqs/what-are-band-designations-landsat-satellites?qt-news_science_products=0#qt-news_science_products).

# True color composite\n\nSensors carrie.msgid:
# True color composite

Sensors carried by satellites can image Earth in different regions of the electromagnetic spectrum. Each region in the spectrum is referred to as a band. Landsat 8-9 has 11 bands. True color composite uses visible light bands red, green and blue in the corresponding red, green and blue color channels, resulting in a natural colored product, that is a good representation of the Earth as humans would see it naturally.



More info [here](https://custom-scripts.sentinel-hub.com/landsat-8/composites/).
msgstr:
# Kompozit v pravih barvah

Senzorji na satelitih lahko Zemljo posnamejo v različnih območjih elektromagnetnega spektra. Vsako območje spektra imenujemo kanal. Landsat 8-9 ima 11 kanalov. Kompozit v pravih barvah uporablja kanale vidne svetlobe, rdečega, zelenega in modrega, v ustreznih rdečem, zelenem in modrem barvnem kanalu, kar daje naravno obarvan izdelek, ki dobro predstavlja Zemljo, kot bi jo ljudje videli naravno.



Več informacij [tukaj](https://custom-scripts.sentinel-hub.com/landsat-8/composites/).

# Pansharpened True Color\n\nThe panshar.msgid:
# Pansharpened True Color

The pansharpened true color composite is done by using the usual true color data (red, green and blue (RGB)) and enhancing them by using the panchromatic band 8, or pan band (a band is a region of the electromagnetic spectrum; a satellite sensor can image Earth in different bands). An image from the pan band is similar to black-and-white film: it combines light from the red, green, and blue parts of the spectrum into a single measure of overall visible reflectance. Pansharpened images have 4x the resolution of the usual true color composite, greatly enhancing the usefulness of Landsat imagery.



More info [here](https://blog.mapbox.com/pansharpening-for-higher-resolution-in-landsat-live-e4717cd7c356).
msgstr:
# Poostrene prave barve (pansharpened)

Kompozit v poostrenih pravih barvah nastane z uporabo običajnih podatkov v pravih barvah (rdeča, zelena in modra (RGB)), ki jih izboljšamo s pankromatskim kanalom 8 oziroma pan kanalom (kanal je območje elektromagnetnega spektra; satelitski senzor lahko Zemljo posname v različnih kanalih). Posnetek iz pan kanala je podoben črno-belemu filmu: združuje svetlobo iz rdečega, zelenega in modrega dela spektra v eno samo mero celotne vidne odbojnosti. Poostreni posnetki imajo 4-krat večjo ločljivost kot običajni kompozit v pravih barvah, kar močno poveča uporabnost posnetkov Landsat.



Več informacij [tukaj](https://blog.mapbox.com/pansharpening-for-higher-resolution-in-landsat-live-e4717cd7c356).

# Normalised Difference Snow Index (NDSI.msgid:
# Normalised Difference Snow Index (NDSI)

The normalised difference snow index (NDSI) can be used to differentiate between cloud and snow cover as snow absorbs in the short-wave infrared light, but reflects the visible light, whereas cloud is generally reflective in both wavelengths. Snow cover is represented in bright vivid blue.



More info [here](https://custom-scripts.sentinel-hub.com/sentinel-2/ndsi/).
msgstr:
# Normaliziran diferenčni indeks snega (NDSI)

Normaliziran diferenčni indeks snega (NDSI) se lahko uporablja za razlikovanje med oblaki in snežno odejo, saj sneg vpija kratkovalovno infrardečo svetlobo, vidno svetlobo pa odbija, oblaki pa so na splošno odbojni v obeh valovnih dolžinah. Snežna odeja je prikazana v svetli živo modri barvi.



Več informacij [tukaj](https://custom-scripts.sentinel-hub.com/sentinel-2/ndsi/).

The **Landsat 8-9** collection contains.msgid:
The **Landsat 8-9** collection contains imagery from the two most recently launched Landsat satellites (Landsat 8 and Landsat 9, provided by NASA/USGS). Both carry the Operational Land Imager (OLI) and the Thermal Infrared Sensor (TIRS), with 9 optical and 2 thermal bands. These two sensors provide seasonal coverage of the global landmass.

**Spatial resolution:** 15 m for the panchromatic band and 30 m for the rest (the thermal bands are re-sampled from 100 m).

**Revisit time:** 16 days

**Data availability:** Since January 2021

**Common usage:** Vegetation monitoring, land use, land cover maps, change monitoring, etc.

**Level-1** data (from **Landsat Collection 2**) provides global top of the atmosphere reflectance and top of the atmosphere brightness temperature products. 
  
The data underwent several processing steps including geometric and radiometric improvements. 
  
More info about Level-1 data [here](https://documentation.dataspace.copernicus.eu/APIs/SentinelHub/Data/Landsat8-9.html).
msgstr:
Zbirka **Landsat 8-9** vsebuje posnetke dveh nazadnje izstreljenih satelitov Landsat (Landsat 8 in Landsat 9, ki ju zagotavljata NASA/USGS). Oba nosita optični senzor OLI (Operational Land Imager) in termalni infrardeči senzor TIRS (Thermal Infrared Sensor) z 9 optičnimi in 2 termalnima kanaloma. Ta dva senzorja zagotavljata sezonsko pokritost globalnega kopnega.

**Prostorska ločljivost:** 15 m za pankromatski kanal in 30 m za ostale (termalni kanali so prevzorčeni s 100 m).

**Čas ponovnega obiska:** 16 dni

**Razpoložljivost podatkov:** Od januarja 2021

**Običajna uporaba:** Spremljanje vegetacije, raba tal, karte pokrovnosti tal, spremljanje sprememb itd.

Podatki **Level-1** (iz **Landsat Collection 2**) zagotavljajo globalne izdelke odbojnosti na vrhu atmosfere in svetlostne temperature na vrhu atmosfere. 
  
Podatki so bili obdelani v več korakih, vključno z geometričnimi in radiometričnimi izboljšavami. 
  
Več informacij o podatkih Level-1 [tukaj](https://documentation.dataspace.copernicus.eu/APIs/SentinelHub/Data/Landsat8-9.html).

Desetdnevna opazovanja so na voljo skoraj v realnem času s prostorsko ločljivostjo 100 m od septembra 2024 do danes. Več informacij [tukaj](https://land.copernicus.eu/en/products/water-bodies/lake-water-quality-v2-0-100m).

msgstr: Dolžina polobdobja po dekadnem datumu okna sestavljanja [dnevi].

LAI (Leaf Area Index) is defined as half.msgid: LAI (Leaf Area Index) is defined as half the total area of green elements of the canopy per unit horizontal ground area. It is expressed in m²/m².
msgstr: LAI (indeks listne površine) je definiran kot polovica skupne površine zelenih elementov krošnje na enoto vodoravne talne površine. Izražen je v m²/m².

Length of the semi-period before the dek.msgid: Length of the semi-period before the dekadal date of the compositing window [days].

FAPAR represents the fraction of photosy.msgid: FAPAR represents the fraction of photosynthetically active radiation [0.4-0.7 μm] that is absorbed by vegetation. FAPAR is defined as instantaneous at 10:00 local time.
msgstr: FAPAR predstavlja delež fotosintetsko aktivnega sevanja [0,4-0,7 μm], ki ga vegetacija vpije. FAPAR je definiran kot trenutna vrednost ob 10:00 po lokalnem času.

msgstr: RMSE je izračunan med končno dekadno vrednostjo FAPAR in razpoložljivimi veljavnimi trenutnimi vrednostmi v oknu sestavljanja.

Provides information about Leaf Area Ind.msgid: Provides information about Leaf Area Index, defined as half the total area of green elements of the canopy per unit horizontal ground area. Desetdnevne ocene so na voljo v globalnem merilu s prostorsko ločljivostjo ~300 m od januarja 2014 do danes. Več informacij [tukaj](https://land.copernicus.eu/en/products/vegetation/leaf-area-index-v2-0-300m).

Quantifies the fraction of the solar rad.msgid: Quantifies the fraction of the solar radiation absorbed by live plants for photosynthesis. Every 10-days estimates are available at global scale, in the spatial resolution of ~ 300 m, from January 2014 to the present. More information [here](https://land.copernicus.eu/en/products/vegetation/fraction-of-absorbed-photosynthetically-active-radiation-v2-0-300m).
msgstr: Kvantificira delež sončnega sevanja, ki ga žive rastline vpijejo za fotosintezo. Desetdnevne ocene so na voljo v globalnem merilu s prostorsko ločljivostjo ~300 m od januarja 2014 do danes. Več informacij [tukaj](https://land.copernicus.eu/en/products/vegetation/fraction-of-absorbed-photosynthetically-active-radiation-v2-0-300m).

FCOVER is defined as the fraction of gro.msgid: FCOVER is defined as the fraction of ground surface covered by green vegetation as seen from the nadir direction.
msgstr: FCOVER je definiran kot delež talne površine, ki jo prekriva zelena vegetacija, gledano iz smeri nadirja.

RMSE is computed between the final dekad.msgid: RMSE is computed between the final dekadal FCOVER value and the available valid instantaneous values in the compositing window.
msgstr: RMSE je izračunan med končno dekadno vrednostjo FCOVER in razpoložljivimi veljavnimi trenutnimi vrednostmi v oknu sestavljanja.

Number of available valid instantaneous.msgid: Number of available valid instantaneous FCOVER values in the compositing window.
msgstr: Število razpoložljivih veljavnih trenutnih vrednosti FCOVER v oknu sestavljanja.

Provides information of the fraction of.msgid: Provides information of the fraction of ground covered by green vegetation. Every 10-days estimates are available at global scale in the spatial resolution of ~ 300 m from January 2014 to the present. More information [here](https://land.copernicus.eu/en/products/vegetation/fraction-of-green-vegetation-cover-v2-0-300m).
msgstr: Zagotavlja informacije o deležu tal, ki ga prekriva zelena vegetacija. Desetdnevne ocene so na voljo v globalnem merilu s prostorsko ločljivostjo ~300 m od januarja 2014 do danes. Več informacij [tukaj](https://land.copernicus.eu/en/products/vegetation/fraction-of-green-vegetation-cover-v2-0-300m).

The Snow Cover Extent (SCE) product is g.msgid: The Snow Cover Extent (SCE) product is generated daily in near-real time for the global land areas, excluding Antarctica, based on medium resolution optical satellite data. The snow maps are generated from Sentinel-3 SLSTR data and in parallel from NOAA-20 VIIRS data to assure service continuity in case one satellite or sensor fails. The global SCE product provides information on the Fraction of Snow Cover (FSC) on ground (also in forested areas) per pixel in percentage (0% – 100%) and is extending from 90°N/180°W to 90°S/180°E with a pixel size of 0.01° x 0.01° (approx. 1 km x 1 km). The product is provided within 1 day after the last raw image acquisition per date.
msgstr: Izdelek Snow Cover Extent (SCE) se ustvarja dnevno skoraj v realnem času za globalna kopenska območja, razen Antarktike, na podlagi optičnih satelitskih podatkov srednje ločljivosti. Snežni zemljevidi se ustvarjajo iz podatkov Sentinel-3 SLSTR in vzporedno iz podatkov NOAA-20 VIIRS, da se zagotovi neprekinjenost storitve v primeru odpovedi enega satelita ali senzorja. Globalni izdelek SCE zagotavlja informacije o deležu snežne odeje (FSC) na tleh (tudi v gozdnatih območjih) na piksel v odstotkih (0 % – 100 %) in sega od 90°N/180°W do 90°S/180°E z velikostjo piksla 0,01° x 0,01° (približno 1 km x 1 km). Izdelek je na voljo v 1 dnevu po zadnjem zajemu surovega posnetka za posamezen datum.

Snow Cover Extent Uncertainty, provided.msgid: Snow Cover Extent Uncertainty, provided as unbiased Root Mean Square Error
msgstr: Negotovost obsega snežne odeje, podana kot nepristranska kvadratna sredina napake (RMSE)

Provides for global land areas (excludin.msgid: Provides for global land areas (excluding Antarctica) daily maps of the fraction of snow cover on ground (also in forested areas) per pixel in percentage (0% – 100%). The data is available in near real time with a pixel spacing of about 1 km and with the temporal extent from December 2025 to present. More information [here](https://land.copernicus.eu/en/products/snow/snow-cover-global-v1-0-1km).
msgstr: Zagotavlja dnevne zemljevide deleža snežne odeje na tleh (tudi v gozdnatih območjih) na piksel v odstotkih (0 % – 100 %) za globalna kopenska območja (razen Antarktike). Podatki so na voljo skoraj v realnem času z razmikom pikslov približno 1 km za obdobje od decembra 2025 do danes. Več informacij [tukaj](https://land.copernicus.eu/en/products/snow/snow-cover-global-v1-0-1km).

Dry Matter Productivity is defined as th.msgid: Dry Matter Productivity is defined as the overall growth rate, or dry biomass increase, of the vegetation. It is expressed in kg of Dry Matter per hectare and per day (kg DM/ha/day).
msgstr: Produktivnost suhe snovi je definirana kot celotna stopnja rasti oziroma prirastek suhe biomase vegetacije. Izražena je v kg suhe snovi na hektar na dan (kg DM/ha/dan).

GPP is defined as the total amount of ca.msgid: GPP is defined as the total amount of carbon compounds produced by photosynthesis of plants in an ecosystem in a given period of time, expressed in gC/m²/day.
msgstr: GPP je definiran kot skupna količina ogljikovih spojin, ki jih v danem časovnem obdobju s fotosintezo proizvedejo rastline v ekosistemu, izražena v gC/m²/dan.

NPP is defined as the net amount of biom.msgid: NPP is defined as the net amount of biomass, or carbon, produced by plants per unit area and time, expressed in gC/m²/day.
msgstr: NPP je definiran kot neto količina biomase oziroma ogljika, ki jo rastline proizvedejo na enoto površine in časa, izražena v gC/m²/dan.

GDMP represents the total amount of dry.msgid: GDMP represents the total amount of dry matter produced by land plants per unit time through photosynthesis. It is expressed in kg of Dry Matter per hectare and per day (kg DM/ha/day).
msgstr: GDMP predstavlja skupno količino suhe snovi, ki jo kopenske rastline proizvedejo na enoto časa s fotosintezo. Izražen je v kg suhe snovi na hektar na dan (kg DM/ha/dan).

Provides information about the overall g.msgid: Provides information about the overall growth rate, or net dry biomass increase, of the vegetation. It is equivalent to Net Primary Production (NPP) but expressed in kg of dry matter per hectare and per day. Every 10-days, estimates are available at global scale, at a spatial resolution of ~300 m, from January 2014 to the present. More information [here](https://land.copernicus.eu/en/products/vegetation/dry-matter-productivity-v2-0-300m).
msgstr: Zagotavlja informacije o celotni stopnji rasti oziroma neto prirastku suhe biomase vegetacije. Je enakovreden neto primarni produkciji (NPP), vendar izražen v kg suhe snovi na hektar na dan. Desetdnevne ocene so na voljo v globalnem merilu s prostorsko ločljivostjo ~300 m od januarja 2014 do danes. Več informacij [tukaj](https://land.copernicus.eu/en/products/vegetation/dry-matter-productivity-v2-0-300m).

Provides information about the total amo.msgid: Provides information about the total amount of carbon compounds produced by photosynthesis of plants in an ecosystem in a given period of time, expressed in gC/m²/day. Every 10-days, estimates are available at global scale, at a spatial resolution of ~ 300 m, from January 2014 to the present. More information [here](https://land.copernicus.eu/en/products/vegetation/gross-primary-production-v2-0-300m).
msgstr: Zagotavlja informacije o skupni količini ogljikovih spojin, ki jih v danem časovnem obdobju s fotosintezo proizvedejo rastline v ekosistemu, izražene v gC/m²/dan. Desetdnevne ocene so na voljo v globalnem merilu s prostorsko ločljivostjo ~300 m od januarja 2014 do danes. Več informacij [tukaj](https://land.copernicus.eu/en/products/vegetation/gross-primary-production-v2-0-300m).

Provides information about the net amoun.msgid: Provides information about the net amount of biomass, or carbon, produced by plants per unit area and time, expressed in gC/m²/day. It is equal to the difference between the Gross Primary Production (GPP), i.e. the total amount of carbon produced through photosynthesis, and the amount of energy used for plant respiration. Every 10-days, estimates are available at global scale, at a spatial resolution of ~ 300 m, from January 2014 to the present. More information [here](https://land.copernicus.eu/en/products/vegetation/net-primary-production-v2-0-300m).
msgstr: Zagotavlja informacije o neto količini biomase oziroma ogljika, ki jo rastline proizvedejo na enoto površine in časa, izraženi v gC/m²/dan. Enaka je razliki med bruto primarno produkcijo (GPP), tj. skupno količino ogljika, proizvedenega s fotosintezo, in količino energije, porabljene za dihanje rastlin. Desetdnevne ocene so na voljo v globalnem merilu s prostorsko ločljivostjo ~300 m od januarja 2014 do danes. Več informacij [tukaj](https://land.copernicus.eu/en/products/vegetation/net-primary-production-v2-0-300m).

Provides information about the total amo.msgid: Provides information about the total amount of dry matter produced by land plants per unit time through photosynthesis. It is equivalent to Gross Primary Production (GPP) but expressed in kg of dry matter per hectare and per day. Every 10-days estimates are available at global scale, at a spatial resolution of ~ 300 m, from January 2014 to the present. More information [here](https://land.copernicus.eu/en/products/vegetation/gross-dry-matter-productivity-v2-0-300m).
msgstr: Zagotavlja informacije o skupni količini suhe snovi, ki jo kopenske rastline proizvedejo na enoto časa s fotosintezo. Je enakovredna bruto primarni produkciji (GPP), vendar izražena v kg suhe snovi na hektar na dan. Desetdnevne ocene so na voljo v globalnem merilu s prostorsko ločljivostjo ~300 m od januarja 2014 do danes. Več informacij [tukaj](https://land.copernicus.eu/en/products/vegetation/gross-dry-matter-productivity-v2-0-300m).

Season 1: provides the day of the year w.msgid: Season 1: provides the day of the year when the vegetation growing season ends in the time profile of the Plant Phenology Index. The end-of-season occurs, by definition, when the Plant Phenology Index value reaches 15% of the season amplitude during the green-down period. The data are available at 300 m spatial resolution with the temporal extent from 2023 to present.
msgstr: Sezona 1: podaja dan v letu, ko se v časovnem profilu indeksa fenologije rastlin konča vegetacijska rastna sezona. Konec sezone nastopi po definiciji, ko vrednost indeksa fenologije rastlin med obdobjem pojemanja zelenja doseže 15 % amplitude sezone. Podatki so na voljo s prostorsko ločljivostjo 300 m za obdobje od leta 2023 do danes.

Season 2: provides the day of the year w.msgid: Season 2: provides the day of the year when the vegetation growing season ends in the time profile of the Plant Phenology Index. The end-of-season occurs, by definition, when the Plant Phenology Index value reaches 15% of the season amplitude during the green-down period. The data are available at 300 m spatial resolution with the temporal extent from 2023 to present.

Konec sezone nastopi po definiciji, ko vrednost indeksa fenologije rastlin med obdobjem pojemanja zelenja doseže 15 % amplitude sezone. Podatki so na voljo s prostorsko ločljivostjo 300 m za obdobje od leta 2023 do danes.

Season 1: provides the day of the year i.msgid: Season 1: provides the day of the year in the vegetation growing season when the maximum Plant Phenology Index value is reached. The data are available at 300 m spatial resolution with the temporal extent from 2023 to present.
msgstr: Sezona 1: podaja dan v letu v vegetacijski rastni sezoni, ko je dosežena največja vrednost indeksa fenologije rastlin. Podatki so na voljo s prostorsko ločljivostjo 300 m za obdobje od leta 2023 do danes.

Season 2: provides the day of the year i.msgid: Season 2: provides the day of the year in the vegetation growing season when the maximum Plant Phenology Index value is reached. The data are available at 300 m spatial resolution with the temporal extent from 2023 to present.
msgstr: Sezona 2: podaja dan v letu v vegetacijski rastni sezoni, ko je dosežena največja vrednost indeksa fenologije rastlin. Podatki so na voljo s prostorsko ločljivostjo 300 m za obdobje od leta 2023 do danes.

Season 1: provides the average Plant Phe.msgid: Season 1: provides the average Plant Phenology Index value of the minima on left and right sides of each season. The data are available at 300 m spatial resolution with the temporal extent from 2023 to present.
msgstr: Sezona 1: podaja povprečno vrednost indeksa fenologije rastlin v minimumih na levi in desni strani posamezne sezone. Podatki so na voljo s prostorsko ločljivostjo 300 m za obdobje od leta 2023 do danes.

Season 2: provides the average Plant Phe.msgid: Season 2: provides the average Plant Phenology Index value of the minima on left and right sides of each season. The data are available at 300 m spatial resolution with the temporal extent from 2023 to present.
msgstr: Sezona 2: podaja povprečno vrednost indeksa fenologije rastlin v minimumih na levi in desni strani posamezne sezone. Podatki so na voljo s prostorsko ločljivostjo 300 m za obdobje od leta 2023 do danes.

Season 1: the growing season integral th.msgid: Season 1: the growing season integral that is computed as the time-integrated Plant Phenology Index values between the dates of the season start and end, minus their base level value. The data are available at 300 m spatial resolution with the temporal extent from 2023 to present.
msgstr: Sezona 1: integral rastne sezone, izračunan kot časovno integrirane vrednosti indeksa fenologije rastlin med datumoma začetka in konca sezone, zmanjšan za vrednost osnovne ravni. Podatki so na voljo s prostorsko ločljivostjo 300 m za obdobje od leta 2023 do danes.

Season 2: the growing season integral th.msgid: Season 2: the growing season integral that is computed as the time-integrated Plant Phenology Index values between the dates of the season start and end, minus their base level value. The data are available at 300 m spatial resolution with the temporal extent from 2023 to present.
msgstr: Sezona 2: integral rastne sezone, izračunan kot časovno integrirane vrednosti indeksa fenologije rastlin med datumoma začetka in konca sezone, zmanjšan za vrednost osnovne ravni. Podatki so na voljo s prostorsko ločljivostjo 300 m za obdobje od leta 2023 do danes.

Season 1: marks the day of the year when.msgid: Season 1: marks the day of the year when the vegetation growing season starts in the time profile of the Plant Phenology Index. The start-of-season occurs, by definition, when the Plant Phenology Index value reaches 25% of the season amplitude during the green-up period. The data are available at 300 m spatial resolution with the temporal extent from 2023 to present.
msgstr: Sezona 1: označuje dan v letu, ko se v časovnem profilu indeksa fenologije rastlin začne vegetacijska rastna sezona. Začetek sezone nastopi po definiciji, ko vrednost indeksa fenologije rastlin med obdobjem naraščanja zelenja doseže 25 % amplitude sezone. Podatki so na voljo s prostorsko ločljivostjo 300 m za obdobje od leta 2023 do danes.

Season 2: marks the day of the year when.msgid: Season 2: marks the day of the year when the vegetation growing season starts in the time profile of the Plant Phenology Index. The start-of-season occurs, by definition, when the Plant Phenology Index value reaches 25% of the season amplitude during the green-up period. The data are available at 300 m spatial resolution with the temporal extent from 2023 to present.
msgstr: Sezona 2: označuje dan v letu, ko se v časovnem profilu indeksa fenologije rastlin začne vegetacijska rastna sezona. Začetek sezone nastopi po definiciji, ko vrednost indeksa fenologije rastlin med obdobjem naraščanja zelenja doseže 25 % amplitude sezone. Podatki so na voljo s prostorsko ločljivostjo 300 m za obdobje od leta 2023 do danes.

Season 1: the growing season integral co.msgid: Season 1: the growing season integral computed as the time-integrated Plant Phenology Index values between the dates of the season start and end. The data are available at 300 m spatial resolution with the temporal extent from 2023 to present.
msgstr: Sezona 1: integral rastne sezone, izračunan kot časovno integrirane vrednosti indeksa fenologije rastlin med datumoma začetka in konca sezone. Podatki so na voljo s prostorsko ločljivostjo 300 m za obdobje od leta 2023 do danes.

Season 2: the growing season integral co.msgid: Season 2: the growing season integral computed as the time-integrated Plant Phenology Index values between the dates of the season start and end. The data are available at 300 m spatial resolution with the temporal extent from 2023 to present.
msgstr: Sezona 2: integral rastne sezone, izračunan kot časovno integrirane vrednosti indeksa fenologije rastlin med datumoma začetka in konca sezone. Podatki so na voljo s prostorsko ločljivostjo 300 m za obdobje od leta 2023 do danes.

An evalscript (or \"custom script\") is.msgid:
An evalscript (or "custom script") is a piece of Javascript code that defines how the satellite data
should be processed by Sentinel Hub (one of the underlying services that powers the Browser) and what values the
service should return.
Read more about custom scripts in our [tutorials](${ tutorial }) or use already prepared scripts
for different collections from the [custom script repository](${ repo }).
msgstr:
Evalscript (ali »skripta po meri«) je del kode Javascript, ki določa, kako naj Sentinel Hub (ena od osnovnih storitev, na katerih deluje Browser) obdela satelitske podatke in katere vrednosti naj storitev vrne.
Več o skriptah po meri preberite v naših [vodičih](${ tutorial }) ali uporabite že pripravljene skripte
za različne zbirke iz [repozitorija skript po meri](${ repo }).

These values are updated automatically based on your map navigation, date selection, collection choice, and advanced settings.

Provides land cover and land use data in.msgid: Provides land cover and land use data in 764 Functional Urban Areas (FUA) with more than 50,000 inhabitants in EEA38 countries and the United Kingdom for the 2018 reference year. The dataset maps land cover and land use for 17 urban classes with the Minimum Mapping Unit (MMU) of 0.25 ha and for 9 rural classes with the MMU of 1 ha and is available as vector data. The revised 2018 dataset is now aligned with the 2021 FUA boundaries, except for the 26 new FUAs that have no correspondence in 2018.
msgstr: Zagotavlja podatke o pokrovnosti in rabi tal v 764 funkcionalnih urbanih območjih (FUA) z več kot 50.000 prebivalci v državah EEA38 in Združenem kraljestvu za referenčno leto 2018. Zbirka podatkov kartira pokrovnost in rabo tal za 17 urbanih razredov z najmanjšo kartirno enoto (MMU) 0,25 ha in za 9 podeželskih razredov z MMU 1 ha ter je na voljo kot vektorski podatki. Popravljena zbirka za leto 2018 je zdaj usklajena z mejami FUA iz leta 2021, razen 26 novih FUA, ki leta 2018 nimajo ustreznice.
Pokrovnost in raba tal, vsake 3 leta, 2021

Provides land cover and land use data in.msgid: Provides land cover and land use data in 790 Functional Urban Areas (FUA) with more than 50,000 inhabitants in EEA38 countries and the United Kingdom for the 2021 reference year. The dataset maps land cover and land use for 19 urban classes with the Minimum Mapping Unit (MMU) of 0.25 ha and for 9 rural classes with the MMU of 1 ha and is available as vector data.

Zbirka podatkov kartira pokrovnost in rabo tal za 19 urbanih razredov z najmanjšo kartirno enoto (MMU) 0,25 ha in za 9 podeželskih razredov z MMU 1 ha ter je na voljo kot vektorski podatki.

Zbirka podatkov je na voljo kot vektorski podatki.

Growing season integral computed as the.msgid: Growing season integral computed as the time-integrated Plant Phenology Index values between the dates of the start and end of the first growing season. Expressed in [m².day/m²].
msgstr: Integral rastne sezone, izračunan kot časovno integrirane vrednosti indeksa fenologije rastlin med datumoma začetka in konca prve rastne sezone. Izražen je v [m².dan/m²].

Growing season integral computed as the.msgid: Growing season integral computed as the time-integrated Plant Phenology Index values between the dates of the start and end of the second growing season. Expressed in [m².day/m²].
