Growing season integral computed as the.msgid: Growing season integral computed as the time-integrated Plant Phenology Index values between the dates of the start and end of the first growing season minus their base level value. Expressed in [m².day/m²].
msgstr: Integral rastne sezone, izračunan kot časovno integrirane vrednosti indeksa fenologije rastlin med datumoma začetka in konca prve rastne sezone, zmanjšan za vrednost osnovne ravni. Izražen je v [m².dan/m²].

Growing season integral computed as the.msgid: Growing season integral computed as the time-integrated Plant Phenology Index values between the dates of the start and end of the second growing season minus their base level value. Expressed in [m².day/m²].
msgstr: Integral rastne sezone, izračunan kot časovno integrirane vrednosti indeksa fenologije rastlin med datumoma začetka in konca druge rastne sezone, zmanjšan za vrednost osnovne ravni. Izražen je v [m².dan/m²].

Number of days between the start and the.msgid: Number of days between the start and the end of the first growing season.
msgstr: Število dni med začetkom in koncem prve rastne sezone.

Number of days between the start and the.msgid: Number of days between the start and the end of the second growing season.
msgstr: Število dni med začetkom in koncem druge rastne sezone.

Difference between the Season Maximum va.msgid: Difference between the Season Maximum value and the Season Minimum Value for the first growing season. Expressed in [m² / m²].
msgstr: Razlika med največjo in najmanjšo vrednostjo sezone za prvo rastno sezono. Izražena je v [m² / m²].

Difference between the Season Maximum va.msgid: Difference between the Season Maximum value and the Season Minimum Value for the second growing season. Expressed in [m² / m²].
msgstr: Razlika med največjo in najmanjšo vrednostjo sezone za drugo rastno sezono. Izražena je v [m² / m²].

Absolute value of the decreasing rate of.msgid: Absolute value of the decreasing rate of Plant Phenology Index during the first season vegetation green-down. Expressed in [m² / m² /day].
msgstr: Absolutna vrednost stopnje padanja indeksa fenologije rastlin med pojemanjem zelenja vegetacije v prvi sezoni. Izražena je v [m² / m² /dan].

Absolute value of the decreasing rate of.msgid: Absolute value of the decreasing rate of Plant Phenology Index during the second season vegetation green-down. Expressed in [m² / m² /day].
msgstr: Absolutna vrednost stopnje padanja indeksa fenologije rastlin med pojemanjem zelenja vegetacije v drugi sezoni. Izražena je v [m² / m² /dan].

Day of the year when the first vegetatio.msgid: Day of the year when the first vegetation growing season starts in the time profile of the Plant Phenology Index. A negative value of the SOSD indicates that the peak of growing season is in the current year and the start of the season is located in the previous year.
msgstr: Dan v letu, ko se v časovnem profilu indeksa fenologije rastlin začne prva vegetacijska rastna sezona. Negativna vrednost SOSD pomeni, da je vrh rastne sezone v tekočem letu, začetek sezone pa v preteklem letu.

Day of the year when the second vegetati.msgid: Day of the year when the second vegetation growing season starts in the time profile of the Plant Phenology Index. A negative value of the SOSD indicates that the peak of growing season is in the current year and the start of the season is located in the previous year.
msgstr: Dan v letu, ko se v časovnem profilu indeksa fenologije rastlin začne druga vegetacijska rastna sezona. Negativna vrednost SOSD pomeni, da je vrh rastne sezone v tekočem letu, začetek sezone pa v preteklem letu.

Day of the year in the first vegetation.msgid: Day of the year in the first vegetation growing season when the Plant Phenology Index reaches its maximum value.
msgstr: Dan v letu v prvi vegetacijski rastni sezoni, ko indeks fenologije rastlin doseže največjo vrednost.

Day of the year in the second vegetation.msgid: Day of the year in the second vegetation growing season when the Plant Phenology Index reaches its maximum value.
msgstr: Dan v letu v drugi vegetacijski rastni sezoni, ko indeks fenologije rastlin doseže največjo vrednost.

Day of the year when the first vegetatio.msgid: Day of the year when the first vegetation growing season ends in the time profile of the Plant Phenology Index. A value of the EOSD larger than 365 indicates that the peak of growing season is in the current year and the end of the season is located in the next year.
msgstr: Dan v letu, ko se v časovnem profilu indeksa fenologije rastlin konča prva vegetacijska rastna sezona. Vrednost EOSD, večja od 365, pomeni, da je vrh rastne sezone v tekočem letu, konec sezone pa v naslednjem letu.

Day of the year when the second vegetati.msgid: Day of the year when the second vegetation growing season ends in the time profile of the Plant Phenology Index. A value of the EOSD larger than 365 indicates that the peak of growing season is in the current year and the end of the season is located in the next year.
msgstr: Dan v letu, ko se v časovnem profilu indeksa fenologije rastlin konča druga vegetacijska rastna sezona. Vrednost EOSD, večja od 365, pomeni, da je vrh rastne sezone v tekočem letu, konec sezone pa v naslednjem letu.

Value of the Plant Phenology Index at th.msgid: Value of the Plant Phenology Index at the start of the first vegetation growing season. Expressed in [m² / m²].
msgstr: Vrednost indeksa fenologije rastlin na začetku prve vegetacijske rastne sezone. Izražena je v [m² / m²].

Value of the Plant Phenology Index at th.msgid: Value of the Plant Phenology Index at the start of the second vegetation growing season. Expressed in [m² / m²].
msgstr: Vrednost indeksa fenologije rastlin na začetku druge vegetacijske rastne sezone. Izražena je v [m² / m²].

Maximum value that the Plant Phenology I.msgid: Maximum value that the Plant Phenology Index reaches during the first vegetation growing season i.e. value of the Plant Phenology Index at the maximum season date of the first growing season. Expressed in [m² / m²].
msgstr: Največja vrednost, ki jo indeks fenologije rastlin doseže med prvo vegetacijsko rastno sezono, tj. vrednost indeksa fenologije rastlin na datum sezonskega maksimuma prve rastne sezone. Izražena je v [m² / m²].

Maximum value that the Plant Phenology I.msgid: Maximum value that the Plant Phenology Index reaches during the second vegetation growing season i.e. value of the Plant Phenology Index at the maximum season date of the second growing season. Expressed in [m² / m²].
msgstr: Največja vrednost, ki jo indeks fenologije rastlin doseže med drugo vegetacijsko rastno sezono, tj. vrednost indeksa fenologije rastlin na datum sezonskega maksimuma druge rastne sezone. Izražena je v [m² / m²].

The average of the Plant Phenology Index.msgid: The average of the Plant Phenology Index value of the minima on left and right sides of the first season. Expressed in [m² / m²].
msgstr: Povprečje vrednosti indeksa fenologije rastlin v minimumih na levi in desni strani prve sezone. Izraženo je v [m² / m²].

The average of the Plant Phenology Index.msgid: The average of the Plant Phenology Index value of the minima on left and right sides of the second season. Expressed in [m² / m²].
msgstr: Povprečje vrednosti indeksa fenologije rastlin v minimumih na levi in desni strani druge sezone. Izraženo je v [m² / m²].

Value of the Plant Phenology Index at th.msgid: Value of the Plant Phenology Index at the end of the first vegetation growing season. Expressed in [m² / m²].
msgstr: Vrednost indeksa fenologije rastlin na koncu prve vegetacijske rastne sezone. Izražena je v [m² / m²].

Value of the Plant Phenology Index at th.msgid: Value of the Plant Phenology Index at the end of the second vegetation growing season. Expressed in [m² / m²].
msgstr: Vrednost indeksa fenologije rastlin na koncu druge vegetacijske rastne sezone. Izražena je v [m² / m²].

Value of the increasing rate of Plant Ph.msgid: Value of the increasing rate of Plant Phenology Index during the first season vegetation green-up. Expressed in [m² / m² /day]
msgstr: Vrednost stopnje naraščanja indeksa fenologije rastlin med naraščanjem zelenja vegetacije v prvi sezoni. Izražena je v [m² / m² /dan]

Value of the increasing rate of Plant Ph.msgid: Value of the increasing rate of Plant Phenology Index during the second season vegetation green-up. Expressed in [m² / m² /day].
msgstr: Vrednost stopnje naraščanja indeksa fenologije rastlin med naraščanjem zelenja vegetacije v drugi sezoni. Izražena je v [m² / m² /dan].

Provides at pan-European level a classif.msgid: Provides at pan-European level a classification of the presence of fallow land over annual cropland area at a spatial resolution of 10 m and a MMU of 0.25 ha.
msgstr: Zagotavlja klasifikacijo prisotnosti prahe na njivskih površinah na vseevropski ravni s prostorsko ločljivostjo 10 m in MMU 0,25 ha.

Confidence layer - a quality indicator f.msgid: Confidence layer - a quality indicator for fallow land presence.
msgstr: Sloj zaupanja – kazalnik kakovosti za prisotnost prahe.

Provides at pan-European level in the sp.msgid: Provides at pan-European level in the spatial resolution of 10 m information on the dominant leaf type (broadleaved or coniferous).
msgstr: Zagotavlja informacije o prevladujočem tipu listov (listavci ali iglavci) na vseevropski ravni s prostorsko ločljivostjo 10 m.

Confidence layer - a quality indicator f.msgid: Confidence layer - a quality indicator for dominant leaf type.
msgstr: Sloj zaupanja – kazalnik kakovosti za prevladujoči tip listov.

Provides at pan-European level a classif.msgid: Provides at pan-European level a classification of cropland into one of the 19 crop type classes at a spatial resolution of 10 m and a MMU of 0.25 ha.
msgstr: Zagotavlja klasifikacijo njivskih površin v enega od 19 razredov vrst posevkov na vseevropski ravni s prostorsko ločljivostjo 10 m in MMU 0,25 ha.

Confidence layer - a quality indicator f.msgid: Confidence layer - a quality indicator for crop types.
msgstr: Sloj zaupanja – kazalnik kakovosti za vrste posevkov.

Provides at pan-European level the durat.msgid: Provides at pan-European level the duration of the main growing season at a spatial resolution of 10 m and a MMU of 0.25 ha.
msgstr: Zagotavlja trajanje glavne rastne sezone na vseevropski ravni s prostorsko ločljivostjo 10 m in MMU 0,25 ha.

Confidence layer - a quality indicator f.msgid: Confidence layer - a quality indicator for main crop duration.
msgstr: Sloj zaupanja – kazalnik kakovosti za trajanje glavnega posevka.

Confidence layer - a quality indicator f.msgid: Confidence layer - a quality indicator for tree cover presence change.
msgstr: Sloj zaupanja – kazalnik kakovosti za spremembo prisotnosti drevesnega pokrova.

Confidence layer - a quality indicator f.msgid: Confidence layer - a quality indicator for grassland change.
msgstr: Sloj zaupanja – kazalnik kakovosti za spremembo travinja.

Classification of grassland / non-grassl.msgid: Classification of grassland / non-grassland. Provides at pan-European level in the spatial resolution of 10 m a basic land cover classification with two thematic classes (grassland / non-grassland).
msgstr: Klasifikacija travinje / ne travinje. Zagotavlja osnovno klasifikacijo pokrovnosti tal z dvema tematskima razredoma (travinje / ne travinje) na vseevropski ravni s prostorsko ločljivostjo 10 m.

Confidence layer - a quality indicator f.msgid: Confidence layer - a quality indicator for grassland classification.
msgstr: Sloj zaupanja – kazalnik kakovosti za klasifikacijo travinja.

Provides at pan-European level in the sp.msgid: Provides at pan-European level in the spatial resolution of 10 m the level of tree cover density in a range from 0% to 100%.
msgstr: Zagotavlja raven gostote drevesnega pokrova v razponu od 0 % do 100 % na vseevropski ravni s prostorsko ločljivostjo 10 m.

Confidence layer - a quality indicator f.msgid: Confidence layer - a quality indicator for tree cover density.
msgstr: Sloj zaupanja – kazalnik kakovosti za gostoto drevesnega pokrova.

The High Resolution Dominant Leaf Type (.msgid:
The High Resolution Dominant Leaf Type (DLT) raster product provides a basic land cover classification with 3 thematic classes (all non-tree covered areas, broadleaved and coniferous).

This dataset is provided annually starting with 2018 in 10 meter rasters (fully conformant with the EEA reference grid) in 100 x 100 km tiles covering the EEA38 countries.

High Resolution Layer Tree Cover and Forest product is part of the European Union’s Copernicus Land Monitoring Service. Confidence layer available for the dataset.

This dataset includes data from the French Overseas Territories (DOMs)
msgstr:
Rastrski izdelek High Resolution Dominant Leaf Type (DLT) zagotavlja osnovno klasifikacijo pokrovnosti tal s 3 tematskimi razredi (vsa območja brez drevesnega pokrova, listavci in iglavci).

Ta zbirka podatkov je na voljo letno od leta 2018 naprej v rastrih ločljivosti 10 metrov (popolnoma skladnih z referenčno mrežo EEA) v ploščicah 100 x 100 km, ki pokrivajo države EEA38.

Izdelek High Resolution Layer Tree Cover and Forest je del storitve Copernicus za spremljanje kopenskega površja Evropske unije. Za zbirko podatkov je na voljo sloj zaupanja.

Ta zbirka podatkov vključuje podatke francoskih čezmorskih ozemelj (DOM)

The High Resolution Layer Cropping Patte.msgid:
The High Resolution Layer Cropping Patterns - Fallow Land Presence (CPFLP) raster product provides the yearly fallow land classification indicating if arable land has been left fallow in the respective calendar year. This dataset is provided annually starting in 2017 with 10 meter rasters (fully conformant with the EEA reference grid) in 100 x 100 km tiles covering the EEA38 countries. High Resolution Layer Croplands product is part of the European Union’s Copernicus Land Monitoring Service. Confidence layer available for the dataset.

This dataset includes data from the French Overseas Territories (DOMs). More information [here](https://land.copernicus.eu/en/products/high-resolution-layer-croplands).
msgstr:
Rastrski izdelek High Resolution Layer Cropping Patterns - Fallow Land Presence (CPFLP) zagotavlja letno klasifikacijo prahe, ki kaže, ali je bila obdelovalna zemlja v zadevnem koledarskem letu puščena v prahi. Ta zbirka podatkov je na voljo letno od leta 2017 naprej v rastrih ločljivosti 10 metrov (popolnoma skladnih z referenčno mrežo EEA) v ploščicah 100 x 100 km, ki pokrivajo države EEA38. Izdelek High Resolution Layer Croplands je del storitve Copernicus za spremljanje kopenskega površja Evropske unije. Za zbirko podatkov je na voljo sloj zaupanja.

Ta zbirka podatkov vključuje podatke francoskih čezmorskih ozemelj (DOM). Več informacij [tukaj](https://land.copernicus.eu/en/products/high-resolution-layer-croplands).

The High Resolution Layer Crop Types (CT.msgid:
The High Resolution Layer Crop Types (CTY) raster product provides high resolution crop type classification for 17 classes of both arable and permanent crops across the EEA38 extent. Using both Sentinel-1 and Sentinel-2, the model is finetuned to first map the crop field boundaries, and then determine the main crop for each field.

This dataset is provided annually starting in 2017 with 10 meter rasters (fully conformant with the EEA reference grid) in 100 x 100 km tiles covering the EEA38 countries.

High Resolution Layer Croplands product is part of the European Union’s Copernicus Land Monitoring Service. Confidence layer available for the dataset.

This dataset includes data from the French Overseas Territories (DOMs). More information [here](https://land.copernicus.eu/en/products/high-resolution-layer-croplands).
msgstr:
Rastrski izdelek High Resolution Layer Crop Types (CTY) zagotavlja klasifikacijo vrst posevkov visoke ločljivosti za 17 razredov njivskih in trajnih posevkov na območju EEA38. Z uporabo podatkov Sentinel-1 in Sentinel-2 je model fino nastavljen tako, da najprej kartira meje njiv, nato pa za vsako njivo določi glavni posevek.

Ta zbirka podatkov je na voljo letno od leta 2017 naprej v rastrih ločljivosti 10 metrov (popolnoma skladnih z referenčno mrežo EEA) v ploščicah 100 x 100 km, ki pokrivajo države EEA38.

Izdelek High Resolution Layer Croplands je del storitve Copernicus za spremljanje kopenskega površja Evropske unije. Za zbirko podatkov je na voljo sloj zaupanja.

Ta zbirka podatkov vključuje podatke francoskih čezmorskih ozemelj (DOM). Več informacij [tukaj](https://land.copernicus.eu/en/products/high-resolution-layer-croplands).

The High Resolution Layer Cropping Patte.msgid:
The High Resolution Layer Cropping Patterns - Main Crop Duration (CPMCD) raster product provides the duration (in days) of the growing season for the main (annual) crop.

This dataset is provided annually starting in 2017 with 10 meter rasters (fully conformant with the EEA reference grid) in 100 x 100 km tiles covering the EEA38 countries. High Resolution Layer Croplands product is part of the European Union’s Copernicus Land Monitoring Service. Confidence layer available for the dataset.

This dataset includes data from the French Overseas Territories (DOMs). More information [here](https://land.copernicus.eu/en/products/high-resolution-layer-croplands).
msgstr:
Rastrski izdelek High Resolution Layer Cropping Patterns - Main Crop Duration (CPMCD) zagotavlja trajanje (v dneh) rastne sezone glavnega (enoletnega) posevka.

Ta zbirka podatkov je na voljo letno od leta 2017 naprej v rastrih ločljivosti 10 metrov (popolnoma skladnih z referenčno mrežo EEA) v ploščicah 100 x 100 km, ki pokrivajo države EEA38. Izdelek High Resolution Layer Croplands je del storitve Copernicus za spremljanje kopenskega površja Evropske unije. Za zbirko podatkov je na voljo sloj zaupanja.

Ta zbirka podatkov vključuje podatke francoskih čezmorskih ozemelj (DOM). Več informacij [tukaj](https://land.copernicus.eu/en/products/high-resolution-layer-croplands).

The High Resolution Layer Forest Type (F.msgid:
The High Resolution Layer Forest Type (FTY) provides a forest classification with 3 thematic classes (all non-forest areas / broadleaved forest / coniferous forest) at 10m spatial resolution and with a Minimum Mapping Unit (MMU) of 0.5 ha. This raster layer is largely following the FAO (Food and Agriculture Organisation of the United Nations) forest definition with tree covered areas in agricultural and urban context excluded using the respective Forest Additional Support Layer (FADSL).

This dataset is provided on a 3-yearly frequency in 10 meter rasters (fully conformant with the EEA reference grid) in 100 x 100 km tiles covering the EEA38 countries.

High Resolution Layer Tree Cover and Forest product is part of the European Union’s Copernicus Land Monitoring Service.

This dataset includes data from the French Overseas Territories (DOMs)
msgstr:
High Resolution Layer Forest Type (FTY) zagotavlja klasifikacijo gozdov s 3 tematskimi razredi (vsa negozdna območja / listnati gozd / iglasti gozd) s prostorsko ločljivostjo 10 m in najmanjšo kartirno enoto (MMU) 0,5 ha. Ta rastrski sloj v veliki meri sledi definiciji gozda FAO (Organizacija Združenih narodov za prehrano in kmetijstvo), pri čemer so območja z drevesnim pokrovom v kmetijskem in urbanem okolju izključena z uporabo ustreznega sloja Forest Additional Support Layer (FADSL).

Ta zbirka podatkov je na voljo s triletno pogostostjo v rastrih ločljivosti 10 metrov (popolnoma skladnih z referenčno mrežo EEA) v ploščicah 100 x 100 km, ki pokrivajo države EEA38.

Izdelek High Resolution Layer Tree Cover and Forest je del storitve Copernicus za spremljanje kopenskega površja Evropske unije.

Ta zbirka podatkov vključuje podatke francoskih čezmorskih ozemelj (DOM)

The High Resolution Layer Grassland (GRA.msgid:
The High Resolution Layer Grassland (GRA) raster product provides a binary status layer of grassland/non-grassland mask. This grassy and non-woody vegetation baseline product includes all kinds of grasslands: managed grassland, semi-natural grassland and natural grassy vegetation. It does not include temporary grasslands, which are masked out using the corresponding Ploughing indicator (PLOUGH), indicating on the number of years since a pixel was last ploughed.

This dataset is provided annually starting in 2017 with 10 meter rasters (fully conformant with the EEA reference grid) in 100 x 100 km tiles covering the EEA38 countries.

High Resolution Layer Grasslands product is part of the European Union’s Copernicus Land Monitoring Service. Confidence layer available for the dataset.

This dataset includes data from the French Overseas Territories (DOMs). More information [here](https://land.copernicus.eu/en/products/high-resolution-layer-grasslands).
msgstr:
Rastrski izdelek High Resolution Layer Grassland (GRA) zagotavlja binarni statusni sloj maske travinje/ne travinje. Ta osnovni izdelek travnate in neolesenele vegetacije vključuje vse vrste travinja: gospodarjeno travinje, polnaravno travinje in naravno travnato vegetacijo. Ne vključuje začasnega travinja, ki je izločeno z ustreznim indikatorjem oranja (PLOUGH), ki kaže število let od zadnjega oranja piksla.

Ta zbirka podatkov je na voljo letno od leta 2017 naprej v rastrih ločljivosti 10 metrov (popolnoma skladnih z referenčno mrežo EEA) v ploščicah 100 x 100 km, ki pokrivajo države EEA38.

Izdelek High Resolution Layer Grasslands je del storitve Copernicus za spremljanje kopenskega površja Evropske unije. Za zbirko podatkov je na voljo sloj zaupanja.

Ta zbirka podatkov vključuje podatke francoskih čezmorskih ozemelj (DOM). Več informacij [tukaj](https://land.copernicus.eu/en/products/high-resolution-layer-grasslands).

The High Resolution Layer Tree Cover Den.msgid:
The High Resolution Layer Tree Cover Density (TCD) dataset provides information on the proportional crown coverage per pixel at 10 meter spatial resolution and ranges from 0% (all non-tree covered areas) to 100%, whereby Tree Cover Density is defined as the "vertical projection of tree crowns to a horizontal earth’s surface".

This dataset is provided annually starting with 2018 in 10 meter rasters (fully conformant with the EEA reference grid) in 100 x 100 km tiles covering the EEA38 countries.

High Resolution Layer Tree Cover and Forest product is part of the European Union’s Copernicus Land Monitoring Service. Confidence layer available for the dataset.

This dataset includes data from the French Overseas Territories (DOMs).
msgstr:
Zbirka podatkov High Resolution Layer Tree Cover Density (TCD) zagotavlja informacije o sorazmerni pokritosti s krošnjami na piksel s prostorsko ločljivostjo 10 metrov in sega od 0 % (vsa območja brez drevesnega pokrova) do 100 %, pri čemer je gostota drevesnega pokrova definirana kot »navpična projekcija krošenj dreves na vodoravno zemeljsko površje«.

Ta zbirka podatkov je na voljo letno od leta 2018 naprej v rastrih ločljivosti 10 metrov (popolnoma skladnih z referenčno mrežo EEA) v ploščicah 100 x 100 km, ki pokrivajo države EEA38.

Izdelek High Resolution Layer Tree Cover and Forest je del storitve Copernicus za spremljanje kopenskega površja Evropske unije. Za zbirko podatkov je na voljo sloj zaupanja.

Ta zbirka podatkov vključuje podatke francoskih čezmorskih ozemelj (DOM).

The available Sentinel-1 data includes p.msgid: The available Sentinel-1 data includes products from the Sentinel-1 satellite constellation, including Sentinel-1A (operational since 2014), Sentinel-1B (operational from 2016 to 2022), Sentinel-1C (operational since 2025), Sentinel-1D (operational since 2026).
msgstr: Razpoložljivi podatki Sentinel-1 vključujejo izdelke konstelacije satelitov Sentinel-1, vključno s Sentinel-1A (v uporabi od leta 2014), Sentinel-1B (v uporabi od leta 2016 do 2022), Sentinel-1C (v uporabi od leta 2025) in Sentinel-1D (v uporabi od leta 2026).

Urban Atlas Building Block Height 2021 i.msgid: Urban Atlas Building Block Height 2021 is a 10 m high resolution raster layer containing height information generated for selected cities and urban areas as part of the Urban atlas suite of products.
msgstr: Urban Atlas Building Block Height 2021 je rastrski sloj visoke ločljivosti 10 m z informacijami o višini, ustvarjen za izbrana mesta in urbana območja v okviru nabora izdelkov Urban Atlas.

Urban Atlas Building Block Height 2021 i.msgid: Urban Atlas Building Block Height 2021 is a 10 m high resolution raster layer containing height information generated for selected cities and urban areas as part of the Urban atlas suite of products. Height information is based on satellite information and derived datasets like the digital surface model, the digital terrain model and the normalized digital surface model (DSM). More information [here](https://land.copernicus.eu/en/products/urban-atlas).
msgstr: Urban Atlas Building Block Height 2021 je rastrski sloj visoke ločljivosti 10 m z informacijami o višini, ustvarjen za izbrana mesta in urbana območja v okviru nabora izdelkov Urban Atlas. Informacije o višini temeljijo na satelitskih podatkih in izpeljanih zbirkah podatkov, kot so digitalni model površja, digitalni model terena in normaliziran digitalni model površja (DSM). Več informacij [tukaj](https://land.copernicus.eu/en/products/urban-atlas).

# Land Surface Temperature (LST)\n\nThe.msgid:
# Land Surface Temperature (LST)

The Land Surface Temperature (LST) product provides the temperature of the Earth's surface as retrieved from the SLSTR thermal infrared channels. LST is a key parameter in the physics of land surface, controlling the partitioning of energy between the atmosphere and the land surface. It is used in climate change monitoring, drought monitoring, and urban heat island studies.

More info [here](https://sentiwiki.copernicus.eu/web/slstr-products#S3-SLSTR-Products-L2-LST-Products).
msgstr:
# Temperatura površja kopnega (LST)

Izdelek temperature površja kopnega (LST) zagotavlja temperaturo zemeljskega površja, pridobljeno iz termalnih infrardečih kanalov SLSTR. LST je ključni parameter v fiziki kopenskega površja, saj nadzoruje porazdelitev energije med atmosfero in kopnim. Uporablja se pri spremljanju podnebnih sprememb, spremljanju suše in študijah urbanih toplotnih otokov.

Več informacij [tukaj](https://sentiwiki.copernicus.eu/web/slstr-products#S3-SLSTR-Products-L2-LST-Products).

# Normalized Difference Vegetation Index.msgid:
# Normalized Difference Vegetation Index (NDVI)

The Normalized Difference Vegetation Index (NDVI) is a dimensionless index that describes the difference between visible and near-infrared reflectance of vegetation cover. It can be used to estimate the density of vegetation cover and monitor vegetation health.

More info [here](https://github.com/eu-cdse/sentinel-hub-custom-scripts/tree/main/sentinel-3/slstrl2/ndvi/).
msgstr:
# Normaliziran diferenčni vegetacijski indeks (NDVI)

Normaliziran diferenčni vegetacijski indeks (NDVI) je brezdimenzijski indeks, ki opisuje razliko med odbojnostjo vegetacijskega pokrova v vidnem in bližnjem infrardečem delu spektra. Z njim lahko ocenimo gostoto vegetacijskega pokrova in spremljamo zdravje vegetacije.

Več informacij [tukaj](https://github.com/eu-cdse/sentinel-hub-custom-scripts/tree/main/sentinel-3/slstrl2/ndvi/).

The **Sea and Land Surface Temperature (.msgid:
The **Sea and Land Surface Temperature (SLSTR)** instrument on board Sentinel-3 measures the global and regional sea and land surface temperature. The SLSTR L2 Land Surface Temperature (LST) product provides land surface temperature retrieved from the thermal infrared channels.

**Spatial resolution:** 1km (that is, only details bigger than 1km can be seen).

**Revisit time:** Maximum 1 day to revisit the same area, using both satellites.

**Data availability:** Since May 2018 onwards.

**Common usage:** Climate change monitoring, land surface temperature monitoring, drought monitoring, urban heat island studies.
msgstr:
Instrument **Sea and Land Surface Temperature (SLSTR)** na satelitu Sentinel-3 meri globalno in regionalno temperaturo morskega in kopenskega površja. Izdelek SLSTR L2 Land Surface Temperature (LST) zagotavlja temperaturo kopenskega površja, pridobljeno iz termalnih infrardečih kanalov.

**Prostorska ločljivost:** 1 km (tj. vidne so le podrobnosti, večje od 1 km).

**Čas ponovnega obiska:** Največ 1 dan za ponovni obisk istega območja z uporabo obeh satelitov.

**Razpoložljivost podatkov:** Od maja 2018 naprej.

**Običajna uporaba:** Spremljanje podnebnih sprememb, spremljanje temperature kopenskega površja, spremljanje suše, študije urbanih toplotnih otokov.

Land Surface Temperature, expressed in K.msgid: Land Surface Temperature, expressed in Kelvin.
msgstr: Temperatura zemeljskega površja, izražena v kelvinih.

Provides Land Surface Temperature estima.msgid: Provides Land Surface Temperature estimates at global scale, at a spatial resolution of ~3 km. More information [here](https://land.copernicus.eu/en/products/temperature-and-reflectance?tab=land_surface_temperature).
msgstr: Zagotavlja ocene temperature površja kopnega v globalnem merilu s prostorsko ločljivostjo ~3 km. Več informacij [tukaj](https://land.copernicus.eu/en/products/temperature-and-reflectance?tab=land_surface_temperature).

Minimum of Land Surface Temperature obse.msgid: Minimum of Land Surface Temperature observed during the 10-days period, per hour. Expressed in Kelvin.
msgstr: Najnižja temperatura površja kopnega, opažena v 10-dnevnem obdobju, po urah. Izražena v kelvinih.

Median of Land Surface Temperature obser.msgid: Median of Land Surface Temperature observed during the 10-days period, per hour. Expressed in Kelvin.
msgstr: Mediana temperature površja kopnega, opažene v 10-dnevnem obdobju, po urah. Izražena v kelvinih.

Maximum of Land Surface Temperature obse.msgid: Maximum of Land Surface Temperature observed during the 10-days period, per hour. Expressed in Kelvin.
msgstr: Najvišja temperatura površja kopnega, opažena v 10-dnevnem obdobju, po urah. Izražena v kelvinih.

Fraction of valid observations as used t.msgid: Fraction of valid observations as used to calculate the minimum, median and maximum temperature values, per hour.
msgstr: Delež veljavnih opazovanj, uporabljenih za izračun najnižje, mediane in najvišje temperature, po urah.

Provides Land Surface Temperature estima.msgid: Provides Land Surface Temperature estimates at global scale, at a spatial resolution of ~3 km. More information [here](https://land.copernicus.eu/en/products/temperature-and-reflectance/daily-land-surface-temperature-global-v3-0-3km).
msgstr: Zagotavlja ocene temperature površja kopnega v globalnem merilu s prostorsko ločljivostjo ~3 km. Več informacij [tukaj](https://land.copernicus.eu/en/products/temperature-and-reflectance/daily-land-surface-temperature-global-v3-0-3km).

Median of Land Surface Temperature obser.msgid: Median of Land Surface Temperature observed during the 10-days period, regardless the time of the day. Expressed in Kelvin.
msgstr: Mediana temperature površja kopnega, opažene v 10-dnevnem obdobju, ne glede na čas dneva. Izražena v kelvinih.

Thermal Condition Index for the composit.msgid: Thermal Condition Index for the compositing period, estimated using LST observations around local solar noon.
msgstr: Indeks toplotnega stanja za obdobje sestavljanja, ocenjen na podlagi opazovanj LST okoli lokalnega sončnega poldneva.

Fraction of valid observations as used t.msgid: Fraction of valid observations as used to calculate the minimum, median and maximum temperature values, regardless the time of the day.
msgstr: Delež veljavnih opazovanj, uporabljenih za izračun najnižje, mediane in najvišje temperature, ne glede na čas dneva.

Provides Land Surface Temperature estima.msgid: Provides Land Surface Temperature estimates at global scale, at a spatial resolution of ~3 km. More information [here](https://land.copernicus.eu/en/products/temperature-and-reflectance/10daily-land-surface-temperature-synthesis-global-v3-0-3km).
msgstr: Zagotavlja ocene temperature površja kopnega v globalnem merilu s prostorsko ločljivostjo ~3 km. Več informacij [tukaj](https://land.copernicus.eu/en/products/temperature-and-reflectance/10daily-land-surface-temperature-synthesis-global-v3-0-3km).

Provides at pan-European level in the sp.msgid: Provides at pan-European level in the spatial resolution of 10 m an indication on the number of years since a ploughing event for each pixel in the herbaceous cover. This dataset is auxiliary and is used in production of the Grassland status products to distinguish between temporary and permanent grasslands.
msgstr: Zagotavlja kazalnik števila let od dogodka oranja za vsak piksel zelnatega pokrova na vseevropski ravni s prostorsko ločljivostjo 10 m. Ta zbirka podatkov je pomožna in se uporablja pri izdelavi izdelkov stanja travinja za razlikovanje med začasnim in trajnim travinjem.

Count of grassland mowing events. Provid.msgid: Count of grassland mowing events. Provides at pan-European level in the spatial resolution of 10 m a basic land cover classification containing respectively the number of grassland mowing events (GRAME) within the detected temporal and permanent grassland (Herbaceous cover Layer) at a spatial resolution of 10 m and a MMU of 0.25 ha.
msgstr: Število dogodkov košnje travinja. Zagotavlja osnovno klasifikacijo pokrovnosti tal na vseevropski ravni s prostorsko ločljivostjo 10 m, ki vsebuje število dogodkov košnje travinja (GRAME) znotraj zaznanega začasnega in trajnega travinja (sloj zelnatega pokrova) s prostorsko ločljivostjo 10 m in MMU 0,25 ha.

Confidence layer - a quality indicator f.msgid: Confidence layer - a quality indicator for grassland mowing events.
msgstr: Sloj zaupanja – kazalnik kakovosti za dogodke košnje travinja.

Provides at pan-European level the type.msgid: Provides at pan-European level the type (4 categories) of the secondary crop season at a spatial resolution of 10 m and a MMU of 0.25 ha.
msgstr: Zagotavlja vrsto (4 kategorije) sekundarne rastne sezone posevka na vseevropski ravni s prostorsko ločljivostjo 10 m in MMU 0,25 ha.

Provides at pan-European level in the sp.msgid: Provides at pan-European level in the spatial resolution of 10 m a basic land cover classification containing respectively the grassland mowing dates (GRAMD) within the detected temporal and permanent grassland (Herbaceous cover Layer) at a spatial resolution of 10 m and a MMU of 0.25 ha.
msgstr: Zagotavlja osnovno klasifikacijo pokrovnosti tal na vseevropski ravni s prostorsko ločljivostjo 10 m, ki vsebuje datume košnje travinja (GRAMD) znotraj zaznanega začasnega in trajnega travinja (sloj zelnatega pokrova) s prostorsko ločljivostjo 10 m in MMU 0,25 ha.

Provides at pan-European level the annua.msgid: Provides at pan-European level the annual crop type diversity over a three-year period at a spatial resolution of 10 m and a MMU of 0.25 ha.
msgstr: Zagotavlja letno raznolikost vrst posevkov v triletnem obdobju na vseevropski ravni s prostorsko ločljivostjo 10 m in MMU 0,25 ha.

Provides at pan-European level in the sp.msgid: Provides at pan-European level in the spatial resolution of 10 m a basic land cover classification with two thematic classes (herbaceous / non-herbaceous).
msgstr: Zagotavlja osnovno klasifikacijo pokrovnosti tal z dvema tematskima razredoma (zelnato / nezelnato) na vseevropski ravni s prostorsko ločljivostjo 10 m.

Provides at pan-European level the numbe.msgid: Provides at pan-European level the number (max 2) of growing seasons (main and secondary) within a calendar year at a spatial resolution of 10 m and a MMU of 0.25 ha.
msgstr: Zagotavlja število (največ 2) rastnih sezon (glavne in sekundarne) v koledarskem letu na vseevropski ravni s prostorsko ločljivostjo 10 m in MMU 0,25 ha.

The High Resolution Layer Ploughing indi.msgid:
The High Resolution Layer Ploughing indicator (PLOUGH) raster product continues the 2015 and 2018 PLOUGH Layer following a rolling archive principle by adding current information and removing historic years. It indicates the number of years since the last indication of ploughing within the permanent grassland area. PLOUGH is derived by taking into account the series of binary HER layers, the BVL classifications and HR VPP PPI (Plant Phenology Index) quantiles. BVL classes 4 (crop) and 7 (overlaying layer between herbaceous and crop) indicate a ploughing event. Low HR VPP PPI quantiles indicate low vegetation at a certain time of the year. For years with missing information (2016 and earlier) the ploughing information from the historic PLOUGH product is considered which causes some issues.

This dataset is provided annually starting in 2017 with 10 meter rasters (fully conformant with the EEA reference grid) in 100 x 100 km tiles covering the EEA38 countries.

High Resolution Layer Grasslands product is part of the European Union's Copernicus Land Monitoring Service.

This dataset includes data from the French Overseas Territories (DOMs). More information [here](https://land.copernicus.eu/en/products/high-resolution-layer-grasslands).
msgstr:
Rastrski izdelek High Resolution Layer Ploughing indicator (PLOUGH) nadaljuje sloj PLOUGH za leti 2015 in 2018 po načelu drsečega arhiva, tako da dodaja trenutne informacije in odstranjuje pretekla leta. Kaže število let od zadnjega znaka oranja znotraj območja trajnega travinja. PLOUGH je izpeljan ob upoštevanju serije binarnih slojev HER, klasifikacij BVL in kvantilov HR VPP PPI (indeks fenologije rastlin). Razreda BVL 4 (posevek) in 7 (prekrivajoči sloj med zelnatim in posevkom) kažeta na dogodek oranja. Nizki kvantili HR VPP PPI kažejo nizko vegetacijo v določenem času leta. Za leta z manjkajočimi informacijami (2016 in prej) se upoštevajo informacije o oranju iz zgodovinskega izdelka PLOUGH, kar povzroča nekatere težave.

Ta zbirka podatkov je na voljo letno od leta 2017 naprej v rastrih ločljivosti 10 metrov (popolnoma skladnih z referenčno mrežo EEA) v ploščicah 100 x 100 km, ki pokrivajo države EEA38.

Izdelek High Resolution Layer Grasslands je del storitve Copernicus za spremljanje kopenskega površja Evropske unije.

Ta zbirka podatkov vključuje podatke francoskih čezmorskih ozemelj (DOM). Več informacij [tukaj](https://land.copernicus.eu/en/products/high-resolution-layer-grasslands).

The High Resolution Layer Cropping Patte.msgid:
The High Resolution Layer Cropping Patterns - Secondary Crop Type (CPSCT) raster product indicates if a cover crop was present within the respective calendar year and further segregates the types of cover crop into: short summer, long summer, short winter and long winter cover crop.

This dataset is provided annually starting in 2017 with 10 meter rasters (fully conformant with the EEA reference grid) in 100 x 100 km tiles covering the EEA38 countries.

High Resolution Layer Croplands product is part of the European Union’s Copernicus Land Monitoring Service. Confidence layer available for the dataset.

This dataset includes data from the French Overseas Territories (DOMs). More information [here](https://land.copernicus.eu/en/products/high-resolution-layer-croplands).
msgstr:
Rastrski izdelek High Resolution Layer Cropping Patterns - Secondary Crop Type (CPSCT) kaže, ali je bil v zadevnem koledarskem letu prisoten pokrovni posevek, in vrste pokrovnih posevkov dodatno razvršča v: kratek poletni, dolg poletni, kratek zimski in dolg zimski pokrovni posevek.

Ta zbirka podatkov je na voljo letno od leta 2017 naprej v rastrih ločljivosti 10 metrov (popolnoma skladnih z referenčno mrežo EEA) v ploščicah 100 x 100 km, ki pokrivajo države EEA38.

Izdelek High Resolution Layer Croplands je del storitve Copernicus za spremljanje kopenskega površja Evropske unije. Za zbirko podatkov je na voljo sloj zaupanja.

Ta zbirka podatkov vključuje podatke francoskih čezmorskih ozemelj (DOM). Več informacij [tukaj](https://land.copernicus.eu/en/products/high-resolution-layer-croplands).

The High Resolution Layer Grassland Mowi.msgid:
The High Resolution Layer Grassland Mowing Dates (GRAMD) raster product provides at pan-European level in the spatial resolution of 10 m a basic land cover classification, flagging and mapping the start date (DOY) (GRAMD) within the detected Herbaceous cover layer (temporal and permanent grassland)) with a Minimum Mapping Unit (MMU) of 0.25 ha. The GRAMD product will flag and map the dates (Day of Year) of each mowing event on temporary or permanent grassland per year, resulting in a product split in four different rasters per year.

This dataset is provided annually starting with 2017 in 10 meter rasters (fully conformant with the EEA reference grid) in 100 x 100 km tiles covering the EEA38 countries.

High Resolution Layer Grasslands product is part of the European Union's Copernicus Land Monitoring Service.

This dataset includes data from the French Overseas Territories (DOMs). More information [here](https://land.copernicus.eu/en/products/high-resolution-layer-grasslands).
msgstr:
Rastrski izdelek High Resolution Layer Grassland Mowing Dates (GRAMD) zagotavlja osnovno klasifikacijo pokrovnosti tal na vseevropski ravni s prostorsko ločljivostjo 10 m, ki označuje in kartira začetni datum (DOY) (GRAMD) znotraj zaznanega sloja zelnatega pokrova (začasno in trajno travinje) z najmanjšo kartirno enoto (MMU) 0,25 ha. Izdelek GRAMD označuje in kartira datume (dan v letu) vsakega dogodka košnje na začasnem ali trajnem travinju v posameznem letu, zato je izdelek razdeljen na štiri različne rastre na leto.

Ta zbirka podatkov je na voljo letno od leta 2017 naprej v rastrih ločljivosti 10 metrov (popolnoma skladnih z referenčno mrežo EEA) v ploščicah 100 x 100 km, ki pokrivajo države EEA38.

Izdelek High Resolution Layer Grasslands je del storitve Copernicus za spremljanje kopenskega površja Evropske unije.

Ta zbirka podatkov vključuje podatke francoskih čezmorskih ozemelj (DOM). Več informacij [tukaj](https://land.copernicus.eu/en/products/high-resolution-layer-grasslands).

The High Resolution Layer Cropping Patte.msgid:
The High Resolution Layer Cropping Patterns - Cropping Seasons Types (CPCSY) raster product provides the number of different crop types grown in a 3-year period [0-3] (excluding cover crops).

This dataset is provided annually starting in 2017 with 10 meter rasters (fully conformant with the EEA reference grid) in 100 x 100 km tiles covering the EEA38 countries.

High Resolution Layer Croplands product is part of the European Union’s Copernicus Land Monitoring Service.

This dataset includes data from the French Overseas Territories (DOMs). More information [here](https://land.copernicus.eu/en/products/high-resolution-layer-croplands).
msgstr:
Rastrski izdelek High Resolution Layer Cropping Patterns - Cropping Seasons Types (CPCSY) zagotavlja število različnih vrst posevkov, gojenih v triletnem obdobju [0-3] (brez pokrovnih posevkov).

Ta zbirka podatkov je na voljo letno od leta 2017 naprej v rastrih ločljivosti 10 metrov (popolnoma skladnih z referenčno mrežo EEA) v ploščicah 100 x 100 km, ki pokrivajo države EEA38.

Izdelek High Resolution Layer Croplands je del storitve Copernicus za spremljanje kopenskega površja Evropske unije.

Ta zbirka podatkov vključuje podatke francoskih čezmorskih ozemelj (DOM). Več informacij [tukaj](https://land.copernicus.eu/en/products/high-resolution-layer-croplands).

The High Resolution Layer Grassland Mowi.msgid:
The High Resolution Layer Grassland Mowing Events (GRAME) raster product provides a basic land cover classification containing respectively the number of grassland mowing events within the detected Herbaceous cover layer (temporal and permanent grassland) with a Minimum Mapping Unit (MMU) of 0.25 ha. The GRAME product will flag and map the number of mowing events (1, 2, 3, or 4+) on temporary or permanent grassland detected per year.

This dataset is provided annually starting in 2017 with 10 meter rasters (fully conformant with the EEA reference grid) in 100 x 100 km tiles covering the EEA38 countries.

High Resolution Layer Grasslands product is part of the European Union’s Copernicus Land Monitoring Service. Confidence layer available for the dataset.

This dataset includes data from the French Overseas Territories (DOMs). More information [here](https://land.copernicus.eu/en/products/high-resolution-layer-grasslands).
msgstr:
Rastrski izdelek High Resolution Layer Grassland Mowing Events (GRAME) zagotavlja osnovno klasifikacijo pokrovnosti tal, ki vsebuje število dogodkov košnje travinja znotraj zaznanega sloja zelnatega pokrova (začasno in trajno travinje) z najmanjšo kartirno enoto (MMU) 0,25 ha. Izdelek GRAME označuje in kartira število dogodkov košnje (1, 2, 3 ali 4+) na začasnem ali trajnem travinju, zaznanih v posameznem letu.

Ta zbirka podatkov je na voljo letno od leta 2017 naprej v rastrih ločljivosti 10 metrov (popolnoma skladnih z referenčno mrežo EEA) v ploščicah 100 x 100 km, ki pokrivajo države EEA38.

Izdelek High Resolution Layer Grasslands je del storitve Copernicus za spremljanje kopenskega površja Evropske unije. Za zbirko podatkov je na voljo sloj zaupanja.

Ta zbirka podatkov vključuje podatke francoskih čezmorskih ozemelj (DOM). Več informacij [tukaj](https://land.copernicus.eu/en/products/high-resolution-layer-grasslands).

The High Resolution Layer Herbaceous cov.msgid:
The High Resolution Layer Herbaceous cover (HER) raster product provides a basic land cover classification with 2 thematic classes (temporal and permanent herbaceous / non-herbaceous). The production of the herbaceous layer is primarily based on the probability estimates obtained from the Base Vegetation Layer (BVL) which also serves to harmonize the different vegetated HRL products (Grasslands, Tree Cover and Forests, Croplands). HER is further used as input for the Grassland status layer (GRA) extracting the permanent herbaceous in combination with the Ploughing indicator (PLOUGH).

This dataset is provided annually starting in 2017 with 10 meter rasters (fully conformant with the EEA reference grid) in 100 x 100 km tiles covering the EEA38 countries.

High Resolution Layer Grasslands product is part of the European Union’s Copernicus Land Monitoring Service.

This dataset includes data from the French Overseas Territories (DOMs). More information [here](https://land.copernicus.eu/en/products/high-resolution-layer-grasslands).
msgstr:
Rastrski izdelek High Resolution Layer Herbaceous cover (HER) zagotavlja osnovno klasifikacijo pokrovnosti tal z 2 tematskima razredoma (začasni in trajni zelnati / nezelnati). Izdelava zelnatega sloja temelji predvsem na ocenah verjetnosti, pridobljenih iz sloja Base Vegetation Layer (BVL), ki služi tudi usklajevanju različnih vegetacijskih izdelkov HRL (Grasslands, Tree Cover and Forests, Croplands). HER se nadalje uporablja kot vhodni podatek za sloj stanja travinja (GRA), pri čemer se v kombinaciji z indikatorjem oranja (PLOUGH) izloči trajni zelnati pokrov.

Ta zbirka podatkov je na voljo letno od leta 2017 naprej v rastrih ločljivosti 10 metrov (popolnoma skladnih z referenčno mrežo EEA) v ploščicah 100 x 100 km, ki pokrivajo države EEA38.

msgstr: Zagotavlja trajanje obdobja golih tal pred začetkom glavne rastne sezone na vseevropski ravni s prostorsko ločljivostjo 10 m in MMU 0,25 ha.

Data is sourced from Corine Land Cover and High Resolution Layer Imperviousness.
msgstr: Zagotavlja pomožne informacije o drevesih v kmetijski rabi in urbanem okolju s prostorsko ločljivostjo 10 m, ki se uporabljajo za izdelavo zbirke podatkov Forest Type za referenčno leto 2021. Podatki izvirajo iz Corine Land Cover in High Resolution Layer Imperviousness.

The High Resolution Layer Forest Additio.msgid:
The High Resolution Layer Forest Additional Support Layer (FADSL) provides information on trees under agricultural use or in urban context to be excluded from the Forest Type (FTY) product and at 10m spatial resolution. The derivation of Forest Additional Support Layer (FADSL) is based on the spatial intersection of the 10m DLT and TCD layers with CORINE Land Cover (CLC) 2018 and HRL Imperviousness Degree 2018 with 10 m spatial resolution; TCD range of 10-100%; with a MMW of 10m and no MMU (pixel base).
This dataset is provided on a 3-yearly frequency in 10 meter rasters (fully conformant with the EEA reference grid) in 100 x 100 km tiles covering the EEA38 countries.
High Resolution Layer Tree Cover and Forest product is part of the European Union’s Copernicus Land Monitoring Service.
This dataset includes data from the French Overseas Territories (DOMs). More information [here](https://land.copernicus.eu/en/products/high-resolution-layer-forests-and-tree-cover).
msgstr:
High Resolution Layer Forest Additional Support Layer (FADSL) zagotavlja informacije o drevesih v kmetijski rabi ali v urbanem okolju, ki jih je treba izključiti iz izdelka Forest Type (FTY), s prostorsko ločljivostjo 10 m. Izpeljava sloja Forest Additional Support Layer (FADSL) temelji na prostorskem preseku slojev DLT in TCD ločljivosti 10 m s slojema CORINE Land Cover (CLC) 2018 in HRL Imperviousness Degree 2018 s prostorsko ločljivostjo 10 m; razpon TCD 10-100 %; z MMW 10 m in brez MMU (na ravni piksla).
Ta zbirka podatkov je na voljo s triletno pogostostjo v rastrih ločljivosti 10 metrov (popolnoma skladnih z referenčno mrežo EEA) v ploščicah 100 x 100 km, ki pokrivajo države EEA38.

The **Sentinel-2 Quarterly Mosaics** pro.msgid:
The **Sentinel-2 Quarterly Mosaics** product offers an almost cloud-free image over the entire globe, created by stitching together the cloudless Sentinel-2 images acquired over a quarterly period (every 3 months) at a spatial resolution of 10 meters.

**Coverage:** Global Coverage.

**Data availability:** ${ displayRange }

Data for each quarter is available in the catalog on the 1st day of the corresponding quarter (e.g. 1.1. or 1.4.).

**Spatial Resolution:** 10 meters.

**Common usage:** Creating Basemaps, Land cover classification, Infrastructure/Land use planning, Environmental monitoring, Water resource management and more.
msgstr:
Izdelek **Sentinel-2 Quarterly Mosaics** ponuja skoraj brezoblačen posnetek celotnega sveta, ustvarjen s spajanjem brezoblačnih posnetkov Sentinel-2, zajetih v četrtletnem obdobju (vsake 3 mesece), s prostorsko ločljivostjo 10 metrov.

**Pokritost:** Globalna pokritost.

**Razpoložljivost podatkov:** ${ displayRange }

Podatki za posamezno četrtletje so v katalogu na voljo na 1. dan ustreznega četrtletja (npr. 1.1. ali 1.4.).

**Prostorska ločljivost:** 10 metrov.

**Običajna uporaba:** Izdelava podlag za karte, klasifikacija pokrovnosti tal, načrtovanje infrastrukture/rabe tal, spremljanje okolja, upravljanje vodnih virov in drugo.

The **Sentinel-1 DH Monthly Mosaics** is.msgid:
The **Sentinel-1 DH Monthly Mosaics** is a monthly composite obtained by computing the local resolution weighted average of radiometrically and geometrically terrain corrected input scenes. Due to the use of all available data in a month, it contains less speckle (temporal average) and the best possible local resolution (combination of ascending and descending orbits).

The input for the Sentinel-1 DH Monthly Mosaics are scenes with DH polarization and can come from all acquisition modes.

**Coverage:** Primarily polar and near-polar areas, as well as ocean-relevant areas

**Data availability:** ${ displayRange }

The data for each month is available in the catalog on the 1st day of the corresponding month (e.g. 1.1. or 1.2.).

**Spatial Resolution:** ~40 meters.
msgstr:
Izdelek **Sentinel-1 DH Monthly Mosaics** je mesečni kompozit, pridobljen z izračunom povprečja vhodnih prizorov, radiometrično in geometrično popravljenih glede na teren, ki je tehtano z lokalno ločljivostjo. Ker uporablja vse razpoložljive podatke v mesecu, vsebuje manj šuma »speckle« (časovno povprečje) in najboljšo možno lokalno ločljivost (kombinacija naraščajočih in padajočih orbit).

Vhodni podatki za Sentinel-1 DH Monthly Mosaics so prizori s polarizacijo DH in lahko izvirajo iz vseh načinov zajema.

**Pokritost:** Predvsem polarna in skoraj polarna območja ter območja, pomembna za oceane

**Razpoložljivost podatkov:** ${ displayRange }

Podatki za posamezen mesec so v katalogu na voljo na 1. dan ustreznega meseca (npr. 1.1. ali 1.2.).

**Prostorska ločljivost:** ~40 metrov.

The **Sentinel-1 IW Monthly Mosaics** is.msgid:
The **Sentinel-1 IW Monthly Mosaics** is a monthly composite obtained by computing the local resolution weighted average of radiometrically and geometrically terrain corrected input scenes. Due to the use of all available data in a month, it contains less speckle (temporal average) and the best possible local resolution (combination of ascending and descending orbits).

The input for the Sentinel-1 IW Monthly Mosaics are scenes taken in the IW acquisition mode with DV polarization.

**Coverage:** Over land and coastal areas (mainly between 80°N and 56°S)

**Data availability:** ${ displayRange }

The data for each month is available in the catalog on the 1st day of the corresponding month (e.g. 1.1. or 1.2.).

**Spatial Resolution:** ~20 meters.
msgstr:
Izdelek **Sentinel-1 IW Monthly Mosaics** je mesečni kompozit, pridobljen z izračunom povprečja vhodnih prizorov, radiometrično in geometrično popravljenih glede na teren, ki je tehtano z lokalno ločljivostjo. Ker uporablja vse razpoložljive podatke v mesecu, vsebuje manj šuma »speckle« (časovno povprečje) in najboljšo možno lokalno ločljivost (kombinacija naraščajočih in padajočih orbit).

Vhodni podatki za Sentinel-1 IW Monthly Mosaics so prizori, posneti v načinu zajema IW s polarizacijo DV.

**Pokritost:** Nad kopnim in obalnimi območji (predvsem med 80°N in 56°S)

**Razpoložljivost podatkov:** ${ displayRange }

Podatki za posamezen mesec so v katalogu na voljo na 1. dan ustreznega meseca (npr. 1.1. ali 1.2.).

**Prostorska ločljivost:** ~20 metrov.

The High Resolution Layer Cropping Patte.msgid:
The High Resolution Layer Cropping Patterns - Fallow Land Duration (CPFLD) raster product provides information on the duration of fallow land periods, expressed in days, over a five-year period.

This dataset is provided annually starting in 2017 with 10 meter rasters (fully conformant with the EEA reference grid) in 100 x 100 km tiles covering the EEA38 countries.

Note: each product covers a five-year window and is referenced by the end year of that window (e.g. the 2021 product covers the period 2017–2021).

High Resolution Layer Croplands product is part of the European Union's Copernicus Land Monitoring Service. Confidence layer available for the dataset.

This dataset includes data from the French Overseas Territories (DOMs). More information [here](https://land.copernicus.eu/en/products/high-resolution-layer-croplands).
msgstr:
Rastrski izdelek High Resolution Layer Cropping Patterns - Fallow Land Duration (CPFLD) zagotavlja informacije o trajanju obdobij prahe, izraženem v dneh, v petletnem obdobju.

Ta zbirka podatkov je na voljo letno od leta 2017 naprej v rastrih ločljivosti 10 metrov (popolnoma skladnih z referenčno mrežo EEA) v ploščicah 100 x 100 km, ki pokrivajo države EEA38.

Opomba: vsak izdelek pokriva petletno okno in je označen s končnim letom tega okna (npr. izdelek 2021 pokriva obdobje 2017–2021).

Izdelek High Resolution Layer Croplands je del storitve Copernicus za spremljanje kopenskega površja Evropske unije. Za zbirko podatkov je na voljo sloj zaupanja.

Ta zbirka podatkov vključuje podatke francoskih čezmorskih ozemelj (DOM). Več informacij [tukaj](https://land.copernicus.eu/en/products/high-resolution-layer-croplands).

Classification of the Sentinel-2 image u.msgid: Classification of the Sentinel-2 image using the MAJA cloud screening and atmospheric correction software, developed by CNES and CESBIO with contributions from DLR. Cloud detection is performed at a spatial resolution of 120 m.
msgstr: Klasifikacija posnetka Sentinel-2 z uporabo programske opreme MAJA za zaznavanje oblakov in atmosferski popravek, ki sta jo razvila CNES in CESBIO s prispevki DLR. Zaznavanje oblakov poteka s prostorsko ločljivostjo 120 m.

Quality layer providing basic assessment.msgid: Quality layer providing basic assessment of the cloud and cloud shadow classification layer.
msgstr: Sloj kakovosti, ki zagotavlja osnovno oceno klasifikacijskega sloja oblakov in senc oblakov.

Bitmask layer with pixel quality flags..msgid: Bitmask layer with pixel quality flags. The default visualisation highlights pixels where clouds have been detected using a single-scene, threshold-based approach. These correspond to pixels where bit 0 is activated. Additional information can also be visualised by selecting other bits. More details are available in the </> Custom option.
msgstr: Sloj bitne maske z zastavicami kakovosti pikslov. Privzeti prikaz poudari piksle, kjer so bili oblaki zaznani z enoprizornim pristopom na podlagi pragov. Ti ustrezajo pikslom, kjer je aktiviran bit 0. Z izbiro drugih bitov je mogoče prikazati tudi dodatne informacije. Več podrobnosti je na voljo v možnosti </> Po meri.

Fraction of the surface covered by snow.msgid: Fraction of the surface covered by snow (ranging from 0% to 100%). In the presence of tree cover, estimate of the fraction of snow under the canopy. The dataset has also the following classes: cloud or cloud shadow (205), inland water (210), and no data (255).
msgstr: Delež površja, prekritega s snegom (od 0 % do 100 %). Ob prisotnosti drevesnega pokrova je to ocena deleža snega pod krošnjami. Zbirka podatkov ima tudi naslednje razrede: oblak ali senca oblaka (205), celinske vode (210) in ni podatkov (255).

Quality layer providing basic assessment.msgid: Quality layer providing basic assessment of the on-ground snow fraction layer.
msgstr: Sloj kakovosti, ki zagotavlja osnovno oceno sloja deleža snega na tleh.

Fraction of the surface covered by snow.msgid: Fraction of the surface covered by snow as seen above the top of the canopy, i.e. visible from space (ranging from 0% to 100%). The dataset has also the following classes: cloud or cloud shadow (205), inland water (210), and no data (255).
msgstr: Delež površja, prekritega s snegom, kot je viden nad vrhom krošenj, tj. viden iz vesolja (od 0 % do 100 %). Zbirka podatkov ima tudi naslednje razrede: oblak ali senca oblaka (205), celinske vode (210) in ni podatkov (255).

Quality layer providing basic assessment.msgid: Quality layer providing basic assessment of the Top-of-canopy snow fraction layer.
msgstr: Sloj kakovosti, ki zagotavlja osnovno oceno sloja deleža snega na vrhu krošenj.

Bitmask layer with pixel quality flags..msgid: Bitmask layer with pixel quality flags. The default visualisation displays whether the pixel is located in the hillshade. These correspond to pixels where bit 0 is activated. Additional information can also be visualised by selecting other bits. More details are available in the </> Custom option.
msgstr: Sloj bitne maske z zastavicami kakovosti pikslov. Privzeti prikaz kaže, ali je piksel v reliefni senci. Ti ustrezajo pikslom, kjer je aktiviran bit 0. Z izbiro drugih bitov je mogoče prikazati tudi dodatne informacije. Več podrobnosti je na voljo v možnosti </> Po meri.

Bitmask layer defining cloud and cloud-s.msgid: Bitmask layer defining cloud and cloud-shadow masks derived from the input MAJA Sentinel-2 Level-2A product. The default visualisation displays all clouds except the thinnest ones, as well as all cloud shadows. These correspond to pixels where bit 0 is activated. Additional information can also be visualised by selecting other bits. More details are available in the </> Custom option.
msgstr: Sloj bitne maske, ki določa maski oblakov in senc oblakov, izpeljani iz vhodnega izdelka MAJA Sentinel-2 Level-2A. Privzeti prikaz kaže vse oblake razen najtanjših ter vse sence oblakov. Ti ustrezajo pikslom, kjer je aktiviran bit 0. Z izbiro drugih bitov je mogoče prikazati tudi dodatne informacije. Več podrobnosti je na voljo v možnosti </> Po meri.

Values of the spectral index Normalized.msgid: Values of the spectral index Normalized Difference Snow Index for snow-covered-pixels (ranging from 0% to 100%). The index is derived from the input MAJA Sentinel-2 level 2A product. The dataset has also the following classes: cloud or cloud shadow (205), inland water (210), and no data (255).
msgstr: Vrednosti spektralnega indeksa normaliziranega diferenčnega indeksa snega za piksle, prekrite s snegom (od 0 % do 100 %). Indeks je izpeljan iz vhodnega izdelka MAJA Sentinel-2 level 2A. Zbirka podatkov ima tudi naslednje razrede: oblak ali senca oblaka (205), celinske vode (210) in ni podatkov (255).

Wet Snow classification performed in hig.msgid: Wet Snow classification performed in high Mountains areas as described in the documentation. The possible values are wet snow (110), and Dry snow or snow-free or patchy snow (125). The dataset is also masked with the following classes: radar Shadow, layover, or foreshortening (200), water (210), forest (220), urban areas (230), non-mountain areas (240) and no data (255).
msgstr: Klasifikacija mokrega snega, izvedena v visokogorskih območjih, kot je opisano v dokumentaciji. Možne vrednosti so mokri sneg (110) ter suh sneg ali brez snega ali krpast sneg (125). Zbirka podatkov je prav tako maskirana z naslednjimi razredi: radarska senca, prekrivanje ali skrajšanje (200), voda (210), gozd (220), urbana območja (230), nehribovita območja (240) in ni podatkov (255).

Quality layer providing basic assessment.msgid: Quality layer providing basic assessment of the wet snow classification layer.
msgstr: Sloj kakovosti, ki zagotavlja osnovno oceno sloja klasifikacije mokrega snega.

Snow State Classification (SSC) within t.msgid: Snow State Classification (SSC) within the Sentinel-2 snow cover map derived from the CLMS FSC product - top-of canopy FSC layer (FSCTOC). It provides binary discrimination of wet (110) and dry (115) snow and identifies patchy snow or snow-free areas (120). The dataset has also the following classes: radar shadow, layover, foreshortening (200), shadow, and clouds and cloud shadow (205) from the aggregated FSCTOC layer, water (210), forest (220), urban areas (230), and no data (255).
msgstr: Klasifikacija stanja snega (SSC) znotraj karte snežne odeje Sentinel-2, izpeljane iz izdelka CLMS FSC – sloj FSC na vrhu krošenj (FSCTOC). Zagotavlja binarno razlikovanje med mokrim (110) in suhim (115) snegom ter prepoznava krpast sneg ali območja brez snega (120). Zbirka podatkov ima tudi naslednje razrede: radarska senca, prekrivanje, skrajšanje (200), senca ter oblaki in sence oblakov (205) iz združenega sloja FSCTOC, voda (210), gozd (220), urbana območja (230) in ni podatkov (255).

Quality layer providing basic assessment.msgid: Quality layer providing basic assessment of the wet snow state classification.
msgstr: Sloj kakovosti, ki zagotavlja osnovno oceno klasifikacije stanja mokrega snega.

Fraction of the surface covered by snow.msgid: Fraction of the surface covered by snow (ranging from 0% to 100%). The dataset has also the following classes: cloud or cloud shadow (205), inland water (210), and no data (255).
msgstr: Delež površja, prekritega s snegom (od 0 % do 100 %). Zbirka podatkov ima tudi naslednje razrede: oblak ali senca oblaka (205), celinske vode (210) in ni podatkov (255).

Quality layer providing basic assessment.msgid: Quality layer providing basic assessment of the snow fraction GF layer. For pixels with a QAFLAGS bit 7 value of 0, the data quality refers to the Sentinel-2 optical snow data quality. For pixels with a QAFLAGS bit 7 value of 1, the data quality refers to the Sentinel-1 SAR wet snow data quality.
msgstr: Sloj kakovosti, ki zagotavlja osnovno oceno sloja deleža snega GF. Za piksle z vrednostjo bita 7 v QAFLAGS 0 se kakovost podatkov nanaša na kakovost optičnih podatkov o snegu Sentinel-2. Za piksle z vrednostjo bita 7 v QAFLAGS 1 se kakovost podatkov nanaša na kakovost podatkov SAR o mokrem snegu Sentinel-1.

Number of days of snow cover over the hy.msgid: Number of days of snow cover over the hydrological year.
msgstr: Število dni snežne odeje v hidrološkem letu.

Snow cover onset date, expressed as the.msgid: Snow cover onset date, expressed as the number of days from the beginning of the hydrological year (1st September = day 0). Note that SCO is not given when the snow cover duration SCD is less than 60 days.
msgstr: Datum začetka snežne odeje, izražen kot število dni od začetka hidrološkega leta (1. september = dan 0). Upoštevajte, da SCO ni podan, kadar je trajanje snežne odeje SCD krajše od 60 dni.

Snow cover melt out date, expressed as t.msgid: Snow cover melt out date, expressed as the number of days from the beginning of the hydrological year (1st September = day 0). Note that SCM is not given when the snow cover duration SCD is less than 60 days.
msgstr: Datum konca taljenja snežne odeje, izražen kot število dni od začetka hidrološkega leta (1. september = dan 0). Upoštevajte, da SCM ni podan, kadar je trajanje snežne odeje SCD krajše od 60 dni.

Number of days with clear sky observatio.msgid: Number of days with clear sky observations used in the interpolation of the snow cover time series within the hydrological year.
msgstr: Število dni z opazovanji ob jasnem nebu, uporabljenih pri interpolaciji časovne serije snežne odeje znotraj hidrološkega leta.

Bitmask layer with pixel quality flags..msgid: Bitmask layer with pixel quality flags. The default visualisation displays areas where the snow cover duration is less than 60 days. These correspond to pixels where bit 4 is activated. Additional information can also be visualised by selecting other bits. More details are available in the </> Custom option.
msgstr: Sloj bitne maske z zastavicami kakovosti pikslov. Privzeti prikaz kaže območja, kjer je trajanje snežne odeje krajše od 60 dni. Ta ustrezajo pikslom, kjer je aktiviran bit 4. Z izbiro drugih bitov je mogoče prikazati tudi dodatne informacije. Več podrobnosti je na voljo v možnosti </> Po meri.

Quality layer providing a basic assessme.msgid: Quality layer providing a basic assessment of the snow cover duration layer.
msgstr: Sloj kakovosti, ki zagotavlja osnovno oceno sloja trajanja snežne odeje.

Number of days between the estimated sno.msgid: Number of days between the estimated snow onset date and the closest snow observation date.
msgstr: Število dni med ocenjenim datumom začetka snega in najbližjim datumom opazovanja snega.

Number of days between the estimated sno.msgid: Number of days between the estimated snow melt out date and the closest snow observation date.
msgstr: Število dni med ocenjenim datumom konca taljenja snega in najbližjim datumom opazovanja snega.

Number of days with Sentinel-1-based wet.msgid: Number of days with Sentinel-1-based wet snow observations used in the interpolation of the snow cover time series within the hydrological year (used where Sentinel-2-based observations have gaps).
msgstr: Število dni z opazovanji mokrega snega na podlagi Sentinel-1, uporabljenih pri interpolaciji časovne serije snežne odeje znotraj hidrološkega leta (uporabljeno, kjer imajo opazovanja na podlagi Sentinel-2 vrzeli).

SP S1+S2 Europe (high mountains) 60m Yea.msgid: SP S1+S2 Europe (high mountains) 60m Yearly V1
msgstr: SP S1+S2 Europe (high mountains) 60m Yearly V1

Provides at pan-European level in the sp.msgid: Provides at pan-European level in the spatial resolution of 100m information on the broadleaved cover density.
msgstr: Zagotavlja informacije o gostoti pokrova listavcev na vseevropski ravni s prostorsko ločljivostjo 100 m.

Provides at pan-European level in the sp.msgid: Provides at pan-European level in the spatial resolution of 100 m the percentage of grassland coverage within each 100 m cell.
msgstr: Zagotavlja odstotek pokritosti s travinjem znotraj posamezne celice 100 m na vseevropski ravni s prostorsko ločljivostjo 100 m.

Provides at pan-European level in the sp.msgid: Provides at pan-European level in the spatial resolution of 100 m the level of tree cover density in a range from 0% to 100%.
msgstr: Zagotavlja raven gostote drevesnega pokrova v razponu od 0 % do 100 % na vseevropski ravni s prostorsko ločljivostjo 100 m.

Provides at pan-European level the emerg.msgid: Provides at pan-European level the emergence date of the main growing season at a spatial resolution of 10 m and a MMU of 0.25 ha.
msgstr: Zagotavlja datum vznika glavne rastne sezone na vseevropski ravni s prostorsko ločljivostjo 10 m in MMU 0,25 ha.

Confidence layer - a quality indicator f.msgid: Confidence layer - a quality indicator for main crop emergence.
msgstr: Sloj zaupanja – kazalnik kakovosti za vznik glavnega posevka.

Provides at pan-European level the harve.msgid: Provides at pan-European level the harvest date of the main growing season at a spatial resolution of 10 m and a MMU of 0.25 ha.
msgstr: Zagotavlja datum žetve glavne rastne sezone na vseevropski ravni s prostorsko ločljivostjo 10 m in MMU 0,25 ha.

Confidence layer - a quality indicator f.msgid: Confidence layer - a quality indicator for main crop harvest.
msgstr: Sloj zaupanja – kazalnik kakovosti za žetev glavnega posevka.

The High Resolution Layer Broadleaved De.msgid:
The High Resolution Layer Broadleaved Density (BCD) dataset provides information on the percentage of broadleaved pixels at 100m spatial resolution, and is derived through aggregation of the 10m DLT for the respective reference year. Within each cell the number of broadleaved pixels are counted and the percentages stored into in the 100m pixel of the BCD. The class 255 = outside area is predefined by the 100m boundary layer and remains unchanged.

This dataset is provided annually starting with 2018 in 100 meter rasters (fully conformant with the EEA reference grid) in 100 x 100 km tiles covering the EEA38 countries.

High Resolution Layer Tree Cover and Forest product is part of the European Union's Copernicus Land Monitoring Service.

This dataset includes data from the French Overseas Territories (DOMs). More information [here](https://land.copernicus.eu/en/products/high-resolution-layer-forests-and-tree-cover).
msgstr:
Zbirka podatkov High Resolution Layer Broadleaved Density (BCD) zagotavlja informacije o odstotku pikslov listavcev s prostorsko ločljivostjo 100 m in je izpeljana z agregacijo DLT ločljivosti 10 m za zadevno referenčno leto. Znotraj vsake celice se prešteje število pikslov listavcev, odstotki pa se shranijo v piksel BCD ločljivosti 100 m. Razred 255 = zunanje območje je vnaprej določen s slojem meje ločljivosti 100 m in ostaja nespremenjen.

Ta zbirka podatkov je na voljo letno od leta 2018 naprej v rastrih ločljivosti 100 metrov (popolnoma skladnih z referenčno mrežo EEA) v ploščicah 100 x 100 km, ki pokrivajo države EEA38.

Izdelek High Resolution Layer Tree Cover and Forest je del storitve Copernicus za spremljanje kopenskega površja Evropske unije.

Ta zbirka podatkov vključuje podatke francoskih čezmorskih ozemelj (DOM). Več informacij [tukaj](https://land.copernicus.eu/en/products/high-resolution-layer-forests-and-tree-cover).

The High Resolution Layer Forest Type (F.msgid:
The High Resolution Layer Forest Type (FTY) dataset provides the Forest Type estimation at 100 meter spatial resolution. The number of broadleaved and coniferous pixels are counted and the percentages stored in the 100m cell. The class 255 = outside area is predefined by the 100m boundary layer and remains unchanged.

This dataset is provided on a 3-yearly frequency in 100 meter rasters (fully conformant with the EEA reference grid) in 100 x 100 km tiles covering the EEA38 countries.

High Resolution Layer Tree Cover and Forest product is part of the European Union's Copernicus Land Monitoring Service.

This dataset includes data from the French Overseas Territories (DOMs). More information [here](https://land.copernicus.eu/en/products/high-resolution-layer-forests-and-tree-cover).
msgstr:
Zbirka podatkov High Resolution Layer Forest Type (FTY) zagotavlja oceno tipa gozda s prostorsko ločljivostjo 100 metrov. Prešteje se število pikslov listavcev in iglavcev, odstotki pa se shranijo v celico 100 m. Razred 255 = zunanje območje je vnaprej določen s slojem meje ločljivosti 100 m in ostaja nespremenjen.

Ta zbirka podatkov je na voljo s triletno pogostostjo v rastrih ločljivosti 100 metrov (popolnoma skladnih z referenčno mrežo EEA) v ploščicah 100 x 100 km, ki pokrivajo države EEA38.

Izdelek High Resolution Layer Tree Cover and Forest je del storitve Copernicus za spremljanje kopenskega površja Evropske unije.

Ta zbirka podatkov vključuje podatke francoskih čezmorskih ozemelj (DOM). Več informacij [tukaj](https://land.copernicus.eu/en/products/high-resolution-layer-forests-and-tree-cover).

The High Resolution Layer Grassland (GRA.msgid:
The High Resolution Layer Grassland (GRA) raster product provides a binary status layer of grassland/non-grassland mask. This grassy and non-woody vegetation baseline product includes all kinds of grasslands: managed grassland, semi-natural grassland and natural grassy vegetation. It does not include temporary grasslands, which are masked out using the corresponding Ploughing indicator (PLOUGH), indicating on the number of years since a pixel was last ploughed. In the 100 meter raster product, the number of Grassland pixels are counted and the percentages stored in each 100 meter cell. The class 255 = outside area is predefined by the 100m boundary layer and remains unchanged.

This dataset is provided annually starting in 2017 with 100 meter rasters (fully conformant with the EEA reference grid) in 100 x 100 km tiles covering the EEA38 countries.

High Resolution Layer Grasslands product is part of the European Union's Copernicus Land Monitoring Service.

This dataset includes data from the French Overseas Territories (DOMs). More information [here](https://land.copernicus.eu/en/products/high-resolution-layer-grasslands).
msgstr:
Rastrski izdelek High Resolution Layer Grassland (GRA) zagotavlja binarni statusni sloj maske travinje/ne travinje. Ta osnovni izdelek travnate in neolesenele vegetacije vključuje vse vrste travinja: gospodarjeno travinje, polnaravno travinje in naravno travnato vegetacijo. Ne vključuje začasnega travinja, ki je izločeno z ustreznim indikatorjem oranja (PLOUGH), ki kaže število let od zadnjega oranja piksla. V rastrskem izdelku ločljivosti 100 metrov se prešteje število pikslov travinja, odstotki pa se shranijo v vsako celico 100 metrov. Razred 255 = zunanje območje je vnaprej določen s slojem meje ločljivosti 100 m in ostaja nespremenjen.

Ta zbirka podatkov je na voljo letno od leta 2017 naprej v rastrih ločljivosti 100 metrov (popolnoma skladnih z referenčno mrežo EEA) v ploščicah 100 x 100 km, ki pokrivajo države EEA38.

Izdelek High Resolution Layer Grasslands je del storitve Copernicus za spremljanje kopenskega površja Evropske unije.

Ta zbirka podatkov vključuje podatke francoskih čezmorskih ozemelj (DOM). Več informacij [tukaj](https://land.copernicus.eu/en/products/high-resolution-layer-grasslands).

The High Resolution Layer Tree Cover Den.msgid:
The High Resolution Layer Tree Cover Density (TCD) dataset provides information on the proportional crown coverage per pixel at 100 meter spatial resolution and ranges from 0% (all non-tree covered areas) to 100%, whereby Tree Cover Density is defined as the "vertical projection of tree crowns to a horizontal earth's surface". This product is an aggregation of its corresponding high resolution dataset.

This dataset is provided annually starting with 2018 in 100 meter rasters (fully conformant with the EEA reference grid) in 100 x 100 km tiles covering the EEA38 countries.

High Resolution Layer Tree Cover and Forest product is part of the European Union's Copernicus Land Monitoring Service. More information [here](https://land.copernicus.eu/en/products/high-resolution-layer-forests-and-tree-cover).
msgstr:
Zbirka podatkov High Resolution Layer Tree Cover Density (TCD) zagotavlja informacije o sorazmerni pokritosti s krošnjami na piksel s prostorsko ločljivostjo 100 metrov in sega od 0 % (vsa območja brez drevesnega pokrova) do 100 %, pri čemer je gostota drevesnega pokrova definirana kot »navpična projekcija krošenj dreves na vodoravno zemeljsko površje«. Ta izdelek je agregacija ustrezne zbirke podatkov visoke ločljivosti.

Ta zbirka podatkov je na voljo letno od leta 2018 naprej v rastrih ločljivosti 100 metrov (popolnoma skladnih z referenčno mrežo EEA) v ploščicah 100 x 100 km, ki pokrivajo države EEA38.

Izdelek High Resolution Layer Tree Cover and Forest je del storitve Copernicus za spremljanje kopenskega površja Evropske unije. Več informacij [tukaj](https://land.copernicus.eu/en/products/high-resolution-layer-forests-and-tree-cover).

The High Resolution Layer Cropping Patte.msgid:
The High Resolution Layer Cropping Patterns - Main Crop Emergence (CPMCE) raster product provides the emergence date of the main (annual) crop expressed in DOY (day of year). YYDOY where YY = last 2 digits of the year (e.g. 19 for 2019) and DOY is the day of the year (1-365).

This dataset is provided annually starting in 2017 with 10 meter rasters (fully conformant with the EEA reference grid) in 100 x 100 km tiles covering the EEA38 countries.

High Resolution Layer Croplands product is part of the European Union's Copernicus Land Monitoring Service. Confidence layer available for the dataset.

This dataset includes data from the French Overseas Territories (DOMs). More information [here](https://land.copernicus.eu/en/products/high-resolution-layer-croplands).
msgstr:
Rastrski izdelek High Resolution Layer Cropping Patterns - Main Crop Emergence (CPMCE) zagotavlja datum vznika glavnega (enoletnega) posevka, izražen v DOY (dan v letu). YYDOY, kjer je YY = zadnji dve števki leta (npr. 19 za 2019), DOY pa je dan v letu (1-365).

Ta zbirka podatkov je na voljo letno od leta 2017 naprej v rastrih ločljivosti 10 metrov (popolnoma skladnih z referenčno mrežo EEA) v ploščicah 100 x 100 km, ki pokrivajo države EEA38.

Izdelek High Resolution Layer Croplands je del storitve Copernicus za spremljanje kopenskega površja Evropske unije. Za zbirko podatkov je na voljo sloj zaupanja.

Ta zbirka podatkov vključuje podatke francoskih čezmorskih ozemelj (DOM). Več informacij [tukaj](https://land.copernicus.eu/en/products/high-resolution-layer-croplands).
