The Normalized Difference Vegetation Ind.msgid: The Normalized Difference Vegetation Index is a spectral index indicating the greenness of the vegetation.
msgstr: Normaliziran diferenčni vegetacijski indeks je spektralni indeks, ki kaže zelenost vegetacije.

Number of clear-sky surface reflectance.msgid: Number of clear-sky surface reflectance used for the inversion of the bidirectional reflectance distribution function.
msgstr: Število odbojnosti površja ob jasnem nebu, uporabljenih za inverzijo dvosmerne porazdelitvene funkcije odbojnosti.

Uncertainty of the NDVI is calculated by.msgid: Uncertainty of the NDVI is calculated by propagating the uncertainties associated to the model parameters resulting from the inversion of the bidirectional reflectance distribution function.
msgstr: Negotovost NDVI se izračuna s propagacijo negotovosti, povezanih s parametri modela, ki izhajajo iz inverzije dvosmerne porazdelitvene funkcije odbojnosti.

Maximum value of the Normalized Differen.msgid: Maximum value of the Normalized Difference Vegetation Index calculated over the 21-years period 1999-2019.
msgstr: Največja vrednost normaliziranega diferenčnega vegetacijskega indeksa, izračunana v 21-letnem obdobju 1999-2019.

Mean value of the Normalized Difference.msgid: Mean value of the Normalized Difference Vegetation Index calculated over the 21-years period 1999-2019.
msgstr: Povprečna vrednost normaliziranega diferenčnega vegetacijskega indeksa, izračunana v 21-letnem obdobju 1999-2019.

Median value of the Normalized Differenc.msgid: Median value of the Normalized Difference Vegetation Index calculated over the 21-years period 1999-2019.
msgstr: Mediana normaliziranega diferenčnega vegetacijskega indeksa, izračunana v 21-letnem obdobju 1999-2019.

Minimum value of the Normalized Differen.msgid: Minimum value of the Normalized Difference Vegetation Index calculated over the 21-years period 1999-2019.
msgstr: Najmanjša vrednost normaliziranega diferenčnega vegetacijskega indeksa, izračunana v 21-letnem obdobju 1999-2019.

Uncertainty of the NDVI is calculated by.msgid: Uncertainty of the NDVI is calculated by error propagation of the uncertainty associated to input spectral surface reflectances.
msgstr: Negotovost NDVI se izračuna s propagacijo napake negotovosti, povezane z vhodnimi spektralnimi odbojnostmi površja.

Number of clear-sky surface reflectance.msgid: Number of clear-sky surface reflectance in the dekad time window, minimum over the spectral bands used for the NDVI calculation.
msgstr: Število odbojnosti površja ob jasnem nebu v dekadnem časovnem oknu, najmanjše med spektralnimi kanali, uporabljenimi za izračun NDVI.

Provides the Long-Term Statistics of the.msgid: Provides the Long-Term Statistics of the Normalized Difference Vegetation Index. Every 10-days, minimum, median, maximum and mean are available at global scale, at a spatial resolution of ~1km over the 21-years period 1999-2019. More information [here](https://land.copernicus.eu/en/products/vegetation/normalised-difference-vegetation-long-term-statistics-v3-0-1km).
msgstr: Zagotavlja dolgoročno statistiko normaliziranega diferenčnega vegetacijskega indeksa. Vsakih 10 dni so na voljo najmanjša vrednost, mediana, največja vrednost in povprečje v globalnem merilu s prostorsko ločljivostjo ~1 km za 21-letno obdobje 1999-2019. Več informacij [tukaj](https://land.copernicus.eu/en/products/vegetation/normalised-difference-vegetation-long-term-statistics-v3-0-1km).

Provides information on the Normalized D.msgid: Provides information on the Normalized Difference Vegetation Index, a spectral index quantifying the amount and vigour of vegetation. # Enhanced Vegetation Index (EVI)\n\nThe.msgid:
# Enhanced Vegetation Index (EVI)

The enhanced vegetation index (EVI) is an 'optimized' vegetation index as it corrects for soil background signals and atmospheric influences. It is very useful in areas of dense canopy cover. The range of values for EVI is -1 to 1, with healthy vegetation generally around 0.20 to 0.80.





More infos [here](https://custom-scripts.sentinel-hub.com/sentinel-2/evi/) and [here.](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Enhanced_vegetation_index)
msgstr:
# Izboljšani vegetacijski indeks (EVI)

Izboljšani vegetacijski indeks (EVI) je »optimiziran« vegetacijski indeks, saj popravlja signale ozadja tal in atmosferske vplive. Zelo je uporaben na območjih z gostimi krošnjami. Razpon vrednosti EVI je od -1 do 1, pri čemer je zdrava vegetacija običajno okoli 0,20 do 0,80.





Več informacij [tukaj](https://custom-scripts.sentinel-hub.com/sentinel-2/evi/) in [tukaj.](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Enhanced_vegetation_index)

# False color composite\n\nA false color.msgid:
# False color composite

A false color composite uses at least one non-visible wavelength to image Earth. The false color composite using near infrared, red and green bands is very popular (a band is a region of the electromagnetic spectrum; a satellite sensor can image Earth in different bands). The false colour composite is most commonly used to assess plant density and health, since plants reflect near infrared and green light, while they absorb red. Cities and exposed ground are grey or tan, and water appears blue or black.



More info [here](https://custom-scripts.sentinel-hub.com/sentinel-2/false_color_infrared/) and [here.](https://eo.belspo.be/en/colour-composites)
msgstr:
# Kompozit v lažnih barvah

Kompozit v lažnih barvah za snemanje Zemlje uporablja vsaj eno nevidno valovno dolžino. Zelo priljubljen je kompozit v lažnih barvah z bližnjim infrardečim, rdečim in zelenim kanalom (kanal je območje elektromagnetnega spektra; satelitski senzor lahko Zemljo posname v različnih kanalih). Kompozit v lažnih barvah se najpogosteje uporablja za oceno gostote in zdravja rastlin, saj rastline odbijajo bližnjo infrardečo in zeleno svetlobo, rdečo pa vpijajo. Mesta in izpostavljena tla so siva ali rjavkasta, voda pa je videti modra ali črna.



Več informacij [tukaj](https://custom-scripts.sentinel-hub.com/sentinel-2/false_color_infrared/) in [tukaj.](https://eo.belspo.be/en/colour-composites)

# Agriculture composite\n\nThis composit.msgid:
# Agriculture composite

This composite uses short-wave infrared, near-infrared and blue bands to monitor crop health (a band is a region of the electromagnetic spectrum; a satellite sensor can image Earth in different bands). Both short-wave and near infrared bands are particularly good at highlighting dense vegetation, which appears dark green in the composite. Crops appear in a vibrant green and bare earth appears magenta.



More info [here](https://eo.belspo.be/en/colour-composites) and [here.](https://gisgeography.com/sentinel-2-bands-combinations/)
msgstr:
# Kmetijski kompozit

Ta kompozit za spremljanje zdravja posevkov uporablja kratkovalovni infrardeči, bližnji infrardeči in modri kanal (kanal je območje elektromagnetnega spektra; satelitski senzor lahko Zemljo posname v različnih kanalih). Kratkovalovni in bližnji infrardeči kanal sta še posebej dobra pri poudarjanju goste vegetacije, ki je v kompozitu temno zelena. Posevki so videti živo zeleni, gola zemlja pa je videti škrlatna.



Več informacij [tukaj](https://eo.belspo.be/en/colour-composites) in [tukaj.](https://gisgeography.com/sentinel-2-bands-combinations/)

# Geology 8, 11, 12 composite\n\nThis co.msgid:
# Geology 8, 11, 12 composite

This composite uses both short-wave infrared (SWIR) bands 11 and 12 to differentiate among different rock types (a band is a region of the electromagnetic spectrum; a satellite sensor can image Earth in different bands). Each rock and mineral type reflects shortwave infrared light differently, making it possible to map out geology by comparing reflected SWIR light. Near Infrared (NIR) band 8 highlights vegetation, contributing to differentiation of ground materials. Vegetation in the composite appears red. The composite is useful for differentiating vegetation, and land especially geologic features that can be useful for mining and mineral exploration.



More info [here.](http://murphygeological.com/new---sentinel-2.html#)
msgstr:
# Kompozit Geologija 8, 11, 12

Ta kompozit uporablja kratkovalovna infrardeča (SWIR) kanala 11 in 12 za razlikovanje med različnimi vrstami kamnin (kanal je območje elektromagnetnega spektra; satelitski senzor lahko Zemljo posname v različnih kanalih). Vsaka vrsta kamnine in minerala različno odbija kratkovalovno infrardečo svetlobo, kar omogoča kartiranje geologije s primerjavo odbite svetlobe SWIR. Bližnji infrardeči (NIR) kanal 8 poudarja vegetacijo in prispeva k razlikovanju talnih materialov. Vegetacija je v kompozitu rdeča. Kompozit je uporaben za razlikovanje vegetacije in tal, predvsem geoloških značilnosti, ki so lahko koristne za rudarstvo in iskanje mineralov.



Več informacij [tukaj.](http://murphygeological.com/new---sentinel-2.html#)

# Total suspended matter concentration\n.msgid:
# Total suspended matter concentration

Satellite-derived total suspended matter (TSM) is a measure of the concentration of particulate material in surface water such as mud, silt and other fine-grainded sedimentss, including organic and inorganic fractions. The TSM product is calculated based on the MERIS 1999 Baseline Atmospheric Correction and the OCI neural net TSM algorithm by [Hieronymi et al. 2017](https://www.frontiersin.org/journals/marine-science/articles/10.3389/fmars.2017.00140/full). The product has variable accuracy and schould be considert experimental.

More info [here.](https://documentation.dataspace.copernicus.eu/Data/SentinelMissions/Sentinel3.html#sentinel-3-olci-level-2)
msgstr:
# Koncentracija skupnih suspendiranih snovi

Satelitsko pridobljene skupne suspendirane snovi (TSM) so merilo koncentracije delcev v površinski vodi, kot so blato, melj in drugi drobnozrnati sedimenti, vključno z organskimi in anorganskimi frakcijami. Izdelek TSM je izračunan na podlagi atmosferskega popravka MERIS 1999 Baseline in nevronskega algoritma OCI TSM avtorjev [Hieronymi et al. 2017](https://www.frontiersin.org/journals/marine-science/articles/10.3389/fmars.2017.00140/full). Izdelek ima spremenljivo natančnost in ga je treba obravnavati kot eksperimentalnega.

Več informacij [tukaj.](https://documentation.dataspace.copernicus.eu/Data/SentinelMissions/Sentinel3.html#sentinel-3-olci-level-2)

# Aerosol optical thickness\n\nAerosol o.msgid:
# Aerosol optical thickness

Aerosol optical thickness (AOT) is a measure of the extent to which aerosols in the atmosphere prevent the transmission of light through absorption and scattering. Optical thickness, also knwon as optical depth depends on the physical nature, the shape and the concentration of particles. AOT is often used in climatology and atmospheric research to assess the effects of aerosols on weather, climate, and air quality.

More info [here.](https://user.eumetsat.int/resources/user-guides/sentinel-3-ocean-colour-level-2-data-guide#ID-Data)
msgstr:
# Optična debelina aerosolov

Optična debelina aerosolov (AOT) je merilo, v kolikšni meri aerosoli v ozračju z absorpcijo in sipanjem preprečujejo prehod svetlobe. Optična debelina, imenovana tudi optična globina, je odvisna od fizikalne narave, oblike in koncentracije delcev. AOT se pogosto uporablja v klimatologiji in raziskavah ozračja za oceno vplivov aerosolov na vreme, podnebje in kakovost zraka.

Več informacij [tukaj.](https://user.eumetsat.int/resources/user-guides/sentinel-3-ocean-colour-level-2-data-guide#ID-Data)

# Aerosol Angstrom exponent\n\nThe Aeros.msgid:
# Aerosol Angstrom exponent

The Aerosol Angstrom exponent is a parameter that describes how the optical thickness of aerosols in the atmosphere varies with wavelength. It provides information about the size distribution of aerosol particles, with higher values indicating smaller particles and lower values indicating larger particles. This exponent is often used in atmospheric research and climatology to analyse the properties of aerosols and their effects on climate and air quality.

More info [here.](https://user.eumetsat.int/resources/user-guides/sentinel-3-ocean-colour-level-2-data-guide#ID-Data)
msgstr:
# Ångströmov eksponent aerosolov

Ångströmov eksponent aerosolov je parameter, ki opisuje, kako se optična debelina aerosolov v ozračju spreminja z valovno dolžino. Zagotavlja informacije o porazdelitvi velikosti aerosolnih delcev, pri čemer višje vrednosti kažejo na manjše delce, nižje vrednosti pa na večje delce. Ta eksponent se pogosto uporablja v raziskavah ozračja in klimatologiji za analizo lastnosti aerosolov in njihovih vplivov na podnebje in kakovost zraka.

Več informacij [tukaj.](https://user.eumetsat.int/resources/user-guides/sentinel-3-ocean-colour-level-2-data-guide#ID-Data)

This metadata refers to the CORINE Land.msgid: This metadata refers to the CORINE Land Cover Plus Land Use, Land-Use Change and Forestry Instance (CLCplus LULUCF Instance), an annually updated, pan-European, spatially consistent and seamless geospatial proxy for land use reporting under the LULUCF regulation. The product is delivered as a single raster layer with a spatial resolution of 100 m, derived from multiple pan-European Copernicus Land Monitoring Service (CLMS) high resolution input datasets. The LULUCF Instance is available for the reference years 2018, 2021, 2022 and 2023, with production moving to an annual update cycle starting from the 2021 product. Each raster cell represents a dominant LULUCF land-use class, assigned according to thematic and spatial rulesets implemented during the extraction process. While each pixel corresponds primarily to one of the six main LULUCF land use categories - forest land, grassland, cropland, settlements, wetlands, and other lands - the dataset further differentiates these categories into sub classes, resulting in a total of 27 classes. This classification structure supports greenhouse gas reporting and other applications within the LULUCF sector by providing a harmonised and policy relevant representation of land use across Europe. More information [here](https://land.copernicus.eu/en/products/clcplus-lulucf-instance).
msgstr: Ti metapodatki se nanašajo na CORINE Land Cover Plus Land Use, Land-Use Change and Forestry Instance (CLCplus LULUCF Instance), letno posodobljen, vseevropski, prostorsko skladen in neprekinjen geoprostorski približek za poročanje o rabi tal v okviru uredbe LULUCF. LULUCF Instance je na voljo za referenčna leta 2018, 2021, 2022 in 2023, pri čemer se izdelava od izdelka 2021 naprej preusmerja na letni cikel posodabljanja. Vsaka rastrska celica predstavlja prevladujoči razred rabe tal LULUCF, dodeljen po tematskih in prostorskih pravilih, uporabljenih pri postopku izločanja. Čeprav vsak piksel ustreza predvsem eni od šestih glavnih kategorij rabe tal LULUCF – gozdna zemljišča, travinje, njivske površine, naselja, mokrišča in druga zemljišča – zbirka podatkov te kategorije dodatno razčleni na podrazrede, kar skupaj da 27 razredov. Ta klasifikacijska struktura podpira poročanje o toplogrednih plinih in druge uporabe v sektorju LULUCF, saj zagotavlja usklajeno in za politike pomembno predstavitev rabe tal po vsej Evropi. # SLSTR VIS/SWIR Bands (S1–S6)\n\nSentin.msgid:
# SLSTR VIS/SWIR Bands (S1–S6)

Sentinel-3 SLSTR (Sea and Land Surface Temperature Radiometer) captures Top-of-Atmosphere radiances in six solar reflective channels at 500 m resolution: S1 (0.555 µm, vegetation/aerosol), S2 (0.659 µm, NDVI/aerosol), S3 (0.865 µm, NDVI/cloud flagging), S4 (1.375 µm, cirrus detection), S5 (1.61 µm, ice/snow/vegetation), and S6 (2.25 µm, vegetation state). Each band is available in nadir and oblique views, enabling dual-angle observation of land and ocean surfaces. The L1B product contains geolocated, calibrated radiances produced by signal calibration, re-gridding, and cloud flagging.



More info [here](https://sentiwiki.copernicus.eu/web/slstr-products#SLSTRProducts-L1BProductsS3-SLSTR-Products-L1B).
msgstr:
# Kanali SLSTR VIS/SWIR (S1–S6)

Sentinel-3 SLSTR (Sea and Land Surface Temperature Radiometer) zajema sevanja na vrhu atmosfere v šestih kanalih odbitega sončnega sevanja z ločljivostjo 500 m: S1 (0,555 µm, vegetacija/aerosoli), S2 (0,659 µm, NDVI/aerosoli), S3 (0,865 µm, NDVI/označevanje oblakov), S4 (1,375 µm, zaznavanje cirusov), S5 (1,61 µm, led/sneg/vegetacija) in S6 (2,25 µm, stanje vegetacije). Vsak kanal je na voljo v nadirnem in poševnem pogledu, kar omogoča opazovanje kopenskih in oceanskih površin pod dvema kotoma. Izdelek L1B vsebuje geolocirana, kalibrirana sevanja, pridobljena s kalibracijo signala, ponovnim vzorčenjem na mrežo in označevanjem oblakov.



Več informacij [tukaj](https://sentiwiki.copernicus.eu/web/slstr-products#SLSTRProducts-L1BProductsS3-SLSTR-Products-L1B).

# SLSTR Thermal Infrared Bands (S7–S9)\n.msgid:
# SLSTR Thermal Infrared Bands (S7–S9)

Sentinel-3 SLSTR (Sea and Land Surface Temperature Radiometer) captures Top-of-Atmosphere brightness temperatures in three thermal infrared channels at 1 km resolution: S7 (3.74 µm, sea/land surface temperature and fire detection), S8 (10.85 µm, sea/land surface temperature and fire detection), and S9 (12.0 µm, sea/land surface temperature). Each band is available in nadir and oblique views, enabling dual-angle observation for improved atmospheric correction and surface temperature retrieval. The L1B product contains geolocated, calibrated brightness temperatures produced by signal calibration, re-gridding, and cloud flagging.



More info [here](https://sentiwiki.copernicus.eu/web/slstr-products#SLSTRProducts-L1BProductsS3-SLSTR-Products-L1B).
msgstr:
# Termalni infrardeči kanali SLSTR (S7–S9)

Sentinel-3 SLSTR (Sea and Land Surface Temperature Radiometer) zajema svetlostne temperature na vrhu atmosfere v treh termalnih infrardečih kanalih z ločljivostjo 1 km: S7 (3,74 µm, temperatura morskega/kopenskega površja in zaznavanje požarov), S8 (10,85 µm, temperatura morskega/kopenskega površja in zaznavanje požarov) in S9 (12,0 µm, temperatura morskega/kopenskega površja). Vsak kanal je na voljo v nadirnem in poševnem pogledu, kar omogoča opazovanje pod dvema kotoma za boljši atmosferski popravek in pridobivanje temperature površja. Izdelek L1B vsebuje geolocirane, kalibrirane svetlostne temperature, pridobljene s kalibracijo signala, ponovnim vzorčenjem na mrežo in označevanjem oblakov.



Več informacij [tukaj](https://sentiwiki.copernicus.eu/web/slstr-products#SLSTRProducts-L1BProductsS3-SLSTR-Products-L1B).

# Tristimulus\n\nThe colours of natural.msgid:
# Tristimulus

The colours of natural waters differ markedly across the globe, depending on water composition and illumination conditions. Ocean colour instruments measure water-leaving radiance in narrow spectral bands to retrieve water-quality indicators. The true colour of natural waters is derived by calculating tristimulus values — the three primaries (X, Y, Z) that specify a colour stimulus as perceived by the human eye.



More info [here](https://custom-scripts.sentinel-hub.com/sentinel-3/tristimulus/).
msgstr:
# Tristimulus

Barve naravnih voda se po svetu močno razlikujejo glede na sestavo vode in osvetlitvene razmere. Instrumenti za barvo oceanov merijo sevanje, ki zapušča vodo, v ozkih spektralnih kanalih, da pridobijo kazalnike kakovosti vode. Prava barva naravnih voda se izpelje z izračunom tristimulusnih vrednosti – treh primarnih vrednosti (X, Y, Z), ki določajo barvni dražljaj, kot ga zaznava človeško oko.



Več informacij [tukaj](https://custom-scripts.sentinel-hub.com/sentinel-3/tristimulus/).

# Green Instantaneous Fraction of Absorb.msgid:
# Green Instantaneous Fraction of Absorbed Photosynthetically Available Radiation (GIFAPAR)

The Green Instantaneous Fraction of Absorbed Photosynthetically Available Radiation (GIFAPAR) is a bio-geophysical product used to study the photosynthetic process of plants and is often used in diagnostic and predictive models computing primary productivity of the vegetation canopies. In addition, this parameter is also an input for the estimation of assimilation of CO2 in vegetation. GIFAPAR ranges from 0–1.

More info [here](https://sentiwiki.copernicus.eu/web/olci-products#OLCIProducts-GreenInstantaneousFractionofAbsorbedPhotosyntheticallyActiveRadiation(GI-FAPAR)S3-OLCI-Products-L2-Land-GI-FAPAR).
msgstr:
# Zeleni trenutni delež absorbiranega fotosintetsko razpoložljivega sevanja (GIFAPAR)

Zeleni trenutni delež absorbiranega fotosintetsko razpoložljivega sevanja (GIFAPAR) je biogeofizikalni izdelek, ki se uporablja za preučevanje procesa fotosinteze rastlin in se pogosto uporablja v diagnostičnih in napovednih modelih za izračun primarne produktivnosti vegetacijskih krošenj. Poleg tega je ta parameter tudi vhodni podatek za oceno asimilacije CO2 v vegetaciji. GIFAPAR je v razponu od 0 do 1.

Več informacij [tukaj](https://sentiwiki.copernicus.eu/web/olci-products#OLCIProducts-GreenInstantaneousFractionofAbsorbedPhotosyntheticallyActiveRadiation(GI-FAPAR)S3-OLCI-Products-L2-Land-GI-FAPAR).

# True Color\n\nThis True color script u.msgid:
# True Color

This True color script uses the visible light bands red, green and blue in the corresponding red, green and blue color channels, resulting in a natural colored product, that is a good representation of the Earth as humans would see it naturally. For Sentinel-2 L2A Quarterly Cloudless Mosaic, contrast enhancement with highlight compression and saturation enhancement were applied for better visualisation.



More info [here](https://custom-scripts.sentinel-hub.com/sentinel2-quarterly-cloudless-mosaic/true-color/).
msgstr:
# Prave barve

Ta skripta v pravih barvah uporablja kanale vidne svetlobe, rdečega, zelenega in modrega, v ustreznih rdečem, zelenem in modrem barvnem kanalu, kar daje naravno obarvan izdelek, ki dobro predstavlja Zemljo, kot bi jo ljudje videli naravno. Za Sentinel-2 L2A Quarterly Cloudless Mosaic sta bila za boljši prikaz uporabljena izboljšanje kontrasta s stiskanjem svetlih delov in izboljšanje nasičenosti.



Več informacij [tukaj](https://custom-scripts.sentinel-hub.com/sentinel2-quarterly-cloudless-mosaic/true-color/).

# False Color\n\nA false color composite.msgid:
# False Color

A false color composite uses at least one non-visible wavelength to image Earth. The false color composite using near infrared, red and green bands is very popular (a band is a region of the electromagnetic spectrum; a satellite sensor can image Earth in different bands). The false color composite is most commonly used to assess plant density and health, since plants reflect near infrared and green light, while they absorb red. Cities and exposed ground are grey or tan, and water appears blue or black. For Sentinel-2 L2A Quarterly Cloudless Mosaic, the HighlightCompressVisualizer is applied for better visualisation.



More info [here](https://custom-scripts.sentinel-hub.com/sentinel2-quarterly-cloudless-mosaic/false-color/).
msgstr:
# Lažne barve

Kompozit v lažnih barvah za snemanje Zemlje uporablja vsaj eno nevidno valovno dolžino. Zelo priljubljen je kompozit v lažnih barvah z bližnjim infrardečim, rdečim in zelenim kanalom (kanal je območje elektromagnetnega spektra; satelitski senzor lahko Zemljo posname v različnih kanalih). Kompozit v lažnih barvah se najpogosteje uporablja za oceno gostote in zdravja rastlin, saj rastline odbijajo bližnjo infrardečo in zeleno svetlobo, rdečo pa vpijajo. Mesta in izpostavljena tla so siva ali rjavkasta, voda pa je videti modra ali črna. Za Sentinel-2 L2A Quarterly Cloudless Mosaic je za boljši prikaz uporabljen HighlightCompressVisualizer.



Več informacij [tukaj](https://custom-scripts.sentinel-hub.com/sentinel2-quarterly-cloudless-mosaic/false-color/).

# Normalized Difference Vegetation Index.msgid:
# Normalized Difference Vegetation Index (NDVI)

The normalized difference vegetation index is a simple, but effective index for quantifying green vegetation. It is a measure of the state of vegetation health based on how plants reflect light at certain wavelengths. The value range of the NDVI is -1 to 1. Negative values of NDVI (values approaching -1) correspond to water. Values close to zero (-0.1 to 0.1) generally correspond to barren areas of rock, sand, or snow. Low, positive values represent shrub and grassland (approximately 0.2 to 0.4), while high values indicate temperate and tropical rainforests (values approaching 1). For Sentinel-2, the NDVI is calculated using NIR band B08 and red band B04: NDVI = (B08 - B04) / (B08 + B04).



More info [here](https://custom-scripts.sentinel-hub.com/sentinel2-quarterly-cloudless-mosaic/ndvi/).
msgstr:
# Normaliziran diferenčni vegetacijski indeks (NDVI)

Normaliziran diferenčni vegetacijski indeks je preprost, a učinkovit indeks za kvantifikacijo zelene vegetacije. Je merilo zdravstvenega stanja vegetacije, ki temelji na tem, kako rastline odbijajo svetlobo pri določenih valovnih dolžinah. Razpon vrednosti NDVI je od -1 do 1. Negativne vrednosti NDVI (vrednosti, ki se bližajo -1) ustrezajo vodi. Vrednosti blizu nič (od -0,1 do 0,1) običajno ustrezajo nerodovitnim območjem skal, peska ali snega. Nizke pozitivne vrednosti predstavljajo grmičevje in travinje (približno od 0,2 do 0,4), visoke vrednosti pa kažejo na zmerne in tropske deževne gozdove (vrednosti, ki se bližajo 1). Za Sentinel-2 se NDVI izračuna s kanalom NIR B08 in rdečim kanalom B04: NDVI = (B08 - B04) / (B08 + B04).



Več informacij [tukaj](https://custom-scripts.sentinel-hub.com/sentinel2-quarterly-cloudless-mosaic/ndvi/).

# Normalized Difference Water Index (NDW.msgid:
# Normalized Difference Water Index (NDWI)

The normalized difference water index is most appropriate for water body mapping. It uses green and near infrared bands to highlight water bodies, as water strongly absorbs light in the visible to infrared spectrum. Values of water bodies are larger than 0.5. Vegetation has smaller values. Built-up features have positive values between zero and 0.2. The index is sensitive to built-up land and can result in over-estimation of water bodies. For Sentinel-2, the NDWI is calculated using green band B03 and NIR band B08: NDWI = (B03 - B08) / (B03 + B08).



More info [here](https://custom-scripts.sentinel-hub.com/sentinel2-quarterly-cloudless-mosaic/ndwi/).
msgstr:
# Normaliziran diferenčni vodni indeks (NDWI)

Normaliziran diferenčni vodni indeks je najprimernejši za kartiranje vodnih teles. Za poudarjanje vodnih teles uporablja zeleni in bližnji infrardeči kanal, saj voda močno vpija svetlobo od vidnega do infrardečega dela spektra. Vrednosti vodnih teles so večje od 0,5. Vegetacija ima manjše vrednosti. Pozidani elementi imajo pozitivne vrednosti med nič in 0,2. Indeks je občutljiv na pozidana zemljišča, zato lahko povzroči preveliko oceno vodnih teles. Za Sentinel-2 se NDWI izračuna z zelenim kanalom B03 in kanalom NIR B08: NDWI = (B03 - B08) / (B03 + B08).



Več informacij [tukaj](https://custom-scripts.sentinel-hub.com/sentinel2-quarterly-cloudless-mosaic/ndwi/).

# S6 (2.25 µm SWIR)\n\nThe Sentinel-3 SY.msgid:
# S6 (2.25 µm SWIR)

The Sentinel-3 SYNERGY SY_2_SYN product combines data from the OLCI and SLSTR instruments to provide atmospherically corrected surface reflectances over land at 300 m resolution. The S6 band is the SLSTR shortwave infrared channel centered at 2250 nm and is available in both nadir and oblique views. It contributes to aerosol retrieval and surface directional reflectance, and is useful for distinguishing vegetation, bare soil, snow, ice, and minerals.



More info [here](https://sentiwiki.copernicus.eu/web/synergy-products#SYNERGYProducts-ResolutionS3-Synergy-Products-PD-Resolution).

# Normalized Difference Water Index (NDW.msgid:
# Normalized Difference Water Index (NDWI)

The normalized difference water index is most appropriate for water body mapping. It uses green and near infrared bands to highlight water bodies, as water strongly absorbs light in the visible to infrared spectrum. Values of water bodies are larger than 0.5. Vegetation has smaller values. Built-up features have positive values between zero and 0.2. The index is sensitive to built-up land and can result in over-estimation of water bodies. For Sentinel-2, the NDWI is calculated using green band B03 and NIR band B08: NDWI = (B03 - B08) / (B03 + B08).



More info [here](https://remotesensing.vito.be/news/simplify-your-processing-worldcover-annual-composites).
msgstr:
# Normaliziran diferenčni vodni indeks (NDWI)

Normaliziran diferenčni vodni indeks je najprimernejši za kartiranje vodnih teles. Za poudarjanje vodnih teles uporablja zeleni in bližnji infrardeči kanal, saj voda močno vpija svetlobo od vidnega do infrardečega dela spektra. Vrednosti vodnih teles so večje od 0,5. Vegetacija ima manjše vrednosti. Pozidani elementi imajo pozitivne vrednosti med nič in 0,2. Indeks je občutljiv na pozidana zemljišča, zato lahko povzroči preveliko oceno vodnih teles. Za Sentinel-2 se NDWI izračuna z zelenim kanalom B03 in kanalom NIR B08: NDWI = (B03 - B08) / (B03 + B08).



Več informacij [tukaj](https://remotesensing.vito.be/news/simplify-your-processing-worldcover-annual-composites).

# RGB (B17, B05, B02)\n\nThis false colo.msgid:
# RGB (B17, B05, B02)

This false color composite maps Sentinel-3 OLCI bands B17 (865 nm, near-infrared), B05 (510 nm, cyan-green), and B02 (412.5 nm, violet) into the red, green, and blue display channels respectively. B17 is a near-infrared band used for aerosol and atmospheric correction; placing it in the red channel makes vegetation and land surfaces appear bright red while water remains dark. B05 is sensitive to chlorophyll, sediment, turbidity, and red tide, and B02 captures yellow dissolved organic matter (CDOM) and detrital pigments. The composite is useful for ocean colour analysis, coastal water quality monitoring, and distinguishing turbid or sediment-laden waters from clear ocean.



More info [here](https://custom-scripts.sentinel-hub.com/sentinel-3/bands/).
msgstr:
# RGB (B17, B05, B02)

Ta kompozit v lažnih barvah preslika kanale Sentinel-3 OLCI B17 (865 nm, bližnji infrardeči), B05 (510 nm, cian-zeleni) in B02 (412,5 nm, vijoličen) v rdeči, zeleni in modri prikazovalni kanal. B17 je bližnji infrardeči kanal, ki se uporablja za popravek aerosolov in atmosfere; ker je v rdečem kanalu, sta vegetacija in kopenska površja videti svetlo rdeča, voda pa ostane temna. B05 je občutljiv na klorofil, sediment, kalnost in rdečo plimo, B02 pa zajema rumeno raztopljeno organsko snov (CDOM) in detritne pigmente. Kompozit je uporaben za analizo barve oceanov, spremljanje kakovosti obalnih voda ter razlikovanje kalnih ali s sedimentom obremenjenih voda od čistega oceana.



Več informacij [tukaj](https://custom-scripts.sentinel-hub.com/sentinel-3/bands/).

# RGB (B17, B06, B03)\n\nThis false colo.msgid:
# RGB (B17, B06, B03)

This false color composite maps Sentinel-3 OLCI bands B17 (865 nm, near-infrared), B06 (560 nm, green), and B03 (442.5 nm, blue) into the red, green, and blue display channels respectively. B17 is a near-infrared band used for aerosol and atmospheric correction; placing it in the red channel makes vegetation and land surfaces appear bright red while water remains dark. B06 is the chlorophyll absorption minimum reference band, and B03 captures chlorophyll absorption and biogeochemical properties. Compared to the B17/B05/B02 composite, the shifted green and blue channels offer a different sensitivity to phytoplankton and dissolved organic matter in coastal and open ocean waters.



More info [here](https://custom-scripts.sentinel-hub.com/sentinel-3/bands/).
msgstr:
# RGB (B17, B06, B03)

Ta kompozit v lažnih barvah preslika kanale Sentinel-3 OLCI B17 (865 nm, bližnji infrardeči), B06 (560 nm, zeleni) in B03 (442,5 nm, modri) v rdeči, zeleni in modri prikazovalni kanal. B17 je bližnji infrardeči kanal, ki se uporablja za popravek aerosolov in atmosfere; ker je v rdečem kanalu, sta vegetacija in kopenska površja videti svetlo rdeča, voda pa ostane temna. B06 je referenčni kanal minimuma absorpcije klorofila, B03 pa zajema absorpcijo klorofila in biogeokemijske lastnosti. V primerjavi s kompozitom B17/B05/B02 premaknjena zeleni in modri kanal ponujata drugačno občutljivost na fitoplankton in raztopljeno organsko snov v obalnih in odprtih oceanskih vodah.



Več informacij [tukaj](https://custom-scripts.sentinel-hub.com/sentinel-3/bands/).

# SAR False Color Visualization\n\nThis.msgid:
# SAR False Color Visualization

This script combines the gamma0 of the VV and VH polarizations of Sentinel-1 SAR data into a false color visualization. Water areas appear in blue (partially black) and land in different shades of yellow/green. Urban areas are displayed in light green-yellow (towards white), vegetated areas in mustard green, and bare ground in darker green. The visualization supports a wide range of monitoring applications, including ice and ship tracking, agriculture and deforestation monitoring, and emergency response scenarios such as flood and volcano observation.

For snowy and icy areas, the visualization can vary from light green-yellow over brighter green to dark brown or even black. Some general knowledge of the location is helpful to avoid confusing cryogenic features with other land cover types.



More info [here](https://custom-scripts.sentinel-hub.com/sentinel-1/sar_false_color_visualization/).
msgstr:
# Vizualizacija SAR v lažnih barvah

Ta skripta združuje gamma0 polarizacij VV in VH podatkov SAR Sentinel-1 v vizualizacijo v lažnih barvah. Vodna območja so prikazana modro (deloma črno), kopno pa v različnih odtenkih rumene/zelene. Urbana območja so prikazana svetlo zeleno-rumeno (proti beli), vegetacijska območja gorčično zeleno, gola tla pa temneje zeleno. Vizualizacija podpira široko paleto aplikacij spremljanja, vključno s sledenjem ledu in ladij, spremljanjem kmetijstva in krčenja gozdov ter scenariji nujnega odzivanja, kot sta opazovanje poplav in vulkanov.

Za zasnežena in poledenela območja se vizualizacija lahko spreminja od svetlo zeleno-rumene prek svetlejše zelene do temno rjave ali celo črne. Nekaj splošnega poznavanja lokacije je koristno, da kriogenih značilnosti ne zamenjate z drugimi vrstami pokrovnosti tal.



Več informacij [tukaj](https://custom-scripts.sentinel-hub.com/sentinel-1/sar_false_color_visualization/).

# Urban Areas\n\nThis script uses Sentin.msgid:
# Urban Areas

This script uses Sentinel-1 SAR VH and VV polarisations to highlight urban areas and buildings. Structures appear in different colours depending on their backscatter characteristics: purple indicates high VH reflectance, green indicates high VV reflectance, and white indicates high reflectance in both. The red channel is restricted to pixels where VH exceeds 0.5, helping separate buildings from bare soil. The script is useful for monitoring urban expansion, assessing building density, and identifying structures in flood-prone areas. Note that in mountainous terrain, steep slopes and snow can produce similar signals, making it difficult to separate urban areas from other features.



More info [here](https://custom-scripts.sentinel-hub.com/sentinel-1/urban_areas/).
msgstr:
# Urbana območja

Ta skripta uporablja polarizaciji VH in VV SAR Sentinel-1 za poudarjanje urbanih območij in stavb. Strukture so glede na značilnosti povratnega sipanja prikazane v različnih barvah: vijolična kaže visoko odbojnost VH, zelena visoko odbojnost VV, bela pa visoko odbojnost v obeh. Rdeči kanal je omejen na piksle, kjer VH presega 0,5, kar pomaga ločiti stavbe od golih tal. Skripta je uporabna za spremljanje širjenja mest, ocenjevanje gostote pozidave in prepoznavanje struktur na poplavno ogroženih območjih. Upoštevajte, da lahko v gorskem terenu strma pobočja in sneg dajejo podobne signale, zaradi česar je težko ločiti urbana območja od drugih značilnosti.



Več informacij [tukaj](https://custom-scripts.sentinel-hub.com/sentinel-1/urban_areas/).

# SAR Deforestation Detection\n\nThis sc.msgid:
# SAR Deforestation Detection

This script processes Sentinel-1 VV and VH polarisation bands to detect deforestation and forest degradation. It converts the backscatter values into polar form to derive vector length and angle, which discriminate between water, forest, and bare soil. Water and bare soil appear black, forested areas are rendered in green gradients, and degraded or cleared areas appear in red — with stronger colours indicating higher classification confidence. The script is useful for monitoring forest loss and land-use change over time.



More info [here](https://custom-scripts.sentinel-hub.com/sentinel-1/sar_deforestation_detection/).
msgstr:
# Zaznavanje krčenja gozdov s SAR

Ta skripta obdeluje kanala polarizacij VV in VH Sentinel-1 za zaznavanje krčenja in degradacije gozdov. Vrednosti povratnega sipanja pretvori v polarno obliko, da izpelje dolžino in kot vektorja, ki razlikujeta med vodo, gozdom in golimi tlemi. Voda in gola tla so črna, gozdnata območja so prikazana v zelenih gradientih, degradirana ali izkrčena območja pa rdeče – močnejše barve kažejo višjo zanesljivost klasifikacije. Skripta je uporabna za spremljanje izgube gozdov in sprememb rabe tal skozi čas.



Več informacij [tukaj](https://custom-scripts.sentinel-hub.com/sentinel-1/sar_deforestation_detection/).

# Water Surface Roughness\n\nThis script.msgid:
# Water Surface Roughness

This script visualizes water surface roughness using Sentinel-1 SAR data. SAR backscatter is highly sensitive to the roughness of the water surface: calm water reflects radar energy away from the sensor and appears dark, while rough or wind-driven water scatters energy back and appears brighter. Variations in surface roughness reveal oceanographic and maritime features such as wind patterns, sea currents, internal waves, and ship wakes. Oil spills dampen surface waves and appear as dark patches against the surrounding rougher water. The visualization supports maritime monitoring applications including ship tracking, oil pollution detection, and observation of ocean circulation.



More info [here](https://custom-scripts.sentinel-hub.com/sentinel-1/water_surface_roughness_visualization/).
msgstr:
# Hrapavost vodne površine

Ta skripta vizualizira hrapavost vodne površine s podatki SAR Sentinel-1. Povratno sipanje SAR je zelo občutljivo na hrapavost vodne površine: mirna voda odbija radarsko energijo stran od senzorja in je videti temna, razburkana ali z vetrom gnana voda pa energijo sipa nazaj in je videti svetlejša. Razlike v hrapavosti površine razkrivajo oceanografske in pomorske značilnosti, kot so vzorci vetra, morski tokovi, notranji valovi in sledi ladij. Razlitja nafte dušijo površinske valove in so videti kot temne lise na okoliški bolj hrapavi vodi. Vizualizacija podpira aplikacije pomorskega spremljanja, vključno s sledenjem ladij, zaznavanjem onesnaženja z nafto in opazovanjem oceanskega kroženja.



Več informacij [tukaj](https://custom-scripts.sentinel-hub.com/sentinel-1/water_surface_roughness_visualization/).

The High Resolution Layer Cropping Patte.msgid:
The High Resolution Layer Cropping Patterns - Main Crop Harvest (CPMCH) raster product provides the harvest date of the main (annual) crop expressed in days of the year (DOY). The harvest is considered as the time of removal of most of the biomass. YYDOY where YY = last 2 digits of the year (e.g. 19 for 2019) and DOY is the day of the year (1-365).

This dataset is provided annually starting in 2017 with 10 meter rasters (fully conformant with the EEA reference grid) in 100 x 100 km tiles covering the EEA38 countries.

High Resolution Layer Croplands product is part of the European Union's Copernicus Land Monitoring Service. Confidence layer available for the dataset.

This dataset includes data from the French Overseas Territories (DOMs). More information [here](https://land.copernicus.eu/en/products/high-resolution-layer-croplands).
msgstr:
Rastrski izdelek High Resolution Layer Cropping Patterns - Main Crop Harvest (CPMCH) zagotavlja datum žetve glavnega (enoletnega) posevka, izražen v dnevih v letu (DOY). Za žetev velja čas odstranitve večine biomase. YYDOY, kjer je YY = zadnji dve števki leta (npr. 19 za 2019), DOY pa je dan v letu (1-365).

Ta zbirka podatkov je na voljo letno od leta 2017 naprej v rastrih ločljivosti 10 metrov (popolnoma skladnih z referenčno mrežo EEA) v ploščicah 100 x 100 km, ki pokrivajo države EEA38.

Izdelek High Resolution Layer Croplands je del storitve Copernicus za spremljanje kopenskega površja Evropske unije. Za zbirko podatkov je na voljo sloj zaupanja.

Ta zbirka podatkov vključuje podatke francoskih čezmorskih ozemelj (DOM). Več informacij [tukaj](https://land.copernicus.eu/en/products/high-resolution-layer-croplands).

The Cloud Classification (CC) product pr.msgid:
The Cloud Classification (CC) product provides information on the extent of clouds and cloud shadows derived from optical satellite data acquired by the **Sentinel-2** constellation. Cloud detection is performed at a **120m** spatial resolution using the [MAJA software](https://gitlab.orfeo-toolbox.org/maja/maja/).

It is generated in near real-time at European scale, with a pixel spacing of 20 m x 20 m. It used to produce the CLMS High-Resolution Water, Snow and Ice datasets (HR-WSI), which rely on Sentinel-2 imagery.

**Data availability**: from 2016 to the present. No product is generated for a Sentinel-2 tile when cloud cover exceeds 90%.

More information in the products documentation [here](https://land.copernicus.eu/en/products/snow/fractional-snow-cover).
msgstr:
Izdelek Cloud Classification (CC) zagotavlja informacije o obsegu oblakov in senc oblakov, izpeljanih iz optičnih satelitskih podatkov konstelacije **Sentinel-2**. Zaznavanje oblakov poteka s prostorsko ločljivostjo **120 m** z uporabo [programske opreme MAJA](https://gitlab.orfeo-toolbox.org/maja/maja/).

Ustvarja se skoraj v realnem času v evropskem merilu z razmikom pikslov 20 m x 20 m. Uporablja se za izdelavo zbirk podatkov CLMS High-Resolution Water, Snow and Ice (HR-WSI), ki temeljijo na posnetkih Sentinel-2.

**Razpoložljivost podatkov**: od 2016 do danes. Za ploščico Sentinel-2 se izdelek ne ustvari, kadar oblačnost presega 90 %.

Več informacij v dokumentaciji izdelkov [tukaj](https://land.copernicus.eu/en/products/snow/fractional-snow-cover).

The **SAR Wet Snow (SWS)** product provi.msgid:
The **SAR Wet Snow (SWS)** product provides the wet snow extent for high mountain areas, based on C-band Synthetic Aperture Radar satellite data from the **Sentinel-1** constellation.

It is generated in near real-time for selected high mountain areas at European scale with a spatial resolution of **60 m x 60 m**.

**Data availability**: from 2016 to the present.

More information [here](https://land.copernicus.eu/en/products/snow/high-resolution-sar-wet-snow).
msgstr:
Izdelek **SAR Wet Snow (SWS)** zagotavlja obseg mokrega snega za visokogorska območja na podlagi satelitskih podatkov radarja s sintetično odprtino (SAR) v pasu C konstelacije **Sentinel-1**.

Ustvarja se skoraj v realnem času za izbrana visokogorska območja v evropskem merilu s prostorsko ločljivostjo **60 m x 60 m**.

**Razpoložljivost podatkov**: od 2016 do danes.

Več informacij [tukaj](https://land.copernicus.eu/en/products/snow/high-resolution-sar-wet-snow).

The **Wet / Dry Snow (WDS)** product pro.msgid:
The **Wet / Dry Snow (WDS)** product provides information on the snow state (wet or dry) by combining **Sentinel-1** radar-based wet snow maps within the snow cover extent derived from **Sentinel-2** optical data. Cloud detection in the Sentinel-2 imagery is performed using the [MAJA software](https://gitlab.orfeo-toolbox.org/maja/maja/).

It is generated in near real-time at European scale, with a spatial resolution of **60 m x 60 m** in areas where Sentinel-1 and Sentinel-2 observation tracks overlap.

**Data availability**: from 2016 to the present. No product is generated for a Sentinel-2 tile when cloud cover exceeds 90%.

More information [here](https://land.copernicus.eu/en/products/snow/high-resolution-wet-dry-snow).
msgstr:
Izdelek **Wet / Dry Snow (WDS)** zagotavlja informacije o stanju snega (moker ali suh) z združevanjem radarskih zemljevidov mokrega snega **Sentinel-1** znotraj obsega snežne odeje, izpeljanega iz optičnih podatkov **Sentinel-2**. Zaznavanje oblakov v posnetkih Sentinel-2 poteka z uporabo [programske opreme MAJA](https://gitlab.orfeo-toolbox.org/maja/maja/).

Ustvarja se skoraj v realnem času v evropskem merilu s prostorsko ločljivostjo **60 m x 60 m** na območjih, kjer se sledi opazovanja Sentinel-1 in Sentinel-2 prekrivajo.

**Razpoložljivost podatkov**: od 2016 do danes. Za ploščico Sentinel-2 se izdelek ne ustvari, kadar oblačnost presega 90 %.

Več informacij [tukaj](https://land.copernicus.eu/en/products/snow/high-resolution-wet-dry-snow).

The Sentinel-1 & Sentinel-2 **Snow Pheno.msgid:
The Sentinel-1 & Sentinel-2 **Snow Phenology (SP S1+S2)** product characterizes the timing and duration of the snow season. For each pixel and for a given hydrological year, it provides the number of days with snow cover, as well as the first and last day of the longest continuous snow period. The hydrological year starts on 1 September.

The product is generated at the European scale with a spatial resolution of **60 m x 60 m**, consistent with the input snow cover maps derived from optical satellite data acquired by the Sentinel-2 constellation and from C-band Synthetic Aperture Radar satellite data acquired by the Sentinel-1 constellation (Gap-filled Fractional Snow Cover - GFSC).

**Data availability**: from 2016 to the present. The data can be downloaded in multiple projections and pixel spacings.

More information [here](https://land.copernicus.eu/en/products/snow/high-resolution-snow-phenology).
msgstr:
Izdelek Sentinel-1 & Sentinel-2 **Snow Phenology (SP S1+S2)** opisuje čas in trajanje snežne sezone. Za vsak piksel in dano hidrološko leto zagotavlja število dni s snežno odejo ter prvi in zadnji dan najdaljšega neprekinjenega snežnega obdobja. Hidrološko leto se začne 1. septembra.

Izdelek se ustvarja v evropskem merilu s prostorsko ločljivostjo **60 m x 60 m**, skladno z vhodnimi zemljevidi snežne odeje, izpeljanimi iz optičnih satelitskih podatkov konstelacije Sentinel-2 in iz satelitskih podatkov radarja s sintetično odprtino v pasu C konstelacije Sentinel-1 (Gap-filled Fractional Snow Cover - GFSC).

**Razpoložljivost podatkov**: od 2016 do danes. Podatke je mogoče prenesti v več projekcijah in z več razmiki pikslov.

Več informacij [tukaj](https://land.copernicus.eu/en/products/snow/high-resolution-snow-phenology).

The **Water Cover Duration (WCD)** produ.msgid:
The **Water Cover Duration (WCD)** product estimates the number of days land is covered by water. For each pixel and for a given hydrological year, it indicates how frequently water is present. The hydrological year starts on 1 September. It is based on water masks derived from **Sentinel-1** radar and **Sentinel-2** optical data, combined with Water/Ice Cover data from Sentinel-2 (WIC S2).

The product is generated at the European scale with a spatial resolution of **10 m x 10 m**.

**Data availability**: from 2016 to the present. The data can be downloaded in multiple projections and pixel spacings.

More information [here](https://land.copernicus.eu/en/products/water-bodies/high-resolution-water-cover-duration).
msgstr:
Izdelek **Water Cover Duration (WCD)** ocenjuje število dni, ko je kopno prekrito z vodo. Za vsak piksel in dano hidrološko leto kaže, kako pogosto je voda prisotna. Hidrološko leto se začne 1. septembra. Temelji na vodnih maskah, izpeljanih iz radarskih podatkov **Sentinel-1** in optičnih podatkov **Sentinel-2**, v kombinaciji s podatki Water/Ice Cover iz Sentinel-2 (WIC S2).

Izdelek se ustvarja v evropskem merilu s prostorsko ločljivostjo **10 m x 10 m**.

**Razpoložljivost podatkov**: od 2016 do danes. Podatke je mogoče prenesti v več projekcijah in z več razmiki pikslov.

Več informacij [tukaj](https://land.copernicus.eu/en/products/water-bodies/high-resolution-water-cover-duration).

The **Ice Cover Duration (ICD)** product.msgid:
The **Ice Cover Duration (ICD)** product describes how long inland waters are covered by ice. For each pixel and for a given hydrological year, it provides the number of days with ice cover. The hydrological year starts on 1 September. It is based on ice cover maps derived from **Sentinel-2** optical data (Water/Ice Cover WIC S2) and **Sentinel-1** C-band Synthetic Aperture Radar data (Water/Ice Cover WIC S1).

The product is generated at the European scale with a spatial resolution of **20 m x 20 m**.

**Data availability**: from 2016 to the present. The data can be downloaded in multiple projections and pixel spacings.

More information [here](https://land.copernicus.eu/en/products/water-bodies/high-resolution-ice-cover-duration).
msgstr:
Izdelek **Ice Cover Duration (ICD)** opisuje, kako dolgo so celinske vode prekrite z ledom. Za vsak piksel in dano hidrološko leto zagotavlja število dni z ledeno odejo. Hidrološko leto se začne 1. septembra. Temelji na zemljevidih ledene odeje, izpeljanih iz optičnih podatkov **Sentinel-2** (Water/Ice Cover WIC S2) in podatkov radarja s sintetično odprtino v pasu C **Sentinel-1** (Water/Ice Cover WIC S1).

Izdelek se ustvarja v evropskem merilu s prostorsko ločljivostjo **20 m x 20 m**.

**Razpoložljivost podatkov**: od 2016 do danes. Podatke je mogoče prenesti v več projekcijah in z več razmiki pikslov.

Več informacij [tukaj](https://land.copernicus.eu/en/products/water-bodies/high-resolution-ice-cover-duration).

The **Water and Ice Cover by Sentinel-1.msgid:
The **Water and Ice Cover by Sentinel-1 (WICS1)** product provides information about river and lake areas covered by snow-covered or snow-free ice. It is based on synthetic aperture radar data from the **Sentinel-1** constellation.

It is generated in near real-time at European scale, with a spatial resolution of **60 m x 60 m**.

**Data availability**: from 2016 to the present.

More information [here](https://land.copernicus.eu/en/products/water-bodies/water-and-ice-cover-raster-20-m-60-m-europe-daily).
msgstr:
Izdelek **Water and Ice Cover by Sentinel-1 (WICS1)** zagotavlja informacije o območjih rek in jezer, prekritih z ledom, z ali brez snega. Temelji na podatkih radarja s sintetično odprtino konstelacije **Sentinel-1**.

Ustvarja se skoraj v realnem času v evropskem merilu s prostorsko ločljivostjo **60 m x 60 m**.

**Razpoložljivost podatkov**: od 2016 do danes.

Več informacij [tukaj](https://land.copernicus.eu/en/products/water-bodies/water-and-ice-cover-raster-20-m-60-m-europe-daily).

The **Water and Ice Cover by Sentinel-2.msgid:
The **Water and Ice Cover by Sentinel-2 (WICS2)** product provides the water and ice extent over land. A water mask is used to differentiate between snow on ice-covered water areas and snow on land. Cloud detection in the Sentinel-2 imagery is performed using the [MAJA software](https://gitlab.orfeo-toolbox.org/maja/maja/).

It is generated in near real-time at European scale based on optical satellite data from the Sentinel-2 constellation, with a spatial resolution of **20 m x 20 m**.

**Data availability**: from 2016 to the present. No product is generated for a Sentinel-2 tile when cloud cover exceeds 90%.

More information [here](https://land.copernicus.eu/en/products/water-bodies/water-and-ice-cover-raster-20-m-60-m-europe-daily).
msgstr:
Izdelek **Water and Ice Cover by Sentinel-2 (WICS2)** zagotavlja obseg vode in ledu nad kopnim. Vodna maska se uporablja za razlikovanje med snegom na z ledom prekritih vodnih območjih in snegom na kopnem. Zaznavanje oblakov v posnetkih Sentinel-2 poteka z uporabo [programske opreme MAJA](https://gitlab.orfeo-toolbox.org/maja/maja/).

Ustvarja se skoraj v realnem času v evropskem merilu na podlagi optičnih satelitskih podatkov konstelacije Sentinel-2 s prostorsko ločljivostjo **20 m x 20 m**.

**Razpoložljivost podatkov**: od 2016 do danes. Za ploščico Sentinel-2 se izdelek ne ustvari, kadar oblačnost presega 90 %.

Več informacij [tukaj](https://land.copernicus.eu/en/products/water-bodies/water-and-ice-cover-raster-20-m-60-m-europe-daily).

The **Fractional Snow Cover (FSC)** prod.msgid:
The **Fractional Snow Cover (FSC)** product provides the fraction of the surface covered by snow at the top of canopy (FSC-TOC) and on ground (FSC-OG) per pixel as a percentage (0% – 100%). Cloud detection in the Sentinel-2 imagery is performed using the [MAJA software](https://gitlab.orfeo-toolbox.org/maja/maja/).

It is generated in near real-time at European scale based on optical satellite data from the **Sentinel-2** constellation, with a spatial resolution of **20 m x 20 m**.

**Data availability**: from 2016 to the present. No product is generated for a Sentinel-2 tile when cloud cover exceeds 90%.

More information [here](https://land.copernicus.eu/en/products/snow/fractional-snow-cover).
msgstr:
Izdelek **Fractional Snow Cover (FSC)** zagotavlja delež površja, prekritega s snegom, na vrhu krošenj (FSC-TOC) in na tleh (FSC-OG) na piksel v odstotkih (0 % – 100 %). Zaznavanje oblakov v posnetkih Sentinel-2 poteka z uporabo [programske opreme MAJA](https://gitlab.orfeo-toolbox.org/maja/maja/).

Ustvarja se skoraj v realnem času v evropskem merilu na podlagi optičnih satelitskih podatkov konstelacije **Sentinel-2** s prostorsko ločljivostjo **20 m x 20 m**.

**Razpoložljivost podatkov**: od 2016 do danes. Za ploščico Sentinel-2 se izdelek ne ustvari, kadar oblačnost presega 90 %.

Več informacij [tukaj](https://land.copernicus.eu/en/products/snow/fractional-snow-cover).

The daily cumulative **Gap-filled Fracti.msgid:
The daily cumulative **Gap-filled Fractional Snow Cover (GFSC)** product provides pixel-wise snow cover extent as a percentage (0% – 100%). It is based on synthetic aperture radar (SAR) data from the **Sentinel-1** constellation and optical imagery from the **Sentinel-2** constellation. The product is generated by merging all available Sentinel-1 and Sentinel-2 observations acquired over the previous **seven days** to produce a spatially complete composite of snow conditions, thereby reducing data gaps caused by cloud cover and sensor coverage limitations. Snow information derived from Sentinel-1 is focused on the detection of wet snow in high-mountain areas.

It is generated on a daily basis at European scale, with a spatial resolution of **60 m x 60 m**.

**Data availability**: from 2016 to the present.

More information [here](https://land.copernicus.eu/en/products/snow/high-resolution-gap-filled-fractional-snow-cover).
msgstr:
Dnevni kumulativni izdelek **Gap-filled Fractional Snow Cover (GFSC)** zagotavlja obseg snežne odeje po pikslih v odstotkih (0 % – 100 %). Temelji na podatkih radarja s sintetično odprtino (SAR) konstelacije **Sentinel-1** in optičnih posnetkih konstelacije **Sentinel-2**. Izdelek nastane z združitvijo vseh razpoložljivih opazovanj Sentinel-1 in Sentinel-2, zajetih v preteklih **sedmih dneh**, da se ustvari prostorsko popoln kompozit snežnih razmer, s čimer se zmanjšajo vrzeli v podatkih zaradi oblačnosti in omejitev pokritosti senzorjev. Informacije o snegu, izpeljane iz Sentinel-1, so osredotočene na zaznavanje mokrega snega v visokogorskih območjih.

Ustvarja se dnevno v evropskem merilu s prostorsko ločljivostjo **60 m x 60 m**.

**Razpoložljivost podatkov**: od 2016 do danes.

Več informacij [tukaj](https://land.copernicus.eu/en/products/snow/high-resolution-gap-filled-fractional-snow-cover).

The Sentinel-2 **Snow Phenology (SP S2)*.msgid:
The Sentinel-2 **Snow Phenology (SP S2)** product characterizes the timing and duration of the snow season. For each pixel and for a given hydrological year, it provides the number of days with snow cover, as well as the first and last day of the longest continuous snow period. The hydrological year starts on 1 September.

The product is generated at the European scale with a spatial resolution of **20 m x 20 m**, consistent with the input snow cover maps derived from optical satellite data acquired by the Sentinel-2 constellation (Fractional Snow Cover - FSC).

**Data availability**: from 2016 to the present. The data can be downloaded in multiple projections and pixel spacings.

More information [here](https://land.copernicus.eu/en/products/snow/high-resolution-snow-phenology).
msgstr:
Izdelek Sentinel-2 **Snow Phenology (SP S2)** opisuje čas in trajanje snežne sezone. Za vsak piksel in dano hidrološko leto zagotavlja število dni s snežno odejo ter prvi in zadnji dan najdaljšega neprekinjenega snežnega obdobja. Hidrološko leto se začne 1. septembra.

Izdelek se ustvarja v evropskem merilu s prostorsko ločljivostjo **20 m x 20 m**, skladno z vhodnimi zemljevidi snežne odeje, izpeljanimi iz optičnih satelitskih podatkov konstelacije Sentinel-2 (Fractional Snow Cover - FSC).

**Razpoložljivost podatkov**: od 2016 do danes. Podatke je mogoče prenesti v več projekcijah in z več razmiki pikslov.

Več informacij [tukaj](https://land.copernicus.eu/en/products/snow/high-resolution-snow-phenology).

Applies to all sub-categories. The forma.msgid: Applies to all sub-categories. The format in which the data is stored (NetCDF or Cloud Optimized GeoTIFF).
msgstr: Velja za vse podkategorije. Oblika, v kateri so podatki shranjeni (NetCDF ali Cloud Optimized GeoTIFF).

Applies to all sub-categories. The uniqu.msgid: Applies to all sub-categories. The unique identifier for the specific dataset within this collection.
msgstr: Velja za vse podkategorije. Enolični identifikator posamezne zbirke podatkov znotraj te zbirke.

Applies to all sub-categories. The type.msgid: Applies to all sub-categories. The type of product, identifying the thematic category or processing pipeline.
msgstr: Velja za vse podkategorije. Vrsta izdelka, ki določa tematsko kategorijo ali procesni potek.

Only applies to data sources within the.msgid: Only applies to data sources within the Snow, Water Bodies and Auxiliary Data categories.
msgstr: Velja samo za vire podatkov znotraj kategorij Sneg, Vodna telesa in Pomožni podatki.

Applies to all sub-categories. Missions.msgid: Applies to all sub-categories. Missions whose input data was used to process the product.
msgstr: Velja za vse podkategorije. Misije, katerih vhodni podatki so bili uporabljeni za obdelavo izdelka.

Near real-time consolidation level (RT0–.msgid: Near real-time consolidation level (RT0–RT6). RT0 is the fastest delivery; RT6 has the highest accuracy. Only applies to data sources within the Vegetation category.
msgstr: Raven konsolidacije skoraj v realnem času (RT0–RT6). RT0 je najhitrejša dostava; RT6 ima najvišjo natančnost. Velja samo za vire podatkov znotraj kategorije Vegetacija.

The **Water and Ice Cover by Sentinel-1.msgid:
The **Water and Ice Cover by Sentinel-1 and Sentinel-2 (WIC S1+S2)** product shows which river and lake areas are covered by ice, with or without snow. It combines data from two types of instruments acquired on the same day to increase coverage and reduce missing information. It uses water/ice cover information derived from **Sentinel-2** optical images (WIC S2), and from **Sentinel-1** radar data (WIC S1).

The product is generated in near real-time at European scale, with a spatial resolution of **20 m x 20 m**.

**Data availability**: from 2016 to the present.

More information [here](https://land.copernicus.eu/en/products/water-bodies/water-and-ice-cover-raster-20-m-60-m-europe-daily).
msgstr:
Izdelek **Water and Ice Cover by Sentinel-1 and Sentinel-2 (WIC S1+S2)** kaže, katera območja rek in jezer so prekrita z ledom, z ali brez snega. Združuje podatke dveh vrst instrumentov, zajetih isti dan, da poveča pokritost in zmanjša manjkajoče informacije. Uporablja informacije o vodni/ledeni odeji, izpeljane iz optičnih posnetkov **Sentinel-2** (WIC S2) in iz radarskih podatkov **Sentinel-1** (WIC S1).

Izdelek se ustvarja skoraj v realnem času v evropskem merilu s prostorsko ločljivostjo **20 m x 20 m**.

**Razpoložljivost podatkov**: od 2016 do danes.

Več informacij [tukaj](https://land.copernicus.eu/en/products/water-bodies/water-and-ice-cover-raster-20-m-60-m-europe-daily).

The mosaicking order controls which data.msgid: The mosaicking order controls which data is used where imagery overlaps on the map. Fills overlapping areas with either the newest (most recent) or oldest (least recent) acquisition.
msgstr: Vrstni red mozaičenja določa, kateri podatki se uporabijo tam, kjer se posnetki na karti prekrivajo. Prekrivajoča se območja zapolni z najnovejšim (najnovejši) ali najstarejšim (najstarejši) zajemom.

No products were found for the selected search parameters.

msgstr:
Za izbrane iskalne parametre ni bilo najdenih izdelkov.

Uporabljeni filtri morda omejujejo rezultate. Za več rezultatov poskusite izbrati več virov podatkov, razširiti časovni obseg ali izbrati večje območje na karti. Preverite lahko tudi dodatne filtre.

This dataset comprises one cloud-free Ve.msgid:
This dataset comprises one cloud-free Very High Resolution optical coverage of 39 European States (EEA-39) including all islands of those countries plus
the French Overseas Departments of French Guiana, Martinique, Guadeloupe, Mayotte and Réunion but excluding French Overseas Territories. The area of
interest (~6 million square kilometres) is extended by a 4 km buffer over the sea and a 500 m buffer over countries bordering the EEA-39 states.
More info [here](https://dataspace.copernicus.eu/optical-vhr-coverage-over-europe-vhrimage2024).
msgstr:
Ta zbirka podatkov vsebuje eno brezoblačno optično pokritost zelo visoke ločljivosti 39 evropskih držav (EEA-39), vključno z vsemi otoki teh držav ter
francoskimi čezmorskimi departmaji Francoska Gvajana, Martinik, Guadeloupe, Mayotte in Réunion, vendar brez francoskih čezmorskih ozemelj. Območje
interesa (~6 milijonov kvadratnih kilometrov) je razširjeno za 4 km pas nad morjem in 500 m pas nad državami, ki mejijo na države EEA-39.
Več informacij [tukaj](https://dataspace.copernicus.eu/optical-vhr-coverage-over-europe-vhrimage2024).

This mosaic dataset, directly processed.msgid:
This mosaic dataset, directly processed and delivered by the data provider, comprises one cloud-free Very High Resolution optical coverage of 39 European States (EEA-39) including all islands of those countries plus
the French Overseas Departments of French Guiana, Martinique, Guadeloupe, Mayotte and Réunion but excluding French Overseas Territories. The area of
interest (~6 million square kilometres) is extended by a 4 km buffer over the sea and a 500 m buffer over countries bordering the EEA-39 states.
More info [here](https://dataspace.copernicus.eu/optical-vhr-coverage-over-europe-vhrimage2024).
msgstr:
Ta mozaična zbirka podatkov, ki jo je neposredno obdelal in dostavil ponudnik podatkov, vsebuje eno brezoblačno optično pokritost zelo visoke ločljivosti 39 evropskih držav (EEA-39), vključno z vsemi otoki teh držav ter
francoskimi čezmorskimi departmaji Francoska Gvajana, Martinik, Guadeloupe, Mayotte in Réunion, vendar brez francoskih čezmorskih ozemelj. Območje
interesa (~6 milijonov kvadratnih kilometrov) je razširjeno za 4 km pas nad morjem in 500 m pas nad državami, ki mejijo na države EEA-39.
Več informacij [tukaj](https://dataspace.copernicus.eu/optical-vhr-coverage-over-europe-vhrimage2024).

The Copernicus Contributing Missions (CC.msgid:
The Copernicus Contributing Missions (CCM) provide data that complements the Copernicus Sentinel Missions and play a crucial role in Earth observation.
These missions are conducted by ESA, its Member States, and international third-party operators, and they offer very high to high resolution optical, radar
and elevation model data. More [info](https://dataspace.copernicus.eu/explore-data/data-collections/copernicus-contributing-missions).
msgstr:
Misije Copernicus Contributing Missions (CCM) zagotavljajo podatke, ki dopolnjujejo misije Copernicus Sentinel in imajo ključno vlogo pri opazovanju Zemlje.
Te misije izvajajo ESA, njene države članice in mednarodni tretji operaterji ter ponujajo optične, radarske podatke in podatke digitalnega modela višin
zelo visoke do visoke ločljivosti. Več [informacij](https://dataspace.copernicus.eu/explore-data/data-collections/copernicus-contributing-missions).

No products were found for one of your selected data sources.

msgstr:
Za enega od izbranih virov podatkov ni bilo najdenih izdelkov.

Uporabljeni filtri morda omejujejo rezultate za ta vir. Poskusite razširiti časovni obseg, izbrati večje območje na karti ali preveriti dodatne filtre.

The **WMS/WMTS panel** lets you add thir.msgid: The **WMS/WMTS panel** lets you add third-party map layers to Copernicus Browser via a service **GetCapabilities URL**. To **add a service** - paste its GetCapabilities URL into the input field and click the add button (or press Enter). The service and its layers appear alongside the standard collections. Once a service is loaded, you can: - View **service details** (description, access constraints and fees) - by clicking on the info icon next to the service name. - **Select** a service - by clicking on its name; the active service is marked with a checkmark and its layers are listed below. - **Remove** a service - by clicking on the remove icon . In the layer list you can **search** layers by name, page through them with the and controls, and pick how many layers to show per page. Click a layer to display it on the map. On the active layer, use **Add to** to add it to the **Compare** or **Pins** panels.
msgstr: **Plošča WMS/WMTS** vam omogoča dodajanje slojev kart tretjih oseb v Copernicus Browser prek storitvenega **URL-ja GetCapabilities**. In the **Visualise tab** you can:\n- Sea.msgid:
In the **Visualise tab** you can:
- Search for a **Date**.
- Select a **Theme**.
- Choose a **Collection**.
- Select a **Visualisation Layer**.

You can change the **Date** (type in or select it from the calendar) and set the cloud coverage. You can choose between 
single date, mosaic and time range: ![Single](icon) ![Mosaic](icon) ![Time Range](icon).

The **Configurations** dropdown offers you different preconfigured themes and your own custom configured instances if
you are logged in. To create an instance, go to your [personal dashboard](https://shapps.dataspace.copernicus.eu/dashboard/).

You can select a desired data source in the **Data Collections**. You can read explanations of the satellites by clicking 
on the information icon next to the name of the data collection. Here you can also switch between different panels: 
![Layers](icon) Layers, ![Highlights](icon) Highlights, ![Compare mode](icon) Compare mode and ![Pins](icon) Pins.
msgstr:
V **zavihku Prikaži** lahko:
- Poiščete **datum**.
- Izberete **temo**.
- Izberete **zbirko**.
- Izberete **sloj prikaza**.

**Datum** lahko spremenite (vnesete ga ali izberete v koledarju) in nastavite oblačnost. Izbirate lahko med 
enim datumom, mozaikom in časovnim obsegom: ![Single](icon) ![Mosaic](icon) ![Time Range](icon).

Padajoči meni **Konfiguracije** ponuja različne vnaprej pripravljene teme in vaše lastne konfigurirane primerke, če
ste prijavljeni. Za ustvarjanje primerka obiščite svojo [osebno nadzorno ploščo](https://shapps.dataspace.copernicus.eu/dashboard/).

Želeni vir podatkov lahko izberete v razdelku **Zbirke podatkov**. Razlage satelitov lahko preberete s klikom 
na ikono informacij poleg imena zbirke podatkov. Tu lahko tudi preklapljate med različnimi ploščami: 
![Layers](icon) Sloji, ![Highlights](icon) Poudarki, ![Compare mode](icon) Način primerjave in ![Pins](icon) Oznake.

You can select different pre-installed o.msgid: You can select different pre-installed or custom spectral band combinations to visualise data for the selected result. Some of the common options: - **True Color** - Visual interpretation of land cover - **False Color** - Visual interpretation of vegetation - **NDVI** - Vegetation index - **Moisture index** - Moisture index - **SWIR** - Shortwave-infrared index - **NDWI** - Normalized Difference Water Index - **NDSI** - Normalized Difference Snow Index Most visualisations are given a description and a legend, which you can view by clicking on the expand sign ![expand](icon). Each of the layers offers an option to add it to Compare or Pins by clicking Add to. Based on your action, the Compare and Pins panels will include added layers ![compare-with-badge](icon) ![pins-with-badge](icon) which you can further organise and analyse under each tab. Click on the **Custom visualisation** option to select custom band combinations, index combinations or write your own classification script for the visualisation of data. You can also use custom scripts, which are stored elsewhere, either on Google Drive, GitHub or in our [Custom script repository](https://custom-scripts.sentinel-hub.com/). Paste the URL of the script into the text box in the advanced script editing panel and click Refresh. The custom script of preconfigured layers can be edited by choosing the code icon ![code-icon](icon). You can select **Show effects and advanced options** like the sampling method, advanced RGB effects or apply contrast (gain) and luminance (gamma). To return to preconfigured layers, click **Show visualisations**. **Share** your visualisation on social media by clicking on the share icon .
msgstr: Za prikaz podatkov izbranega rezultata lahko izberete različne vnaprej nameščene ali lastne kombinacije spektralnih kanalov. Nekatere pogoste možnosti: - **True Color** (prave barve) - vizualna interpretacija pokrovnosti tal - **False Color** (lažne barve) - vizualna interpretacija vegetacije - **NDVI** - vegetacijski indeks - **Indeks vlažnosti** - indeks vlažnosti - **SWIR** - kratkovalovni infrardeči indeks - **NDWI** - normaliziran diferenčni vodni indeks - **NDSI** - normaliziran diferenčni indeks snega Večina prikazov ima opis in legendo, ki si ju lahko ogledate s klikom na znak za razširitev ![expand](icon). Vsak od slojev ponuja možnost dodajanja med Primerjaj ali Oznake s klikom na Dodaj v. Glede na vaše dejanje bosta plošči Primerjaj in Oznake vključevali dodane sloje ![compare-with-badge](icon) ![pins-with-badge](icon), ki jih lahko v posameznem zavihku nadalje urejate in analizirate. Kliknite možnost **Ustvari prikaz po meri**, da izberete kombinacije kanalov po meri, kombinacije indeksov ali napišete lastno klasifikacijsko skripto za prikaz podatkov. Uporabite lahko tudi skripte po meri, shranjene drugje, na Google Drive, GitHubu ali v našem [repozitoriju skript po meri](https://custom-scripts.sentinel-hub.com/). Prilepite URL skripte v besedilno polje v plošči za napredno urejanje skriptov in kliknite Osveži. Skripto po meri vnaprej konfiguriranih slojev lahko urejate z izbiro ikone kode ![code-icon](icon). Izberete lahko **Pokaži učinke in napredne možnosti**, kot so način vzorčenja, napredni učinki RGB ali uporaba kontrasta (gain) in svetlosti (gamma). Za vrnitev na vnaprej konfigurirane sloje kliknite **Prikaži vizualizacije**. **Delite** svoj prikaz na družbenih omrežjih s klikom na ikono za deljenje .

The **Pins** panel contains your pinned.msgid: The **Pins** panel contains your pinned (favourite/saved) items. # Wildfires\n\nThis script, based on the.msgid:
# Wildfires

This script, based on the Pierre Markuse wildfire script, detects and visualizes wildfires using Landsat 8/9 thermal and visible bands. It combines natural color (B2, B3, B4) with thermal band (B10) analysis to detect temperature anomalies and create a red-orange-white glow effect highlighting fire locations.



More info [here.](https://github.com/azlinszkysinergise/customscripts_test_az/blob/main/landsat_markuse_fire_v2)
msgstr:
# Požari v naravi

Ta skripta, ki temelji na skripti Pierra Markuseja za požare v naravi, zaznava in vizualizira požare v naravi s termalnimi in vidnimi kanali Landsat 8/9. Združuje naravne barve (B2, B3, B4) z analizo termalnega kanala (B10) za zaznavanje temperaturnih anomalij in ustvarja rdeče-oranžno-beli sijaj, ki poudari lokacije požarov.



Več informacij [tukaj.](https://github.com/azlinszkysinergise/customscripts_test_az/blob/main/landsat_markuse_fire_v2)

The High Resolution Layer Grassland Chan.msgid:
The High Resolution Layer Grassland Change (GRAC) raster product at 20m resolution provides information on changes in grassland vegetation cover. The thematic classes indicate all non-grassland areas, grassland gain and grassland loss, unchanged grassland in both years and unverified grassland gain and loss areas. This dataset covers two comparison periods, 2018-2021 and 2021-2024, with each product dated by the end year of its comparison period.

This dataset is provided in 20 meter rasters (fully conformant with the EEA reference grid) in 100 x 100 km tiles covering the EEA38 countries.

High Resolution Layer Grasslands product is part of the European Union’s Copernicus Land Monitoring Service. Confidence layer available for the dataset.

This dataset includes data from the French Overseas Territories (DOMs). More information [here](https://land.copernicus.eu/en/products/high-resolution-layer-grasslands).
msgstr:
Rastrski izdelek High Resolution Layer Grassland Change (GRAC) ločljivosti 20 m zagotavlja informacije o spremembah vegetacijskega pokrova travinja. Tematski razredi kažejo vsa območja brez travinja, pridobitev in izgubo travinja, nespremenjeno travinje v obeh letih ter nepreverjena območja pridobitve in izgube travinja. Ta zbirka podatkov zajema dve primerjalni obdobji, 2018-2021 in 2021-2024, pri čemer je vsak izdelek datiran s končnim letom svojega primerjalnega obdobja.

Ta zbirka podatkov je na voljo v rastrih ločljivosti 20 metrov (popolnoma skladnih z referenčno mrežo EEA) v ploščicah 100 x 100 km, ki pokrivajo države EEA38.

Izdelek High Resolution Layer Grasslands je del storitve Copernicus za spremljanje kopenskega površja Evropske unije. Za zbirko podatkov je na voljo sloj zaupanja.

Ta zbirka podatkov vključuje podatke francoskih čezmorskih ozemelj (DOM). Več informacij [tukaj](https://land.copernicus.eu/en/products/high-resolution-layer-grasslands).
