msgstr: Zagotavlja podrobne informacije o pokrovnosti in rabi tal za 59 tematskih razredov na izbranih območjih Natura2000 in Emerald za referenčno leto 2021. Zbirka podatkov ima najmanjšo kartirno enoto (MMU) 0,5 ha in najmanjšo kartirno širino (MMW) 10 m ter je na voljo kot vektorski podatki.

Provides detailed land cover and land us.msgid: Provides detailed land cover and land use information for 59 thematic classes in selected Natura2000 and Emerald sites for the 2021 reference year. The dataset has a Minimum Mapping Unit (MMU) of 0.5 ha and a Minimum Mapping Width (MMW) of 10 m and is available as vector data. More information [here](https://land.copernicus.eu/en/products/n2k).
msgstr: Zagotavlja podrobne informacije o pokrovnosti in rabi tal za 59 tematskih razredov na izbranih območjih Natura2000 in Emerald za referenčno leto 2021. Zbirka podatkov ima najmanjšo kartirno enoto (MMU) 0,5 ha in najmanjšo kartirno širino (MMW) 10 m ter je na voljo kot vektorski podatki. Več informacij [tukaj](https://land.copernicus.eu/en/products/n2k).

Only applies to data sources within Urba.msgid: Only applies to data sources within Urban Atlas. Filters results by the country the data covers. Country codes follow the Eurostat convention, see the full list [here](https://ec.europa.eu/eurostat/statistics-explained/index.php?title=Glossary%3ACountry_codes).
msgstr: Velja samo za vire podatkov znotraj Urban Atlas. Filtrira rezultate po državi, ki jo podatki pokrivajo. Kode držav sledijo konvenciji Eurostata, celoten seznam je [tukaj](https://ec.europa.eu/eurostat/statistics-explained/index.php?title=Glossary%3ACountry_codes).

Only applies to data sources within Prot.msgid: Only applies to data sources within Protected Areas. Filters results by DUid (regional delivery unit code).
msgstr: Velja samo za vire podatkov znotraj zavarovanih območij. Filtrira rezultate po DUid (koda regionalne dostavne enote).

Provides at pan-European level in the sp.msgid: Provides at pan-European level in the spatial resolution of 20 m information on the changes in five thematic classes (new broadleaved cover / new coniferous cover / loss of broadleaved cover / loss of coniferous cover / unchanged areas with tree cover).
msgstr: Zagotavlja informacije o spremembah v petih tematskih razredih (nov pokrov listavcev / nov pokrov iglavcev / izguba pokrova listavcev / izguba pokrova iglavcev / nespremenjena območja z drevesnim pokrovom) na vseevropski ravni s prostorsko ločljivostjo 20 m.

Provides at pan-European level in the sp.msgid: Provides at pan-European level in the spatial resolution of 20 m information on tree cover extend changes in three thematic classes (new tree cover / loss of tree cover / unchanged areas with tree cover).
msgstr: Zagotavlja informacije o spremembah obsega drevesnega pokrova v treh tematskih razredih (nov drevesni pokrov / izguba drevesnega pokrova / nespremenjena območja z drevesnim pokrovom) na vseevropski ravni s prostorsko ločljivostjo 20 m.

The High Resolution Layer Dominant Leaf.msgid:
The High Resolution Layer Dominant Leaf Type Change (DLTC) raster provides information on the change between two reference years, and consists of 5 thematic classes (new broadleaved cover / new coniferous cover / loss of broadleaved cover / loss of coniferous cover / unchanged areas with tree cover). This dataset covers two comparison periods, 2018-2021 and 2021-2024, with each product dated by the end year of its comparison period.

This dataset is provided in 20 meter rasters (fully conformant with the EEA reference grid) in 100 x 100 km tiles covering the EEA38 countries.

The production of the high resolution forest layers was coordinated by the European Environment Agency (EEA) in the frame of the EU Copernicus programme.

This dataset includes data from the French Overseas Territories (DOMs). More information [here](https://land.copernicus.eu/en/products/high-resolution-layer-forests-and-tree-cover).
msgstr:
Raster High Resolution Layer Dominant Leaf Type Change (DLTC) zagotavlja informacije o spremembi med dvema referenčnima letoma in je sestavljen iz 5 tematskih razredov (nov pokrov listavcev / nov pokrov iglavcev / izguba pokrova listavcev / izguba pokrova iglavcev / nespremenjena območja z drevesnim pokrovom). Ta zbirka podatkov zajema dve primerjalni obdobji, 2018-2021 in 2021-2024, pri čemer je vsak izdelek datiran s končnim letom svojega primerjalnega obdobja.

Ta zbirka podatkov je na voljo v rastrih ločljivosti 20 metrov (popolnoma skladnih z referenčno mrežo EEA) v ploščicah 100 x 100 km, ki pokrivajo države EEA38.

Izdelavo gozdnih slojev visoke ločljivosti je v okviru programa EU Copernicus usklajevala Evropska agencija za okolje (EEA).

Ta zbirka podatkov vključuje podatke francoskih čezmorskih ozemelj (DOM). Več informacij [tukaj](https://land.copernicus.eu/en/products/high-resolution-layer-forests-and-tree-cover).

The Copernicus High Resolution Layer Tre.msgid:
The Copernicus High Resolution Layer Tree Cover Presence Change (TCPC) raster product provides information on the change between two reference years, and consists of 3 thematic classes (new tree cover / loss of tree cover / unchanged areas with tree cover). The class 255 = outside area is predefined by the 100m boundary layer and remains unchanged. This layer for previous reference year comparisons is called Tree Cover Change Mask (TCCM). This dataset covers two comparison periods, 2018-2021 and 2021-2024, with each product dated by the end year of its comparison period.

This dataset is provided in 20 meter rasters (fully conformant with the EEA reference grid) in 100 x 100 km tiles covering the EEA38 countries.

The production of the high resolution forest layers was coordinated by the European Environment Agency (EEA) in the frame of the EU Copernicus programme. Confidence layer available for the dataset.

This dataset includes data from the French Overseas Territories (DOMs). More information [here](https://land.copernicus.eu/en/products/high-resolution-layer-forests-and-tree-cover).
msgstr:
Rastrski izdelek Copernicus High Resolution Layer Tree Cover Presence Change (TCPC) zagotavlja informacije o spremembi med dvema referenčnima letoma in je sestavljen iz 3 tematskih razredov (nov drevesni pokrov / izguba drevesnega pokrova / nespremenjena območja z drevesnim pokrovom). Razred 255 = zunanje območje je vnaprej določen s slojem meje ločljivosti 100 m in ostaja nespremenjen. Ta sloj za primerjave prejšnjih referenčnih let se imenuje Tree Cover Change Mask (TCCM). Ta zbirka podatkov zajema dve primerjalni obdobji, 2018-2021 in 2021-2024, pri čemer je vsak izdelek datiran s končnim letom svojega primerjalnega obdobja.

Ta zbirka podatkov je na voljo v rastrih ločljivosti 20 metrov (popolnoma skladnih z referenčno mrežo EEA) v ploščicah 100 x 100 km, ki pokrivajo države EEA38.

Izdelavo gozdnih slojev visoke ločljivosti je v okviru programa EU Copernicus usklajevala Evropska agencija za okolje (EEA). Za zbirko podatkov je na voljo sloj zaupanja.

Ta zbirka podatkov vključuje podatke francoskih čezmorskih ozemelj (DOM). Več informacij [tukaj](https://land.copernicus.eu/en/products/high-resolution-layer-forests-and-tree-cover).

Provides a statistical overview of the l.msgid: Provides a statistical overview of the land surface temperature over each 10-day compositing period regardless of any specific hour and every geostationary sensor image pixel. The data are available at global scale in the spatial resolution of about 5 km and covers the period from January 2021 to January 2023 with version 2.0 and from January 2023 to 2026 with version 2.1. More information [here](https://land.copernicus.eu/en/products/temperature-and-reflectance/10-daily-land-surface-temperature-thermal-condition-index-global-v2-0-5km).
msgstr: Zagotavlja statistični pregled temperature površja kopnega za vsako 10-dnevno obdobje sestavljanja ne glede na določeno uro in za vsak piksel posnetka geostacionarnega senzorja. Podatki so na voljo v globalnem merilu s prostorsko ločljivostjo približno 5 km in pokrivajo obdobje od januarja 2021 do januarja 2023 z različico 2.0 ter od januarja 2023 do 2026 z različico 2.1. Več informacij [tukaj](https://land.copernicus.eu/en/products/temperature-and-reflectance/10-daily-land-surface-temperature-thermal-condition-index-global-v2-0-5km).

Provides hourly land surface temperature.msgid:
Provides hourly land surface temperature from geostationary sensors observations. The data are available at global scale in the spatial resolution of about 5 km and covers the period from January 2021 to January 2023 with version 2.0 and from January 2023 to 2026 with version 2.1. More information [here](https://land.copernicus.eu/en/products/temperature-and-reflectance/hourly-land-surface-temperature-global-v2-0-5km). 

*Please note that under default settings, the dataset displayed for each day is the latest image available, which typically reflects the data captured up to midnight. To access data from a specific hour, use the "Date: time range" mode.
msgstr:
Zagotavlja urno temperaturo površja kopnega iz opazovanj geostacionarnih senzorjev. Podatki so na voljo v globalnem merilu s prostorsko ločljivostjo približno 5 km in pokrivajo obdobje od januarja 2021 do januarja 2023 z različico 2.0 ter od januarja 2023 do 2026 z različico 2.1. Več informacij [tukaj](https://land.copernicus.eu/en/products/temperature-and-reflectance/hourly-land-surface-temperature-global-v2-0-5km). 

*Upoštevajte, da je pri privzetih nastavitvah za vsak dan prikazana zadnja razpoložljiva slika, ki običajno odraža podatke, zajete do polnoči. Za dostop do podatkov določene ure uporabite način »Datum: časovni obseg«.

Provides a statistical overview of the l.msgid: Provides a statistical overview of the land surface temperature daily cycle for each 10-day compositing period and every geostationary sensor image pixel. The data are available at global scale in the spatial resolution of about 5 km and covers the period from January 2021 to January 2023 with version 2.0 and from January 2023 to 2026 with version 2.1. More information [here](https://land.copernicus.eu/en/products/temperature-and-reflectance/10-daily-land-surface-temperature-daily-cycle-global-v2-0-5km).
msgstr: Zagotavlja statistični pregled dnevnega cikla temperature površja kopnega za vsako 10-dnevno obdobje sestavljanja in za vsak piksel posnetka geostacionarnega senzorja. Podatki so na voljo v globalnem merilu s prostorsko ločljivostjo približno 5 km in pokrivajo obdobje od januarja 2021 do januarja 2023 z različico 2.0 ter od januarja 2023 do 2026 z različico 2.1. Več informacij [tukaj](https://land.copernicus.eu/en/products/temperature-and-reflectance/10-daily-land-surface-temperature-daily-cycle-global-v2-0-5km).

Quantifies the fraction of the solar rad.msgid: Quantifies the fraction of the solar radiation absorbed by live plants for photosynthesis. Every 10-days estimates are available in near real time at global scale in the spatial resolution of about 300 m from January 2014 to June 2020 based upon PROBA-V data with version 1.0 and from July 2020 to 2026 based upon Sentinel-3/OLCI data with version 1.1. More information [here](https://land.copernicus.eu/en/products/vegetation/fraction-of-absorbed-photosynthetically-active-radiation-v1-0-300m).
msgstr: Kvantificira delež sončnega sevanja, ki ga žive rastline vpijejo za fotosintezo. Desetdnevne ocene so skoraj v realnem času na voljo v globalnem merilu s prostorsko ločljivostjo približno 300 m od januarja 2014 do junija 2020 na podlagi podatkov PROBA-V z različico 1.0 ter od julija 2020 do 2026 na podlagi podatkov Sentinel-3/OLCI z različico 1.1. Več informacij [tukaj](https://land.copernicus.eu/en/products/vegetation/fraction-of-absorbed-photosynthetically-active-radiation-v1-0-300m).

Represents the overall growth rate or dr.msgid: Represents the overall growth rate or dry biomass increase of the vegetation and is directly related to ecosystem Net Primary Production (NPP), however with units customized for agro-statistical purposes (kg/ha/day). Every 10-days estimates are available in near real time at global scale in the spatial resolution of about 300 m from January 2014 to June 2020 based upon PROBA-V data with version 1.0 and from July 2020 to 2026 based upon Sentinel-3/OLCI data with version 1.1. More information [here](https://land.copernicus.eu/en/products/vegetation/dry-matter-productivity-v1-0-300m).
msgstr: Predstavlja celotno stopnjo rasti oziroma prirastek suhe biomase vegetacije in je neposredno povezana z neto primarno produkcijo (NPP) ekosistema, vendar z enotami, prilagojenimi za agrostatistične namene (kg/ha/dan). Desetdnevne ocene so skoraj v realnem času na voljo v globalnem merilu s prostorsko ločljivostjo približno 300 m od januarja 2014 do junija 2020 na podlagi podatkov PROBA-V z različico 1.0 ter od julija 2020 do 2026 na podlagi podatkov Sentinel-3/OLCI z različico 1.1. Več informacij [tukaj](https://land.copernicus.eu/en/products/vegetation/dry-matter-productivity-v1-0-300m).

Corresponds to the fraction of ground co.msgid: Corresponds to the fraction of ground covered by green vegetation. It quantifies the spatial extent of the vegetation. Every 10-days estimates are available in near real time at global scale in the spatial resolution of about 300 m from January 2014 to June 2020 based upon PROBA-V data with version 1.0 and from July 2020 to 2026 based upon Sentinel-3/OLCI data with version 1.1. More information [here](https://land.copernicus.eu/en/products/vegetation/fraction-of-green-vegetation-cover-v1-0-300m).
msgstr: Ustreza deležu tal, ki ga prekriva zelena vegetacija. Kvantificira prostorski obseg vegetacije. Desetdnevne ocene so skoraj v realnem času na voljo v globalnem merilu s prostorsko ločljivostjo približno 300 m od januarja 2014 do junija 2020 na podlagi podatkov PROBA-V z različico 1.0 ter od julija 2020 do 2026 na podlagi podatkov Sentinel-3/OLCI z različico 1.1. Več informacij [tukaj](https://land.copernicus.eu/en/products/vegetation/fraction-of-green-vegetation-cover-v1-0-300m).

Equivalent to Gross Primary Production (.msgid: Equivalent to Gross Primary Production (GPP). Every 10-days estimates are available in near real time at global scale in the spatial resolution of about 300 m from January 2014 to June 2020 based upon PROBA-V data with version 1.0 and from July 2020 to 2026 based upon Sentinel-3/OLCI data with version 1.1. More information [here](https://land.copernicus.eu/en/products/vegetation/gross-dry-matter-productivity-v1-0-300m).
msgstr: Enakovredna bruto primarni produkciji (GPP). Desetdnevne ocene so skoraj v realnem času na voljo v globalnem merilu s prostorsko ločljivostjo približno 300 m od januarja 2014 do junija 2020 na podlagi podatkov PROBA-V z različico 1.0 ter od julija 2020 do 2026 na podlagi podatkov Sentinel-3/OLCI z različico 1.1. Več informacij [tukaj](https://land.copernicus.eu/en/products/vegetation/gross-dry-matter-productivity-v1-0-300m).

Maps burn scars, surfaces which have bee.msgid: Maps burn scars, surfaces which have been sufficiently affected by fire to display significant changes in the vegetation cover (destruction of dry material, reduction or loss of green material) and in the ground surface (temporarily darker because of ash). Monthly datasets are available at global scale, in the spatial resolution of 300 m, and with a time lag of two months. They cover the period from 2019 to 2025. More information [here](https://land.copernicus.eu/en/products/vegetation/burnt-area-v3-1-monthly-300m).
msgstr: Kartira požgane površine, tj. površine, na katere je požar dovolj vplival, da kažejo znatne spremembe vegetacijskega pokrova (uničenje suhe snovi, zmanjšanje ali izguba zelene snovi) in talne površine (začasno temnejša zaradi pepela). Mesečne zbirke podatkov so na voljo v globalnem merilu, s prostorsko ločljivostjo 300 m in dvomesečnim časovnim zamikom. Pokrivajo obdobje od 2019 do 2025. Več informacij [tukaj](https://land.copernicus.eu/en/products/vegetation/burnt-area-v3-1-monthly-300m).

Maps burn scars, surfaces which have bee.msgid: Maps burn scars, surfaces which have been sufficiently affected by fire to display significant changes in the vegetation cover (destruction of dry material, reduction or loss of green material) and in the ground surface (temporarily darker because of ash). Daily datasets are available at global scale, in the spatial resolution of 300 m, and within 24 hours after the satellite acquisition. They cover the period from July 2023 to 2025. More info [here](https://land.copernicus.eu/en/products/vegetation/burnt-area-v3-1-daily-300m).
msgstr: Kartira požgane površine, tj. površine, na katere je požar dovolj vplival, da kažejo znatne spremembe vegetacijskega pokrova (uničenje suhe snovi, zmanjšanje ali izguba zelene snovi) in talne površine (začasno temnejša zaradi pepela). Dnevne zbirke podatkov so na voljo v globalnem merilu, s prostorsko ločljivostjo 300 m in v 24 urah po satelitskem zajemu. Pokrivajo obdobje od julija 2023 do 2025. Več informacij [tukaj](https://land.copernicus.eu/en/products/vegetation/burnt-area-v3-1-daily-300m).

Provides the total amount of carbon comp.msgid: Provides the total amount of carbon compounds produced by photosynthesis of plants in an ecosystem in a given period of time. 10-daily observations are available at global scale in the spatial resolution of 300 m and with the temporal extent from 2023 to 2026. More information [here](https://land.copernicus.eu/en/products/vegetation/gross-primary-production-v1-0-300m).
msgstr: Zagotavlja skupno količino ogljikovih spojin, ki jih v danem časovnem obdobju s fotosintezo proizvedejo rastline v ekosistemu. Desetdnevna opazovanja so na voljo v globalnem merilu s prostorsko ločljivostjo 300 m za obdobje od 2023 do 2026. Več informacij [tukaj](https://land.copernicus.eu/en/products/vegetation/gross-primary-production-v1-0-300m).

Defined as half the total area of green.msgid: Defined as half the total area of green elements of the canopy per unit horizontal ground area. Every 10-days estimates are available in near real time at global scale in the spatial resolution of about 300 m from January 2014 to June 2020 based upon PROBA-V data with version 1.0 and from July 2020 to 2026 based upon Sentinel-3/OLCI data with version 1.1. More information [here](https://land.copernicus.eu/en/products/vegetation/leaf-area-index-300m-v1.0).
msgstr: Definiran kot polovica skupne površine zelenih elementov krošnje na enoto vodoravne talne površine. Desetdnevne ocene so skoraj v realnem času na voljo v globalnem merilu s prostorsko ločljivostjo približno 300 m od januarja 2014 do junija 2020 na podlagi podatkov PROBA-V z različico 1.0 ter od julija 2020 do 2026 na podlagi podatkov Sentinel-3/OLCI z različico 1.1. Več informacij [tukaj](https://land.copernicus.eu/en/products/vegetation/leaf-area-index-300m-v1.0).

Provides the amount of carbon retained i.msgid: Provides the amount of carbon retained in an ecosystem (increase in biomass); it is equal to the difference between the amount of carbon produced through photosynthesis (GPP) and the amount of energy that is used for respiration (R). 10-daily observations are available at global scale in the spatial resolution of 300 m and with the temporal extent from 2023 to 2026. More information [here](https://land.copernicus.eu/en/products/vegetation/net-primary-production-v1-0-300m).
msgstr: Zagotavlja količino ogljika, zadržanega v ekosistemu (prirastek biomase); enaka je razliki med količino ogljika, proizvedenega s fotosintezo (GPP), in količino energije, porabljene za dihanje (R). Desetdnevna opazovanja so na voljo v globalnem merilu s prostorsko ločljivostjo 300 m za obdobje od 2023 do 2026. Več informacij [tukaj](https://land.copernicus.eu/en/products/vegetation/net-primary-production-v1-0-300m).

Averages the daily Soil Water Index prod.msgid: Averages the daily Soil Water Index product over 10 days. The data are produced every 10 days over the globe at the spatial resolution of 0.1° and with the temporal extent from January 2007 to 2025. More information [here](https://land.copernicus.eu/en/products/soil-moisture/10-daily-soil-water-index-global-v3-0-12-5-km).
msgstr: Povpreča dnevni izdelek indeksa vodnosti tal v 10 dneh. Podatki nastajajo vsakih 10 dni za celoten svet s prostorsko ločljivostjo 0,1° in za obdobje od januarja 2007 do 2025. Več informacij [tukaj](https://land.copernicus.eu/en/products/soil-moisture/10-daily-soil-water-index-global-v3-0-12-5-km).

Provides daily updates on the moisture c.msgid: Provides daily updates on the moisture conditions in different soil layers. The data are available over the globe at the spatial resolution of 0.1° and with the temporal extent from January 2007 to 2025. More information [here](https://land.copernicus.eu/en/products/soil-moisture/daily-soil-water-index-global-v3-0-12-5km).
msgstr: Zagotavlja dnevne posodobitve o vlažnosti v različnih plasteh tal. Podatki so na voljo za celoten svet s prostorsko ločljivostjo 0,1° in za obdobje od januarja 2007 do 2025. Več informacij [tukaj](https://land.copernicus.eu/en/products/soil-moisture/daily-soil-water-index-global-v3-0-12-5km).

Quantifies the moisture condition at var.msgid: Quantifies the moisture condition at various depths in the soil. Daily observations are available for the continental Europe in the spatial resolution of 1 km and with the temporal extent from January 2015 to 2025. More information [here](https://land.copernicus.eu/en/products/soil-moisture/daily-soil-water-index-europe-v1-0-1km).
msgstr: Kvantificira vlažnost tal na različnih globinah. Dnevna opazovanja so na voljo za celinsko Evropo s prostorsko ločljivostjo 1 km in za obdobje od januarja 2015 do 2025. Več informacij [tukaj](https://land.copernicus.eu/en/products/soil-moisture/daily-soil-water-index-europe-v1-0-1km).

Provides for Northern Hemisphere daily m.msgid: Provides for Northern Hemisphere daily maps of the fraction of snow cover on ground (also in forested areas) per pixel in percentage (0% – 100%). The data is available in near real time with a pixel spacing of about 1 km and with the temporal extent from January 2018 to 2026. More information [here](https://land.copernicus.eu/en/products/snow/snow-cover-extent-northern-hemisphere-v1-0-1km).
msgstr: Zagotavlja dnevne zemljevide deleža snežne odeje na tleh (tudi v gozdnatih območjih) na piksel v odstotkih (0 % – 100 %) za severno poloblo. Podatki so na voljo skoraj v realnem času z razmikom pikslov približno 1 km za obdobje od januarja 2018 do 2026. Več informacij [tukaj](https://land.copernicus.eu/en/products/snow/snow-cover-extent-northern-hemisphere-v1-0-1km).

On a daily basis classifies pixels in No.msgid: On a daily basis classifies pixels in Northern Hemisphere freshwater bodies into 1) Ice, 2) Open water, and 3) Cloud. The class “Ice” includes various types of ice, also snow-covered ice. The data is updated in near real-time with the spatial resolution of 500 m and with a temporal extent from April 2021 to 2025. More information [here](https://land.copernicus.eu/en/products/water-bodies/lake-ice-extent-northern-hemisphere-500m).
msgstr: Dnevno razvršča piksle v celinskih vodnih telesih severne poloble v 1) led, 2) odprto vodo in 3) oblak. Razred »led« vključuje različne vrste ledu, tudi led, prekrit s snegom. Podatki se posodabljajo skoraj v realnem času s prostorsko ločljivostjo 500 m in za obdobje od aprila 2021 do 2025. Več informacij [tukaj](https://land.copernicus.eu/en/products/water-bodies/lake-ice-extent-northern-hemisphere-500m).

Classified layer, differentiating the cl.msgid: Classified layer, differentiating the classes of permanent water (1), temporary water (2), and dry areas (0). The dataset can also have the following values: cloud or cloud shadow (205), sea water (253), or no data (255).
msgstr: Klasificiran sloj, ki razlikuje razrede stalne vode (1), začasne vode (2) in suhih območij (0). Zbirka podatkov ima lahko tudi naslednje vrednosti: oblak ali senca oblaka (205), morska voda (253) ali ni podatkov (255).

Occurrence of water areas throughout the.msgid: Occurrence of water areas throughout the entire observation period (between 0 and 100).
msgstr: Pojavljanje vodnih območij v celotnem obdobju opazovanja (med 0 in 100).

Quality layer providing an assessment of.msgid: Quality layer providing an assessment of the water layer (WL) quality (between 0 and 100).
msgstr: Sloj kakovosti, ki zagotavlja oceno kakovosti vodnega sloja (WL) (med 0 in 100).

The **High Resolution Water Layer (HRWL).msgid:
The **High Resolution Water Layer (HRWL)** product provides classified maps showing permanent water, temporary water, dry areas, and sea water. It is a multi-annual product, typically covering a **7-year period**, and is updated every 3 years. It is based on the annual Water Cover Duration (WCD) production, which combines water masks from **Sentinel-1** radar and **Sentinel-2** optical imagery with Water/Ice Cover data from Sentinel-2 (WIC S2).

The product is generated at the European scale with a spatial resolution of **10 m × 10 m**.

**Data availability**: HRWL is available for the reference years 2021 and 2024, covering the periods **01/09/2016**–31/12/2021 and **01/09/2018**–31/12/2024, respectively. The dataset can be downloaded in multiple projections and pixel spacings.

More information [here](https://land.copernicus.eu/en/products/water-bodies/high-resolution-water-layer).
msgstr:
Izdelek **High Resolution Water Layer (HRWL)** zagotavlja klasificirane zemljevide, ki kažejo stalno vodo, začasno vodo, suha območja in morsko vodo. Je večletni izdelek, ki običajno zajema **7-letno obdobje** in se posodablja vsake 3 leta. Temelji na letni izdelavi izdelka Water Cover Duration (WCD), ki združuje vodne maske iz radarskih posnetkov **Sentinel-1** in optičnih posnetkov **Sentinel-2** s podatki Water/Ice Cover iz Sentinel-2 (WIC S2).

Izdelek se ustvarja v evropskem merilu s prostorsko ločljivostjo **10 m × 10 m**.

**Razpoložljivost podatkov**: HRWL je na voljo za referenčni leti 2021 in 2024, ki pokrivata obdobji **01/09/2016**–31/12/2021 oziroma **01/09/2018**–31/12/2024. Zbirko podatkov je mogoče prenesti v več projekcijah in z več razmiki pikslov.

Več informacij [tukaj](https://land.copernicus.eu/en/products/water-bodies/high-resolution-water-layer).

Land Surface Temperature (LST) is the th.msgid: Land Surface Temperature (LST) is the thermodynamic temperature of Earth’s surface. LST is a key variable controlling energy, and water fluxes over the land surface and atmosphere interface. In view of increasing extreme temperature events and a growing population exposed to these events, LST is increasingly relevant to sustainably manage food and water systems and urban living conditions.
msgstr: Temperatura površja kopnega (LST) je termodinamična temperatura zemeljskega površja. LST je ključna spremenljivka, ki nadzoruje tokove energije in vode na stiku kopnega površja in atmosfere. Glede na vse pogostejše ekstremne temperaturne dogodke in vse večji delež prebivalstva, izpostavljenega tem dogodkom, je LST vse pomembnejša za trajnostno upravljanje prehranskih in vodnih sistemov ter življenjskih razmer v mestih.

The collection holds Level-2 Land Surfac.msgid:
The collection holds Level-2 Land Surface Temperature (LST) products from OroraTech’s
FOREST satellites, at 200 m ground sampling distance, over selected European pilot sites.
Each product is a Cloud Optimized GeoTIFF giving the land surface temperature, in Kelvin.
Daytime and night-time acquisitions from complementary orbits make the collection suited to
studying the daily temperature cycle, urban heat islands, drought and surface water stress.
msgstr:
Zbirka vsebuje izdelke Level-2 temperature površja kopnega (LST) satelitov FOREST podjetja OroraTech
z razdaljo vzorčenja na tleh 200 m nad izbranimi evropskimi pilotnimi lokacijami.
Vsak izdelek je Cloud Optimized GeoTIFF, ki podaja temperaturo površja kopnega v kelvinih.
Dnevni in nočni zajemi iz komplementarnih orbit naredijo zbirko primerno za
preučevanje dnevnega temperaturnega cikla, urbanih toplotnih otokov, suše in stresa zaradi pomanjkanja površinske vode.
